entries.text: haddathanaa al-humaydiyyu 'abdu Allah ibnu az-zubayri , qaala : haddathanaa sufyaanu , qaala : haddathanaa yahyaa ibnu sa'eedin al-ansaariyyu , qaala : akhbaranee muhammadu ibnu ibraaheema at-taymiyyu , annahu sami'a 'alqamata ibna waqqaasin al-laythiyya , yaqoolu : sami'tu 'umara ibna al-khattaabi radiya Allah 'anhu 'alaa al-minbari, qaala : sami'tu rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam, yaqoolu : " innamaa al-a'maalu bin-niyyaati, wa'innamaa likulli imri'in maa nawaa, faman kaanat hijratuhu ilaa dunyaa yuseebuhaa aw ilaa imra'atin yankihuhaa, fahijratuhu ilaa maa haajara ilayhi

haddathanaa 'abdaanu, qaala akhbaranaa 'abdu Allah, qaala akhbaranaa yoonusu, 'ani az-zuhriyyi, (h) wahaddathanaa bishru ibnu muhammadin, qaala akhbaranaa 'abdu Allah, qaala akhbaranaa yoonusu, wama'marun, 'ani az-zuhriyyi, nahwahu qaala akhbaranee 'ubaydu Allah ibnu 'abdi Allah, 'ani ibni 'abbaasin, qaala kaana rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ajwada an-naasi, wakaana ajwadu maa yakoonu fee ramadaana heena yalqaahu jibreelu, wakaana yalqaahu fee kulli laylatin min ramadaana fayudaarisuhu al-qur'aana, falarasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ajwadu bil-khayri mina ar-reehi al-mursalati‏.‏

haddathanaa 'ubaydu Allah ibnu moosaa, qaala akhbaranaa hanzalatu ibnu abee sufyaana, 'an 'ikrimata ibni khaalidin, 'ani ibni 'umara radiya Allah 'anhuma qaala qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ buniya al-islamu 'alaa khamsin shahaadati an la ilaha ila Allah wa'anna muhammadan rasoolu Allah, wa'iqaami as-salati, wa'eetaa'i az-zakaati, wal-hajji, wasawmi ramadaana ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa 'abdu Allah ibnu muhammadin, qaala haddathanaa aboo 'aamirin al-'aqadiyyu, qaala haddathanaa sulaymaanu ibnu bilalin, 'an 'abdi Allah ibni deenaarin, 'an abee saalihin, 'an abee hurayrata radiya Allah 'anhu 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ al-eemaanu bid'un wasittoona shu'batan, wal-hayaa'u shu'batun mina al-eemaani ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa 'aadamu ibnu abee iyaasin, qaala haddathanaa shu'batu, 'an 'abdi Allah ibni abee as-safari, wa'ismaa'eela, 'ani ash-sha'biyyi, 'an 'abdi Allah ibni 'amrinw radiya Allah 'anhuma 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ al-muslimu man salima al-muslimoona min lisaanihi wayadihi, wal-muhaajiru man hajara maa nahaa Allah 'anhu ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala aboo 'abdi Allah waqaala aboo mu'aawiyata haddathanaa daawudu 'an 'aamirin qaala sami'tu 'abda Allah 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam‏.‏ waqaala 'abdu al-a'laa 'an daawuda 'an 'aamirin 'an 'abdi Allah 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam‏.‏

haddathanaa sa'eedu ibnu yahyaa ibni sa'eedin al-qurashiyyi, qaala haddathanaa abee qaala, haddathanaa aboo burdata ibnu 'abdi Allah ibni abee burdata, 'an abee burdata, 'an abee moosaa radiya Allah 'anhu qaala qaaloo yaa rasoola Allah aa al-islami afdalu qaala ‏ "‏ man salima al-muslimoona min lisaanihi wayadihi ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa 'amroo ibnu khaalidin, qaala haddathanaa al-laythu, 'an yazeeda, 'an abee al-khayri, 'an 'abdi Allah ibni 'amrinw radiya Allah 'anhuma anna rajulan, sa'ala an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam aa al-islami khayrun qaala ‏ "‏ tut'imu at-ta'aama, wataqra'u as-salama 'alaa man 'arafta waman lam ta'rif ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa musaddadun, qaala haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an shu'bata, 'an qataadata, 'an anasin radiya Allah 'anhu 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam‏.‏ wa'an husaynin al-mu'allimi, qaala haddathanaa qataadatu, 'an anasin, 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ l yu'minu ahadukum hattaa yuhibba l'akheehi maa yuhibbu linafsihi ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa aboo al-yamaani, qaala akhbaranaa shu'aybun, qaala haddathanaa aboo az-zinaadi, 'ani al-a'raji, 'an abee hurayrata radiya Allah 'anhu anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ fawaalladhee nafsee biyadihi la yu'minu ahadukum hattaa akoona ahabba ilayhi min waalidihi wawaladihi ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa ya'qoobu ibnu ibraaheema, qaala haddathanaa ibnu 'ulayyata, 'an 'abdi al-'azeezi ibni suhaybin, 'an anasin, 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam (h) wahaddathanaa 'aadamu, qaala haddathanaa shu'batu, 'an qataadata, 'an anasin, qaala qaala an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ la yu'minu ahadukum hattaa akoona ahabba ilayhi min waalidihi wawaladihi wan-naasi ajma'eena ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu al-muthannaa, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu al-wahhaabi ath-thaqafiyyu, qaala haddathanaa ayyoobu, 'an abee qilabata, 'an anasin, 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ thalathun man kunna feehi wajada halawata al-eemaani an yakoona Allah warasooluhu ahabba ilayhi mimmaa siwaahumaa, wa'an yuhibba al-mar'a la yuhibbuhu ila lillah, wa'an yakraha an ya'ooda fee al-kufri kamaa yakrahu an yuqdhafa fee an-naari ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa aboo al-waleedi, qaala haddathanaa shu'batu, qaala akhbaranee 'abdu Allah ibnu 'abdi Allah ibni jabrin, qaala sami'tu anasan, 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ 'aayatu al-eemaani hubbu al-ansaari, wa'aayatu an-nifaaqi bughdu al-ansaari ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa 'abdu Allah ibnu maslamata, 'an maalikin, 'an 'abdi ar-rahmani ibni 'abdi Allah ibni 'abdi ar-rahmani ibni abee sa'sa'ata, 'an abeehi, 'an abee sa'eedin al-khudriyyi, annahu qaala qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ yooshiku an yakoona khayra maali al-muslimi ghanamun yatba'u bihaa sha'afa al-jibaali wamawaaqi'a al-qatri, yafirru bideenihi mina al-fitani ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa sulaymaanu ibnu harbin, qaala haddathanaa shu'batu, 'an qataadata, 'an anasin radiya Allah 'anhu 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ thalathun man kunna feehi wajada halawata al-eemaani man kaana Allah warasooluhu ahabba ilayhi mimmaa siwaahumaa, waman ahabba 'abdan la yuhibbuhu ila lillah, waman yakrahu an ya'ooda fee al-kufri ba'da idh anqadhahu Allah, kamaa yakrahu an yulqaa fee an-naari ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa 'abdu as-salami ibnu mutahharin, qaala haddathanaa 'umaru ibnu 'aliyyin, 'an ma'ni ibni muhammadin al-ghifaariyyi, 'an sa'eedi ibni abee sa'eedin al-maqburiyyi, 'an abee hurayrata, 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ inna ad-deena yusrun, walan yushaadda ad-deena ahadun ila ghalabahu, fasaddidoo waqaariboo wa'abshiroo, waasta'eenoo bil-ghadwati war-rawhati washaa'in mina ad-duljati ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa sa'eedu ibnu 'ufayrin, qaala haddathanaa ibnu wahbin, 'an yoonusa, 'ani ibni shihaabin, qaala qaala humaydu ibnu 'abdi ar-rahmani sami'tu mu'aawiyata, khateeban yaqoolu sami'tu an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam yaqoolu ‏ "‏ man yuridi Allah bihi khayran yufaqqihhu fee ad-deeni, wa'innamaa anaa qaasimun wal-lahu yu'tee, walan tazaala hadhihi al-ummatu qaa'imatan 'alaa amri Allah la yadurruhum man khaalafahum hattaa ya'atiya amru Allah ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa 'abdu Allah ibnu yoosufa, qaala akhbaranaa maalikun, 'an saalihi ibni kaysaana, 'an 'urwata ibni az-zubayri, 'an 'aa'ishata ummi al-mu'mineena, qaalat ‏ "‏ farada Allah as-salata heena faradahaa rak'atayni rak'atayni fee al-hadari was-safari, fa'uqirrat salatu as-safari, wazeeda fee salati al-hadari ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa moosaa ibnu ismaa'eela, qaala haddathanaa yazeedu ibnu ibraaheema, 'an muhammadin, 'an ummi 'atiyyata, qaalat umirnaa an nukhrija, al-huyyada yawma al-'eedayni wadhawaati al-khudoori, fayashhadna jamaa'ata al-muslimeena wada'watahum, waya'tazilu al-huyyadu 'an musalahunna‏.‏ qaalati imra'atun yaa rasoola Allah, ihdaanaa laysa lahaa jilbaabun‏.‏ qaala ‏ "‏ litulbishaa saahibatuhaa min jilbaabihaa ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala 'abdu Allah ibnu rajaa'in haddathanaa 'imraanu, haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu seereena, haddathatnaa ummu 'atiyyata, sami'tu an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam bihadhaa‏.‏

haddathanaa ahmadu ibnu yoonusa, qaala haddathanaa 'aasimu ibnu muhammadin, qaala haddathanee waaqidu ibnu muhammadin, 'an muhammadi ibni al-munkadiri, qaala salla jaabirun fee izaarin qad 'aqadahu min qibali qafaahu, wathiyaabuhu mawdoo'atun 'alaa al-mishjabi qaala lahu qaa'ilun tusallee fee izaarin waahidin faqaala innamaa sana'tu dhalika liyaraanee ahmaqu mithluka, wa'ayyunaa kaana lahu thawbaani 'alaa 'ahdi an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam

haddathanaa mutarrifun aboo mus'abin, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu ar-rahmani ibnu abee al-mawaalee, 'an muhammadi ibni al-munkadiri, qaala ra'aytu jaabira ibna 'abdi Allah yusallee fee thawbin waahidin waqaala ra'aytu an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam yusallee fee thawbin‏.‏

haddathanaa 'ubaydu Allah ibnu moosaa, qaala haddathanaa hishaamu ibnu 'urwata, 'an abeehi, 'an 'umara ibni abee salamata, anna an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam salla fee thawbin waahidin qad khaalafa bayna tarafayhi‏.‏

haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu al-muthannaa, qaala haddathanaa yahyaa, qaala haddathanaa hishaamun, qaala haddathanee abee, 'an 'umara ibni abee salamata, annahu ra'aa an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam yusallee fee thawbin waahidin fee bayti ummi salamata, qad alqaa tarafayhi 'alaa 'aatiqayhi‏.‏

haddathanaa 'ubaydu ibnu ismaa'eela, qaala haddathanaa aboo usaamata, 'an hishaamin, 'an abeehi, anna 'umara ibna abee salamata, akhbarahu qaala ra'aytu rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam yusallee fee thawbin waahidin mushtamilan bihi fee bayti ummi salamata, waadi'an tarafayhi 'alaa 'aatiqayhi‏.‏

haddathanaa 'abdu Allah ibnu yoosufa, qaala akhbaranaa maalikun, 'ani ibni shihaabin, 'an sa'eedi ibni al-musayyabi, 'an abee hurayrata, anna saa'ilan, sa'ala rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam 'ani as-salati fee thawbin waahidin faqaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ awalikullikum thawbaani ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa aboo 'aasimin, 'an maalikin, 'an abee az-zinaadi, 'an 'abdi ar-rahmani al-a'raji, 'an abee hurayrata, qaala qaala an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ la yusallee ahadukum fee ath-thawbi al-waahidi, laysa 'alaa 'aatiqayhi shaa'un ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa aboo nu'aymin, qaala haddathanaa shaybaanu, 'an yahyaa ibni abee katheerin, 'an 'ikrimata, qaala sami'tuhu aw, kuntu sa'altuhu qaala sami'tu abaa hurayrata, yaqoolu ashhadu annee sami'tu rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam yaqoolu ‏ "‏ man salla fee thawbin waahidin, falyukhaalif bayna tarafayhi ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa musaddadun, qaala haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an sufyaana, qaala haddathanee aboo haazimin, 'an sahlin, qaala kaana rijaalun yusalloona ma'a an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam 'aaqidee uzrihim 'alaa a'naaqihim kahay'ati as-sibyaani, waqaala lilnnisaa'i la tarfa'na ru'oosakunna hattaa yastawiya ar-rijaalu juloosan‏.‏

haddathanaa yahyaa, qaala haddathanaa aboo mu'aawiyata, 'ani al-a'mashi, 'an muslimin, 'an masrooqin, 'an mugheerata ibni shu'bata, qaala kuntu ma'a an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam fee safarin faqaala ‏ "‏ yaa mugheeratu, khudhi al-idaawata ‏"‏‏.‏ fa'akhadhtuhaa faantalaqa rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam hattaa tawaaraa 'annee faqadaa haajatahu, wa'alayhi jubbatun sha'amiyyatun, fadhahaba liyukhrija yadahu min kummihaa fadaaqat, fa'akhraja yadahu min asfalihaa, fasababtu 'alayhi fatawadda'a wudoo'ahu lilssalati, wamasaha 'alaa khuffayhi, thumma salla‏.‏

haddathanaa mataru ibnu al-fadli, qaala haddathanaa rawhun, qaala haddathanaa zakariyyaa'u ibnu ishaaqa, haddathanaa 'amroo ibnu deenaarin, qaala sami'tu jaabira ibna 'abdi Allah, yuhaddithu anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam kaana yanqulu ma'ahumu al-hijaarata lilka'bati wa'alayhi izaaruhu‏.‏ faqaala lahu al-'abbaasu 'ammuhu yaa ibna akhee, law halalta izaaraka faja'alta 'alaa mankibayka doona al-hijaarati‏.‏ qaala fahallahu faja'alahu 'alaa mankibayhi, fasaqata maghshiyyan 'alayhi, famaa ru'iya ba'da dhalika 'uryaanan salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam‏.‏

haddathanaa ahmadu ibnu yoonusa, qaala haddathanaa zuhayrun, qaala haddathanaa ismaa'eelu, qaala sami'tu qaysan, qaala akhbaranee aboo mas'oodin, anna rajulan, qaala wal-lahi yaa rasoola Allah innee l'ata'akhkharu 'an salati al-ghadaati min ajli fulanin mimmaa yuteelu binaa‏.‏ famaa ra'aytu rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam fee maw'izatin ashadda ghadaban minhu yawma'idhin thumma qaala ‏ "‏ inna minkum munaffireena, fa'ayyukum maa salla bin-naasi falyatajawwaz, fa'inna feehimu ad-da'eefa wal-kabeera wadhaa al-haajati ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa 'abdu Allah ibnu yoosufa, qaala akhbaranaa maalikun, 'an abee az-zinaadi, 'ani al-a'raji, 'an abee hurayrata, anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ idhaa salla ahadukum lilnnaasi falyukhaffif, fa'inna minhumu ad-da'eefa was-saqeema wal-kabeera, wa'idhaa salla ahadukum linafsihi falyutawwil maa shaa'a ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu yoosufa, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an ismaa'eela ibni abee khaalidin, 'an qaysi ibni abee haazimin, 'an abee mas'oodin, qaala qaala rajulun yaa rasoola Allah innee l'ata'akhkharu 'ani as-salati fee al-fajri mimmaa yuteelu binaa fulanun feehaa‏.‏ faghadiba rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam maa ra'aytuhu ghadiba fee mawdi'in kaana ashadda ghadaban minhu yawma'idhin thumma qaala ‏ "‏ yaa ayyuhaa an-naasu inna minkum munaffireena, faman amma an-naasa falyatajawwaz, fa'inna khalfahu ad-da'eefa wal-kabeera wadhaa al-haajati ‏"‏‏.‏
haddathanaa aboo ma'marin, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu al-waarithi, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu al-'azeezi, 'an anasin, qaala kaana an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam yoojizu as-salata wayukmiluhaa‏.‏

haddathanaa ibraaheemu ibnu moosaa, qaala akhbaranaa al-waleedu, qaala haddathanaa al-awzaa'iyyu, 'an yahyaa ibni abee katheerin, 'an 'abdi Allah ibni abee qataadata, 'an abeehi abee qataadata, 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ innee l'aqoomu fee as-salati ureedu an utawwila feehaa, fa'asma'u bukaa'a as-sabiyyi, fa'atajawwazu fee salatee karaahiyata an ashuqqa 'alaa ummihi ‏"‏‏.‏ taaba'ahu bishru ibnu bakrin waabnu al-mubaaraki wabaqiyyatu 'ani al-awzaa'iyyi‏.‏

haddathanaa khaalidu ibnu makhladin, qaala haddathanaa sulaymaanu ibnu bilalin, qaala haddathanaa shareeku ibnu 'abdi Allah, qaala sami'tu anasa ibna maalikin, yaqoolu maa sallaytu waraa'a imaamin qattu akhaffa salatan wala atamma mina an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam, wa'in kaana layasma'u bukaa'a as-sabiyyi fayukhaffifu makhaafata an tuftana ummuhu‏.‏

haddathanaa 'aliyyu ibnu 'abdi Allah, qaala haddathanaa yazeedu ibnu zuray'in, qaala haddathanaa sa'eedun, qaala haddathanaa qataadatu, anna anasa ibna maalikin, haddathahu anna an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ innee l'adkhulu fee as-salati wa'anaa ureedu itaalatahaa, fa'asma'u bukaa'a as-sabiyyi, fa'atajawwazu fee salatee mimmaa a'lamu min shiddati wajdi ummihi min bukaa'ihi ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu bashshaarin, qaala haddathanaa ibnu abee 'adiyyin, 'an sa'eedin, 'an qataadata, 'an anasi ibni maalikin, 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ innee l'adkhulu fee as-salati fa'ureedu itaalatahaa, fa'asma'u bukaa'a as-sabiyyi, fa'atajawwazu mimmaa a'lamu min shiddati wajdi ummihi min bukaa'ihi ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala moosaa haddathanaa abaanu, haddathanaa qataadatu, haddathanaa anasun, 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam mithlahu‏.‏

haddathanaa sulaymaanu ibnu harbin, wa'aboo an-nu'maani, qaala haddathanaa hammaadu ibnu zaydin, 'an ayyooba, 'an 'amriw ibni deenaarin, 'an jaabirin, qaala kaana mu'aadhun yusallee ma'a an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam thumma ya'atee qawmahu fayusallee bihim‏.‏

haddathanaa 'abdu Allah ibnu maslamata, 'an maaliki ibni anasin, 'an ayyooba ibni abee tameemata as-sakhtiyaaniyyi, 'an muhammadi ibni seereena, 'an abee hurayrata, anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam insarafa mina ithnatayni, faqaala lahu dhoo al-yadayni aqasurati as-salatu am naseeta yaa rasoola Allah faqaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ asadaqa dhoo al-yadayni ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala an-naasu na'am‏.‏ faqaama rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam fasallaa ithnatayni ukhrayayni thumma sallama, thumma kabbara fasajada mithla sujoodihi aw atwala‏.‏

haddathanaa aboo al-waleedi, qaala haddathanaa shu'batu, 'an sa'di ibni ibraaheema, 'an abee salamata, 'an abee hurayrata, qaala salla an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam az-zuhra rak'atayni, faqeela sallayta rak'atayni‏.‏ fasallaa rak'atayni, thumma sallama thumma sajada sajdatayni‏.‏

haddathanaa aboo al-waleedi, hishaamu ibnu 'abdi al-maliki qaala haddathanaa shu'batu, qaala akhbaranee 'amroo ibnu murrata, qaala sami'tu saalima ibna abee al-ja'di, qaala sami'tu an-nu'maana ibna basheerin, yaqoolu qaala an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ latusawwunna sufoofakum aw layukhaalifanna Allah bayna wujoohikum ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa aboo ma'marin, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu al-waarithi, 'an 'abdi al-'azeezi, 'an anasin, anna an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ aqeemoo as-sufoofa fa'innee araakum khalfa zahree ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu yoosufa, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an sa'di ibni ibraaheema, 'an 'abdi ar-rahmani, 'an abee hurayrata radiya Allah 'anhu qaala kaana an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam yaqra'u fee al-jumu'ati fee salati al-fajri ‏{‏al-m * tanzeelu‏}‏ as-sajdata wa‏{‏hal ataa 'alaa al-insaani‏}‏

haddathanaa sulaymaanu ibnu harbin, wa'aboo an-nu'maani, qaala haddathanaa hammaadun, 'an ayyooba, 'an 'ikrimata, 'ani ibni 'abbaasin radiya Allah 'anhuma qaala ‏{‏s‏}‏ laysa min 'azaa'imi as-sujoodi, waqad ra'aytu an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam yasjudu feehaa‏.‏

haddathanaa hafsu ibnu 'umara, qaala haddathanaa shu'batu, 'an abee ishaaqa, 'ani al-aswadi, 'an 'abdi Allah radiya Allah 'anhu anna an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qara'a soorata an-najmi fasajada bihaa, famaa baqiya ahadun mina al-qawmi ila sajada, fa'akhadha rajulun mina al-qawmi kaffan min hasana aw turaabin, farafa'ahu ilaa wajhihi waqaala yakfeenee hadhaa, falaqad ra'aytuhu ba'du qutila kaafiran‏.‏

haddathanaa musaddadun, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu al-waarithi, qaala haddathanaa ayyoobu, 'an 'ikrimata, 'ani ibni 'abbaasin radiya Allah 'anhuma anna an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam sajada bin-najmi wasajada ma'ahu al-muslimoona wal-mushrikoona wal-jinnu wal-insu‏.‏ warawaahu ibnu tahmaana 'an ayyooba‏.‏

haddathanaa sulaymaanu ibnu daawuda aboo ar-rabee'i, qaala haddathanaa ismaa'eelu ibnu ja'farin, qaala akhbaranaa yazeedu ibnu khusayfata, 'ani ibni qusaytin, 'an 'ataa'i ibni yasaarin, annahu akhbarahu, annahu, sa'ala zayda ibna thaabitin radiya Allah 'anhu faza'ama annahu qara'a 'alaa an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏{‏wan-najmi‏}‏ falam yasjud feehaa‏.‏

haddathanaa 'aadamu ibnu abee iyaasin, qaala haddathanaa ibnu abee dhi'bin, qaala haddathanaa yazeedu ibnu 'abdi Allah ibni qusaytin, 'an 'ataa'i ibni yasaarin, 'an zaydi ibni thaabitin, qaala qara'atu 'alaa an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏{‏wan-najmi‏}‏ falam yasjud feehaa‏.‏

haddathanaa muslimun, wamu'aadhu ibnu fadaalata, qaala akhbaranaa hishaamun, 'an yahyaa, 'an abee salamata, qaala ra'aytu abaa hurayrata radiya Allah 'anhu qara'a ‏{‏idhaa as-samaa'u inshaqqat‏}‏ fasajada bihaa faqultu yaa abaa hurayrata, alam araka tasjudu qaala law lam ara an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam yasjudu lam asjud‏.‏

haddathanaa musaddadun, qaala haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an 'ubaydi Allah, qaala haddathanee naafi'un, 'ani ibni 'umara radiya Allah 'anhuma qaala kaana an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam yaqra'u 'alaynaa as-soorata feehaa as-sajdatu, fayasjudu wanasjudu, hattaa maa yajidu ahadunaa mawdi'a jabhatihi‏.‏

haddathanaa bishru ibnu 'aadama, qaala haddathanaa 'aliyyu ibnu mushirin, qaala akhbaranaa 'ubaydu Allah, 'an naafi'in, 'ani ibni 'umara, qaala kaana an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam yaqra'u as-sajdata wanahnu 'indahu fayasjudu wanasjudu ma'ahu fanazdahimu hattaa maa yajidu ahadunaa lijabhatihi mawdi'an yasjudu 'alayhi‏.‏

haddathanaa musaddadun, qaala haddathanaa mu'tamirun, qaala sami'tu abee qaala, haddathanee bakrun, 'an abee raafi'in, qaala sallaytu ma'a abee hurayrata al-'atamata faqara'a ‏{‏idhaa as-samaa'u inshaqqat‏}‏ fasajada faqultu maa hadhihi qaala sajadtu bihaa khalfa abee al-qaasimi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam fala azaalu asjudu feehaa hattaa alqaahu‏.‏

haddathanaa sadaqatu, qaala akhbaranaa yahyaa, 'an 'ubaydi Allah, 'an naafi'in, 'ani ibni 'umara radiya Allah 'anhuma qaala kaana an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam yaqra'u as-soorata allatee feehaa as-sajdatu fayasjudu wanasjudu hattaa maa yajidu ahadunaa makaanan limawdi'i jabhatihi‏.‏

haddathanaa moosaa ibnu ismaa'eela, qaala haddathanaa aboo 'awaanata, 'an 'aasimin, wahusaynin, 'an 'ikrimata, 'ani ibni 'abbaasin radiya Allah 'anhuma qaala aqaama an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam tis'ata 'ashara yaqsuru, fanahnu idhaa saafarnaa tis'ata 'ashara qasarnaa, wa'in zidnaa atmamnaa‏.‏

haddathanaa aboo ma'marin, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu al-waarithi, qaala haddathanaa yahyaa ibnu abee ishaaqa, qaala sami'tu anasan, yaqoolu kharajnaa ma'a an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam mina al-madeenati ilaa makkata, fakaana yusallee rak'atayni rak'atayni hattaa raja'naa ilaa al-madeenati‏.‏ qultu aqamtum bimakkata shay'an qaala aqamnaa bihaa 'ashran‏.‏

haddathanaa 'abdu Allah ibnu maslamata, 'an maalikin, 'ani ibni shihaabin, 'an abee salamata, wa'abee 'abdi Allah al-agharri, 'an abee hurayrata radiya Allah 'anhu anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ yanzilu rabbunaa tabaaraka wata'aalaa kulla laylatin ilaa as-samaa'i ad-dunyaa heena yabqaa thuluthu al-layli al-'aakhiru yaqoolu man yad'oonee fa'astajeeba lahu man yas'alunee fa'u'tiyahu man yastaghfirunee fa'aghfira lahu ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu bashshaarin, haddathanaa ghundarun, haddathanaa shu'batu, 'an thaabitin, qaala sami'tu anasan radiya Allah 'anhu 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ as-sabru 'inda as-sadmati al-oolaa ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu al-muthannaa, haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an ismaa'eela, qaala haddathanee qaysun, 'ani ibni mas'oodin radiya Allah 'anhu qaala sami'tu an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam yaqoolu ‏ "‏ la hasada ila fee ithnatayni rajulun 'aataahu Allah maalan fasallatahu 'alaa halakatihi fee al-haqqi, warajulun 'aataahu Allah hikmatan fahwa yaqdee bihaa wayu'allimuhaa ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa sulaymaanu ibnu harbin, haddathanaa shu'batu, 'an abee ishaaqa, qaala sami'tu 'abda Allah ibna ma'qilin, qaala sami'tu 'adiyya ibna haatimin radiya Allah 'anhu qaala sami'tu rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam yaqoolu ‏ "‏ attaqoo an-naara walaw bishiqqi tamratin ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an 'ubaydi Allah, qaala haddathanee khubaybu ibnu 'abdi ar-rahmani, 'an hafsi ibni 'aasimin, 'an abee hurayrata radiya Allah 'anhu 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ sab'atun yuzilluhumu Allah ta'aalaa fee zillihi yawma la zilla ila zilluhu imaamun 'adlun, washaabbun nasha'a fee 'ibaadati Allah, warajulun qalbuhu mu'allaqun fee al-masaajidi, warajulani tahaabbaa fee Allah ijtama'aa 'alayhi watafarraqaa 'alayhi, warajulun da'athu imra'atun dhaatu mansibin wajamaalin faqaala innee akhaafu Allah, warajulun tasaddaqa bisadaqatin fa'akhfaahaa hattaa la ta'lama shimaaluhu maa tunfiqu yameenuhu, warajulun dhakara Allah khaaliyan fafaadat 'aynaahu ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa aboo an-nu'maani, qaala haddathanaa hammaadu ibnu zaydin, 'an ayyooba, 'an naafi'in, 'ani ibni 'umara radiya Allah 'anhuma qaala sami'tu an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam (h)‏.‏ wahaddathanaa 'abdu Allah ibnu maslamata, 'an maalikin, 'an naafi'in, 'an 'abdi Allah ibni 'umara radiya Allah 'anhuma anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala wahuwa 'alaa al-minbari, wadhakara as-sadaqata wat-ta'affufa wal-mas'alata ‏ "‏ al-yadu al-'ulyaa khayrun mina al-yadi as-suflaa, fal-yadu al-'ulyaa hiya al-munfiqatu, was-suflaa hiya as-saa'ilatu ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa 'abdu Allah ibnu muhammadin, haddathanaa hishaamun, haddathanaa ma'marun, 'ani az-zuhriyyi, 'an 'urwata, 'an hakeemi ibni hizaamin radiya Allah 'anhu qaala qultu yaa rasoola Allah ara'ayta ashyaa'a kuntu atahannathu bihaa fee al-jaahiliyyati min sadaqatin aw 'ataaqatin wasilati rahimin fahal feehaa min ajrin faqaala an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ aslamta 'alaa maa salafa min khayrin ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa qutaybatu ibnu sa'eedin, haddathanaa jareerun, 'ani al-a'mashi, 'an abee waa'ilin, 'an masrooqin, 'an 'aa'ishata radiya Allah 'anha qaalat qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ idhaa tasaddaqati al-mar'atu min ta'aami zawjihaa ghayra mufsidatin kaana lahaa ajruhaa, walizawjihaa bimaa kasaba, walilkhaazini mithlu dhalika ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu al-'ala'i, haddathanaa aboo usaamata, 'an buraydi ibni 'abdi Allah, 'an abee burdata, 'an abee moosaa, 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ al-khaazinu al-muslimu al-ameenu alladhee yunfidhu warubbamaa qaala yu'tee maa umira bihi kaamilan muwaffaran tayyibun bihi nafsuhu, fayadfa'uhu ilaa alladhee umira lahu bihi, ahadu al-mutasaddiqayni ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa 'aadamu, haddathanaa shu'batu, haddathanaa mansoorun, wal-a'mashu, 'an abee waa'ilin, 'an masrooqin, 'an 'aa'ishata radiya Allah 'anha 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ta'nee idhaa tasaddaqati al-mar'atu min bayti zawjihaa‏.‏

haddathanaa 'umaru ibnu hafsin, haddathanaa abee, haddathanaa al-a'mashu, 'an shaqeeqin, 'an masrooqin, 'an 'aa'ishata radiya Allah 'anha qaalat qaala an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ idhaa at'amati al-mar'atu min bayti zawjihaa ghayra mufsidatin, lahaa ajruhaa, walahu mithluhu, walilkhaazini mithlu dhalika, lahu bimaa iktasaba, walahaa bimaa anfaqat ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa yahyaa ibnu yahyaa, akhbaranaa jareerun, 'an mansoorin, 'an shaqeeqin, 'an masrooqin, 'an 'aa'ishata radiya Allah 'anha 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ idhaa anfaqati al-mar'atu min ta'aami baytihaa ghayra mufsidatin falahaa ajruhaa, walilzzawji bimaa iktasaba, walilkhaazini mithlu dhalika ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa ismaa'eelu, qaala haddathanee akhee, 'an sulaymaana, 'an mu'aawiyata ibni abee muzarridin, 'an abee al-hubaabi, 'an abee hurayrata radiya Allah 'anhu anna an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ maa min yawmin yusbihu al-'ibaadu feehi ila malakaani yanzilani fayaqoolu ahaduhumaa al-lahumma a'ti munfiqan khalafan, wayaqoolu al-'aakharu al-lahumma a'ti mumsikan talafan ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa ahmadu ibnu yoonusa, haddathanaa aboo shihaabin, 'an khaalidin al-hadhdhaa'i, 'an hafsata binti seereena, 'an ummi 'atiyyata radiya Allah 'anha qaalat bu'itha ilaa nusaybata al-ansaariyyati bishaatin fa'arsalat ilaa 'aa'ishata radiya Allah 'anha minhaa faqaala an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏"‏ 'indakum shaa'un ‏"‏‏.‏ faqultu la ila maa arsalat bihi nusaybatu min tilka ash-shaati faqaala ‏"‏ haati faqad balaghat mahillahaa ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa 'abdu Allah ibnu yoosufa, akhbaranaa maalikun, 'an 'amriw ibni yahyaa al-maaziniyyi, 'an abeehi, qaala sami'tu abaa sa'eedin al-khudriyya, qaala qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ laysa feemaa doona khamsi dhawdin sadaqatun mina al-ibili, walaysa feemaa doona khamsi awaaqin sadaqatun, walaysa feemaa doona khamsati awsuqin sadaqatun ‏"‏‏.‏ haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu al-muthannaa, haddathanaa 'abdu al-wahhaabi, qaala haddathanee yahyaa ibnu sa'eedin, qaala akhbaranee 'amrunw, sami'a abaahu, 'an abee sa'eedin radiya Allah 'anhu sami'tu an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam bihadhaa‏.‏

haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu 'abdi Allah, qaala haddathanee abee qaala, haddathanee thumaamatu, anna anasan radiya Allah 'anhu haddathahu anna abaa bakrin radiya Allah 'anhu kataba lahu allatee amara Allah rasoolahu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ waman balaghat sadaqatuhu binta makhaadin walaysat 'indahu wa'indahu bintu laboonin fa'innahaa tuqbalu minhu, wayu'teehi al-musaddiqu 'ishreena dirhaman aw shaatayni, fa'in lam yakun 'indahu bintu makhaadin 'alaa wajhihaa, wa'indahu ibnu laboonin fa'innahu yuqbalu minhu walaysa ma'ahu shaa'un ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa mu'ammalun, haddathanaa ismaa'eelu, 'an ayyooba, 'an 'ataa'i ibni abee rabaahin, qaala qaala ibnu 'abbaasin radiya Allah 'anhuma ashhadu 'alaa rasooli Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam lasallaa qabla al-khutbati, fara'aa annahu lam yusmi'i an-nisaa'a, fa'ataahunna wama'ahu bilalun naashira thawbihi fawa'azahunna, wa'amarahunna an yatasaddaqna, faja'alati al-mar'atu tulqee, wa'ashaara ayyoobu ilaa udhunihi wa'ilaa halqihi‏.‏

haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu 'abdi Allah al-ansaariyyu, qaala haddathanee abee qaala, haddathanee thumaamatu, anna anasan radiya Allah 'anhu haddathahu anna abaa bakrin radiya Allah 'anhu kataba lahu allatee farada rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ wala yujma'u bayna mutafarriqin, wala yufarraqu bayna mujtami'in, khashyata as-sadaqati ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu 'abdi Allah, qaala haddathanee abee qaala, haddathanee thumaamatu, anna anasan, haddathahu anna abaa bakrin radiya Allah 'anhu kataba lahu allatee farada rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ wamaa kaana min khaleetayni fa'innahumaa yataraaja'aani baynahumaa bis-sawiyyati ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu 'abdi ar-raheemi, akhbaranaa aboo badrin, shujaa'u ibnu al-waleedi 'an 'umara ibni muhammadin al-'umariyyi, qaala wahaddatha naafi'un, anna 'abda Allah, wasaaliman, kallamaa 'abda Allah ibna 'umara radiya Allah 'anhuma faqaala kharajnaa ma'a an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam mu'tamireena, fahaala kuffaaru qurayshin doona al-bayti, fanahara rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam budnahu, wahalaqa ra'asahu‏.‏

haddathanaa 'abdu Allah ibnu yoosufa, akhbaranaa maalikun, 'an humaydi ibni qaysin, 'an mujaahidin, 'an 'abdi ar-rahmani ibni abee laylaa, 'an ka'bi ibni 'ujrata radiya Allah 'anhu 'an rasooli Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam annahu qaala ‏"‏ la'allaka 'aadhaaka hawaammuka ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala na'am yaa rasoola Allah‏.‏ faqaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏"‏ ihliq ra'asaka wasum thalathata ayyaamin, aw at'im sittata masaakeena, awi insuk bishaatin ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa aboo nu'aymin, haddathanaa sayfun, qaala haddathanee mujaahidun, qaala sami'tu 'abda ar-rahmani ibna abee laylaa, anna ka'ba ibna 'ujrata, haddathahu qaala waqafa 'alaa rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam bil-hudaybiyati, wara'asee yatahaafatu qamlan faqaala ‏"‏ yu'dheeka hawaammuka ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu na'am‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ faahliq ra'asaka aw qaala ihliq ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala fiyya nazalat hadhihi al-'aayatu ‏{‏faman kaana minkum mareedan aw bihi adhana min ra'asihi‏}‏ ilaa 'aakhirihaa‏.‏ faqaala an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏"‏ sum thalathata ayyaamin, aw tasaddaq bifaraqin bayna sittatin, awi insuk bimaa tayassara ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa aboo al-waleedi, haddathanaa shu'batu, 'an 'abdi ar-rahmani ibni al-asbihaaniyyi, 'an 'abdi Allah ibni ma'qilin, qaala jalastu ilaa ka'bi ibni 'ujrata radiya Allah 'anhu fasa'altuhu 'ani al-fidyati, faqaala nazalat fiyya khaassatan, waha lakum 'aammatan, humiltu ilaa rasooli Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam wal-qamlu yatanaatharu 'alaa wajhee faqaala ‏"‏ maa kuntu uraa al-waja'a balagha bika maa araa aw maa kuntu uraa al-jahda balagha bika maa araa, tajidu shaatan ‏"‏‏.‏ faqultu la‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ fasum thalathata ayyaamin, aw at'im sittata masaakeena, likulli miskeenin nisfa saa'in ‏"‏‏.‏

wa'an muhammadi ibni yoosufa, haddathanaa warqaa'u, 'ani ibni abee najeehin, 'an mujaahidin, akhbaranaa 'abdu ar-rahmani ibnu abee laylaa, 'an ka'bi ibni 'ujrata radiya Allah 'anhu anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ra'aahu, waqamluhu yasqutu 'alaa wajhihi‏.‏ mithlahu‏.‏

haddathanaa sulaymaanu ibnu harbin, haddathanaa shu'batu, 'an mansoorin, 'an abee haazimin, 'an abee hurayrata radiya Allah 'anhu qaala qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ man hajja hadhaa al-bayta, falam yarfuth walam yafsuq, raja'a kamaa waladathu ummuhu ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu yoosufa, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an mansoorin, 'an abee haazimin, 'an abee hurayrata radiya Allah 'anhu qaala qaala an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ man hajja hadhaa al-bayta, falam yarfuth, walam yafsuq, raja'a kayawmi waladathu ummuhu ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa 'abdu Allah ibnu yoosufa, akhbaranaa maalikun, 'ani ibni shihaabin, 'an 'ubaydi Allah ibni 'abdi Allah ibni 'utbata ibni mas'oodin, 'an 'abdi Allah ibni 'abbaasin, 'ani as-sa'bi ibni jaththaamata al-laythiyyi, annahu ahdaa lirasooli Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam himaaran wahshiyyan, wahwa bil-abwaa'i aw biwaddaana faraddahu 'alayhi, falammaa ra'aa maa fee wajhihi qaala ‏ "‏ innaa lam naruddahu 'alayka ila annaa hurumun ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa 'abdu Allah ibnu yoosufa, akhbaranaa maalikun, 'an naafi'in, 'an 'abdi Allah ibni 'umara radiya Allah 'anhuma anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ khamsun mina ad-dawaabbi laysa 'alaa al-muhrimi fee qatlihinna junaahun ‏"‏‏.‏ wa'an 'abdi Allah ibni deenaarin 'an 'abdi Allah ibni 'umara anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala‏.‏

haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa aboo 'awaanata, 'an zaydi ibni jubayrin, qaala sami'tu ibna 'umara radiya Allah 'anhuma yaqoolu haddathatnee ihdaa, niswati an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ yaqtulu al-muhrimu ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa asbaghu, qaala akhbaranee 'abdu Allah ibnu wahbin, 'an yoonusa, 'ani ibni shihaabin, 'an saalimin, qaala qaala 'abdu Allah ibnu 'umara radiya Allah 'anhuma qaalat hafsatu qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ khamsun mina ad-dawaabbi la haraja 'alaa man qatalahunna al-ghuraabu wal-hida'atu wal-fa'aratu wal-'aqrabu wal-kalbu al-'aqooru ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa yahyaa ibnu sulaymaana, qaala haddathanee ibnu wahbin, qaala akhbaranee yoonusu, 'ani ibni shihaabin, 'an 'urwata, 'an 'aa'ishata radiya Allah 'anha anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ khamsun mina ad-dawaabbi kulluhunna faasiqun, yaqtuluhunna fee al-harami al-ghuraabu wal-hida'atu wal-'aqrabu wal-fa'aratu wal-kalbu al-'aqooru ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa 'umaru ibnu hafsi ibni ghiyaathin, haddathanaa abee, haddathanaa al-a'mashu, qaala haddathanee ibraaheemu, 'ani al-aswadi, 'an 'abdi Allah radiya Allah 'anhu qaala baynamaa nahnu ma'a an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam fee ghaarin biminana, idh nazala 'alayhi ‏{‏wal-mursalati‏}‏ wa'innahu layatloohaa, wa'innee l'atalaqqaahaa min feehi, wa'inna faahu laratbun bihaa, idh wathabat 'alaynaa hayyatun faqaala an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏"‏ iqtuloohaa ‏"‏‏.‏ faabtadarnaahaa, fadhahabat, faqaala an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏"‏ wuqiyat sharrakum kamaa wuqeetum sharrahaa ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanee yahyaa ibnu bukayrin, qaala haddathanee al-laythu, 'an 'uqaylin, 'ani ibni shihaabin, qaala akhbaranee ibnu abee anasin, mawlaa at-taymiyyeena anna abaahu, haddathahu annahu, sami'a abaa hurayrata radiya Allah 'anhu yaqoolu qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ idhaa dakhala shahru ramadaana futtihat abwaabu as-samaa'i, waghulliqat abwaabu jahannama, wasulsilati ash-shayaateenu ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa 'aadamu ibnu abee iyaasin, haddathanaa shu'batu, haddathanaa 'abdu al-'azeezi ibnu suhaybin, qaala sami'tu anasa ibna maalikin radiya Allah 'anhu qaala qaala an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ tasahharoo fa'inna fee as-sahoori barakatan ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanee muhammadu ibnu al-muthannaa, haddathanaa ibnu abee 'adiyyin, 'ani ibni 'awnin, 'ani ash-sha'biyyi, sami'tu an-nu'maana ibna basheerin radiya Allah 'anhu sami'tu an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam‏.‏ haddathanaa 'aliyyu ibnu 'abdi Allah, haddathanaa ibnu 'uyaynata, 'an abee farwata, 'ani ash-sha'biyyi, qaala sami'tu an-nu'maana, 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam‏.‏ haddathanaa 'abdu Allah ibnu muhammadin, haddathanaa ibnu 'uyaynata, 'an abee farwata, sami'tu ash-sha'biyya, sami'tu an-nu'maana ibna basheerin radiya Allah 'anhuma 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam‏.‏ haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu katheerin, akhbaranaa sufyaanu, 'an abee farwata, 'ani ash-sha'biyyi, 'ani an-nu'maani ibni basheerin radiya Allah 'anhu qaala qaala an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ al-halalu bayyinun, wal-haraamu bayyinun wabaynahumaa umoorun mushtabihatun, faman taraka maa shubbiha 'alayhi mina al-ithmi kaana limaa istabaana atraka, wamani ijtara'a 'alaa maa yashukku feehi mina al-ithmi awshaka an yuwaaqi'a maa istabaana, wal-ma'aasee himaa Allah, man yarta' hawla al-himaa yooshik an yuwaaqi'ahu ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanee moosaa ibnu ismaa'eela, haddathanaa 'abdu al-waahidi, haddathanaa aboo burdata ibnu 'abdi Allah, qaala sami'tu abaa burdata ibna abee moosaa, 'an abeehi radiya Allah 'anhu qaala qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ mathalu al-jaleesi as-saalihi wal-jaleesi as-saw'i kamathali saahibi al-miski, wakeeri al-haddaadi, la ya'damuka min saahibi al-miski immaa tashtareehi, aw tajidu reehahu, wakeeru al-haddaadi yuhriqu badanaka aw thawbaka aw tajidu minhu reehan khabeethatan ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa 'abdu Allah ibnu yoosufa, akhbaranaa maalikun, 'an naafi'in, 'an 'abdi Allah ibni 'umara radiya Allah 'anhuma anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ la yabee'u ba'dukum 'alaa bay'i ba'din, wala talaqqawu as-sila'a hattaa yuhbata bihaa ilaa as-sooqi ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa moosaa ibnu ismaa'eela, haddathanaa juwayriyatu, 'an naafi'in, 'an 'abdi Allah radiya Allah 'anhu qaala kunnaa natalaqqaa ar-rukbaana fanashtaree minhumu at-ta'aama, fanahaanaa an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam an nabee'ahu hattaa yublagha bihi sooqu at-ta'aami‏.‏ qaala aboo 'abdi Allah hadhaa fee a'laa as-sooqi, yubayyinuhu hadeethu 'ubaydi Allah‏.‏

haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an 'ubaydi Allah, qaala haddathanee naafi'un, 'an 'abdi Allah radiya Allah 'anhu qaala kaanoo yabtaa'oona at-ta'aama fee a'laa as-sooqi fayabee'oonahu fee makaanihim, fanahaahum rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam an yabee'oohu fee makaanihi hattaa yanquloohu‏.‏

haddathanaa 'abdu Allah ibnu yoosufa, akhbaranaa maalikun, 'an naafi'in, 'an 'abdi Allah ibni 'umara radiya Allah 'anhuma anna 'aa'ishata, umma al-mu'mineena araadat an tashtariya jaariyatan fatu'tiqahaa, faqaala ahluhaa nabee'ukihaa 'alaa anna wala'ahaa lanaa‏.‏ fadhakarat dhalika lirasooli Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam faqaala ‏ "‏ la yamna'uki dhalika, fa'innamaa al-wala'u liman a'taqa ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa aboo al-waleedi, haddathanaa al-laythu, 'ani ibni shihaabin, 'an maaliki ibni awsin, sami'a 'umara radiya Allah 'anhuma 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ al-burru bil-burri riban ila haa'a wahaa'a, wash-sha'eeru bish-sha'eeri riban ila haa'a wahaa'a, wat-tamru bit-tamri riban ila haa'a wahaa'a ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa ismaa'eelu, haddathanaa maalikun, 'an naafi'in, 'an 'abdi Allah ibni 'umara radiya Allah 'anhuma anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam nahaa 'ani al-muzaabanati, wal-muzaabanatu bay'u ath-thamari bit-tamri kaylan, wabay'u az-zabeebi bil-karmi kaylan‏.‏

haddathanaa aboo an-nu'maani, haddathanaa hammaadu ibnu zaydin, 'an ayyooba, 'an naafi'in, 'ani ibni 'umara radiya Allah 'anhuma anna an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam nahaa 'ani al-muzaabanati qaala wal-muzaabanatu an yabee'a ath-thamara bikaylin, in zaada falee wa'in naqasa fa'alaa‏.‏ qaala wahaddathanee zaydu ibnu thaabitin, anna an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam rakhkhasa fee al-'araayaa bikharsihaa‏.‏

haddathanaa sadaqatu ibnu al-fadli, akhbaranaa ismaa'eelu ibnu 'ulayyata, qaala haddathanee yahyaa ibnu abee ishaaqa, haddathanaa 'abdu ar-rahmani ibnu abee bakrata, qaala qaala aboo bakrata radiya Allah 'anhu qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ la tabee'oo adh-dhahaba bidh-dhahabi ila sawaa'an bisawaa'in, wal-fiddata bil-fiddati ila sawaa'an bisawaa'in, wabee'oo adh-dhahaba bil-fiddati wal-fiddata bidh-dhahabi kayfa shi'tum ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa 'ubaydu Allah ibnu sa'din, haddathanaa 'ammee, haddathanaa ibnu akhee az-zuhriyyi, 'an 'ammihi, qaala haddathanee saalimu ibnu 'abdi Allah, 'an 'abdi Allah ibni 'umara radiya Allah 'anhuma anna abaa sa'eedin, haddathahu mithla, dhalika hadeethan 'an rasooli Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam falaqiyahu 'abdu Allah ibnu 'umara faqaala yaa abaa sa'eedin, maa hadhaa alladhee tuhaddithu 'an rasooli Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam faqaala aboo sa'eedin fee as-sarfi sami'tu rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam yaqoolu ‏ "‏ adh-dhahabu bidh-dhahabi mithlan bimithlin wal-wariqu bil-wariqi mithlan bimithlin ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa 'abdu Allah ibnu yoosufa, akhbaranaa maalikun, 'an naafi'in, 'an abee sa'eedin al-khudriyyi radiya Allah 'anhu anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ la tabee'oo adh-dhahaba bidh-dhahabi ila mithlan bimithlin, wala tushiffoo ba'dahaa 'alaa ba'din, wala tabee'oo al-wariqa bil-wariqi ila mithlan bimithlin, wala tushiffoo ba'dahaa 'alaa ba'din, wala tabee'oo minhaa ghaa'iban binaajizin ‏"‏

haddathanaa 'aliyyu ibnu 'abdi Allah, haddathanaa ad-dahhaaku ibnu makhladin, haddathanaa ibnu jurayjin, qaala akhbaranee 'amroo ibnu deenaarin, anna abaa saalihin az-zayyaata, akhbarahu annahu, sami'a abaa sa'eedin al-khudriyya radiya Allah 'anhu yaqoolu ad-deenaaru bid-deenaari, wad-dirhamu bid-dirhami‏.‏ faqultu lahu fa'inna ibna 'abbaasin la yaqooluhu‏.‏ faqaala aboo sa'eedin sa'altuhu faqultu sami'tahu mina an-nabiyyi, salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam, aw wajadtahu fee kitaabi Allah qaala kullu dhalika la aqoolu, wa'antum a'lamu birasooli Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam minnee, walakinnanee akhbaranee usaamatu anna an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ la riban ila fee an-nasee'ati ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa hafsu ibnu 'umara, haddathanaa shu'batu, qaala akhbaranee habeebu ibnu abee thaabitin, qaala sami'tu abaa al-minhaali, qaala sa'altu al-baraa'a ibna 'aazibin wazayda ibna arqama radiya Allah 'anhum 'ani as-sarfi,, fakullu waahidin minhumaa yaqoolu hadhaa khayrun minnee‏.‏ fakilahumaa yaqoolu nahaa rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam 'an bay'i adh-dhahabi bil-wariqi daynan‏.‏

haddathanaa 'imraanu ibnu maysarata, haddathanaa 'abbaadu ibnu al-'awwaami, akhbaranaa yahyaa ibnu abee ishaaqa, haddathanaa 'abdu ar-rahmani ibnu abee bakrata, 'an abeehi radiya Allah 'anhu qaala nahaa an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam 'ani al-fiddati bil-fiddati wadh-dhahabi bidh-dhahabi, ila sawaa'an bisawaa'in, wa'amaranaa an nabtaa'a adh-dhahaba bil-fiddati kayfa shi'naa, wal-fiddata bidh-dhahabi kayfa shi'naa‏.‏

haddathanaa ahmadu ibnu yoonusa, haddathanaa 'abdu al-'azeezi al-maajishoonu, akhbaranaa 'abdu Allah ibnu deenaarin, 'an 'abdi Allah ibni 'umara radiya Allah 'anhuma 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ az-zulmu zulumaatun yawma al-qiyaamati ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa 'abdu Allah, akhbaranaa maalikun, 'an sumaa, 'an abee saalihin, 'an abee hurayrata radiya Allah 'anhu anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ baynamaa rajulun yamshee bitareeqin, wajada ghusna shawkin fa'akhadhahu, fashakara Allah lahu, faghafara lahu ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa ishaaqu ibnu nasrin, haddathanaa aboo usaamata, 'ani al-a'mashi, haddathanaa aboo saalihin, 'an abee hurayrata radiya Allah 'anhu qaala qaala an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ ni'ma maa l'ahadihim yuhsinu 'ibaadata rabbihi wayansahu lisayyidihi ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an 'ubaydi Allah, haddathanee naafi'un, 'an 'abdi Allah radiya Allah 'anhu 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ idhaa nasaha al-'abdu sayyidahu, wa'ahsana 'ibaadata rabbihi, kaana lahu ajruhu marratayni ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu al-'ala'i, haddathanaa aboo usaamata, 'an buraydin, 'an abee burdata, 'an abee moosaa radiya Allah 'anhu 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ al-mamlooku alladhee yuhsinu 'ibaadata rabbihi, wayu'addee ilaa sayyidihi alladhee lahu 'alayhi mina al-haqqi wan-naseehati wat-taa'ati, lahu ajraani ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa muhammadun, haddathanaa 'abdu ar-razzaaqi, akhbaranaa ma'marun, 'an hammaami ibni munabbihin, annahu sami'a abaa hurayrata radiya Allah 'anhu yuhaddithu 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam annahu qaala ‏ "‏ la yaqul ahadukum at'im rabbaka, waddi' rabbaka, isqi rabbaka‏.‏ walyaqul sayyidee mawlaa‏.‏ wala yaqul ahadukum 'abdee amatee‏.‏ walyaqul fataaa wafataatee waghulamee ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa aboo an-nu'maani, haddathanaa jareeru ibnu haazimin, 'an naafi'in, 'ani ibni 'umara radiya Allah 'anhuma qaala qaala an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ man a'taqa naseeban lahu mina al-'abdi, fakaana lahu mina al-maali maa yablughu qeematahu, yuqawwamu 'alayhi qeemata 'adlin, wa'u'tiqa min maalihi, wa'ila faqad 'ataqa minhu ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an 'ubaydi Allah, qaala haddathanee naafi'un, 'an 'abdi Allah radiya Allah 'anhu anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ kullukum raa'in famas'oolun 'an ra'iyyatihi, fal-ameeru alladhee 'alaa an-naasi raa'in wahwa mas'oolun 'anhum, war-rajulu raa'in 'alaa ahli baytihi wahwa mas'oolun 'anhum, wal-mar'atu raa'iyatun 'alaa bayti ba'lihaa wawaladihi waha mas'oolatun 'anhum, wal-'abdu raa'in 'alaa maali sayyidihi wahwa mas'oolun 'anhu, ala fakullukum raa'in wakullukum mas'oolun 'an ra'iyyatihi ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa maaliku ibnu ismaa'eela, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'ani az-zuhriyyi, haddathanee 'ubaydu Allah, sami'tu abaa hurayrata, wazayda ibna khaalidin, radiya Allah 'anhuma 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ idhaa zanati al-amatu faajlidoohaa, thumma idhaa zanat faajlidoohaa, thumma idhaa zanat faajlidoohaa, fee ath-thaalithati awi ar-raabi'ati bee'oohaa walaw bidafeerin ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa hajjaaju ibnu minhaalin, haddathanaa shu'batu, qaala akhbaranee muhammadu ibnu ziyaadin, sami'tu abaa hurayrata radiya Allah 'anhu 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ idhaa ataa ahadakum khaadimuhu bita'aamihi, fa'in lam yujlishu ma'ahu, falyunaawilhu luqmatan aw luqmatayni aw uklatan aw uklatayni, fa'innahu waliya 'ilajahu ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu 'ubaydi Allah, haddathanaa ibnu wahbin, qaala haddathanee maaliku ibnu anasin, qaala wa'akhbaranee ibnu fulanin, 'an sa'eedin al-maqburiyyi, 'an abeehi, 'an abee hurayrata radiya Allah 'anhu 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam wahaddathanaa 'abdu Allah ibnu muhammadin, haddathanaa 'abdu ar-razzaaqi, akhbaranaa ma'marun, 'an hammaamin, 'an abee hurayrata radiya Allah 'anhu 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ idhaa qaatala ahadukum falyajtanibi al-wajha ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa 'abdu Allah ibnu yoosufa, akhbaranaa maalikun, 'an naafi'in, 'an 'abdi Allah ibni 'umara radiya Allah 'anhuma qaala araadat 'aa'ishatu ummu al-mu'mineena an tashtariya jaariyatan litu'tiqahaa, faqaala ahluhaa 'alaa anna wala'ahaa lanaa‏.‏ qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ la yamna'uki dhaliki, fa'innamaa al-wala'u liman a'taqa ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa 'abdu Allah ibnu yoosufa, akhbaranaa maalikun, 'an yahyaa ibni sa'eedin, 'an 'amrata binti 'abdi ar-rahmani, anna bareerata, jaa'at tasta'eenu 'aa'ishata umma al-mu'mineena radiya Allah 'anha faqaalat lahaa in ahabba ahluki an asubba lahum thamanaki sabbatan waahidatan fa'u'tiqaki fa'altu‏.‏ fadhakarat bareeratu dhalika l'ahlihaa, faqaaloo la‏.‏ ila an yakoona wala'uki lanaa‏.‏ qaala maalikun qaala yahyaa faza'amat 'amratu anna 'aa'ishata dhakarat dhalika lirasooli Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam faqaala ‏ "‏ ishtareehaa wa'a'tiqeehaa, fa'innamaa al-wala'u liman a'taqa ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa 'aasimu ibnu 'aliyyin, haddathanaa ibnu abee dhi'bin, 'ani al-maqburiyyi, ‏{‏'an abeehi,‏}‏ 'an abee hurayrata radiya Allah 'anhu 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ yaa nisaa'a al-muslimaati la tahqiranna jaaratun lijaaratihaa, walaw firsina shaatin ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa 'abdu al-'azeezi ibnu 'abdi Allah al-uwaysiyyu, haddathanaa ibnu abee haazimin, 'an abeehi, 'an yazeeda ibni roomaana, 'an 'urwata, 'an 'aa'ishata radiya Allah 'anha annahaa qaalat li'urwata ibna ukhtee, in kunnaa lananzuru ilaa al-hilali thumma al-hilali, thalathata ahillatin fee shahrayni, wamaa ooqidat fee abyaati rasooli Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam naarun‏.‏ faqultu yaa khaalatu maa kaana yu'eeshukum qaalati al-aswadaani at-tamru wal-maa'u, ila annahu qad kaana lirasooli Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam jeeraanun mina al-ansaari kaanat lahum manaa'ihu, wakaanoo yamnahoona rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam min albaanihim, fayasqeenaa‏.‏

haddathanaa aboo al-yamaani, akhbaranaa shu'aybun, haddathanaa aboo az-zinaadi, 'ani al-a'raji, 'an abee hurayrata radiya Allah 'anhu anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ inna lillah tis'atan watis'eena ismaa mi'atan ila waahidan man ahsaahaa dakhala al-jannata ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa sulaymaanu ibnu daawuda aboo ar-rabee'i, haddathanaa ismaa'eelu ibnu ja'farin, haddathanaa naafi'u ibnu maaliki ibni abee 'aamirin aboo suhaylin, 'an abeehi, 'an abee hurayrata radiya Allah 'anhu 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ 'aayatu al-munaafiqi thalathun, idhaa haddatha kadhaba, wa'idhaa i'tumina khaana, wa'idhaa wa'ada akhlafa ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa 'aliyyu ibnu al-ja'di, akhbaranaa shu'batu, 'an qataadata, qaala sami'tu anasan radiya Allah 'anhu yaqoolu lammaa araada an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam an yaktuba ilaa ar-roomi, qeela lahu innahum la yaqra'oona kitaaban ila an yakoona makhtooman‏.‏ faattakhadha khaataman min fiddatin, faka'annee anzuru ilaa bayaadihi fee yadihi, wanaqasha feehi muhammadun rasoolu Allah‏.‏

haddathanaa 'abdu Allah ibnu yoosufa, haddathanaa al-laythu, qaala haddathanee 'uqaylun, 'ani ibni shihaabin, qaala akhbaranee 'ubaydu Allah ibnu 'abdi Allah ibni 'utbata, anna 'abda Allah ibna 'abbaasin, akhbarahu anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ba'atha bikitaabihi ilaa kisraa, fa'amarahu an yadfa'ahu ilaa 'azeemi al-bahrayni, yadfa'uhu 'azeemu al-bahrayni ilaa kisraa, falammaa qara'ahu kisraa kharraqahu, fahasibtu anna sa'eeda ibna al-musayyabi qaala fada'aa 'alayhimu an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam an yumazzaqoo kulla mumazzaqin‏.‏

haddathanaa 'abdu Allah ibnu muhammadin, haddathanaa mu'aawiyatu ibnu 'amrinw, haddathanaa aboo ishaaqa, 'an humaydin, qaala sami'tu anasan radiya Allah 'anhu yaqoolu kaana rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam idhaa ghazaa qawman lam yughir hattaa yusbiha, fa'in sami'a adhaanan amsaka, wa'in lam yasma' adhaanan aghaara ba'da maa yusbihu, fanazalnaa khaybara laylan‏.‏

haddathanaa 'abdu Allah ibnu maslamata, 'an maalikin, 'an humaydin, 'an anasin radiya Allah 'anhu anna an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam kharaja ilaa khaybara fajaa'ahaa laylan, wakaana idhaa jaa'a qawman bilaylin la yugheeru 'alayhim hattaa yusbiha, falammaa asbaha, kharajat yahoodu bimasaaheehim wamakaatilihim, falammaa ra'awhu qaaloo muhammadun wal-lahi, muhammadun wal-khameesu‏.‏ faqaala an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ Allah akbaru, kharibat khaybaru, innaa idhaa nazalnaa bisaahati qawmin fasaa'a sabaahu al-mundhareena ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa aboo al-yamaani, akhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani az-zuhriyyi, haddathanaa sa'eedu ibnu al-musayyabi, anna abaa hurayrata radiya Allah 'anhu qaala qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ umirtu an uqaatila an-naasa hattaa yaqooloo la ilaha ila Allah‏.‏ faman qaala la ilaha ila Allah, faqad 'asama minnee nafsahu wamaalahu, ila bihaqqihi, wahisaabuhu 'alaa Allah ‏"‏‏.‏ rawaahu 'umaru waabnu 'umara 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam‏.‏

haddathanaa yahyaa ibnu bukayrin, haddathanaa al-laythu, 'an 'uqaylin, 'ani ibni shihaabin, qaala akhbaranee 'abdu ar-rahmani ibnu 'abdi Allah ibni ka'bi ibni maalikin, anna 'abda Allah ibna ka'bin radiya Allah 'anhu wakaana qaa'ida ka'bin min baneehi qaala sami'tu ka'ba ibna maalikin heena takhallafa 'an rasooli Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam‏.‏ walam yakun rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam yureedu ghazwatan ila warraa bighayrihaa‏.‏

wahaddathanee ahmadu ibnu muhammadin, akhbaranaa 'abdu Allah, akhbaranaa yoonusu, 'ani az-zuhriyyi, qaala akhbaranee 'abdu ar-rahmani ibnu 'abdi Allah ibni ka'bi ibni maalikin, qaala sami'tu ka'ba ibna maalikin radiya Allah 'anhu yaqoolu kaana rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qallamaa yureedu ghazwatan yaghzoohaa ila warraa bighayrihaa, hattaa kaanat ghazwatu tabooka, faghazaahaa rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam fee harrin shadeedin, waastaqbala safaran ba'eedan wamafaazan, waastaqbala ghazwa 'aduwwin katheerin, fajallaa lilmuslimeena amrahum, liyata'ahhaboo uhbata 'aduwwihim, wa'akhbarahum biwajhihi alladhee yureedu‏.‏

wa'an yoonusa, 'ani az-zuhriyyi, qaala akhbaranee 'abdu ar-rahmani ibnu ka'bi ibni maalikin, anna ka'ba ibna maalikin radiya Allah 'anhu kaana yaqoolu laqallamaa kaana rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam yakhruju idhaa kharaja fee safarin ila yawma al-khameesi‏.‏

haddathanee 'abdu Allah ibnu muhammadin, haddathanaa hishaamun, akhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani az-zuhriyyi, 'an 'abdi ar-rahmani ibni ka'bi ibni maalikin, 'an abeehi radiya Allah 'anhu anna an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam kharaja yawma al-khameesi fee ghazwati tabooka, wakaana yuhibbu an yakhruja yawma al-khameesi‏.‏

haddathanaa sulaymaanu ibnu harbin, haddathanaa hammaadun, 'an ayyooba, 'an abee qilabata, 'an anasin radiya Allah 'anhu anna an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam salla bil-madeenati az-zuhra arba'an, wal-'asra bidhee al-hulayfati rak'atayni, wasami'tuhum yasrukhoona bihimaa jamee'an‏.‏

haddathanaa 'abdu Allah ibnu maslamata, 'an maalikin, 'an yahyaa ibni sa'eedin, 'an 'amrata binti 'abdi ar-rahmani, annahaa sami'at 'aa'ishata radiya Allah 'anha taqoolu kharajnaa ma'a rasooli Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam likhamsi layaalin baqeena min dhee al-qa'dati, wala nuraa ila al-hajja, falammaa danawnaa min makkata amara rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam man lam yakun ma'ahu hada idhaa taafa bil-bayti wasa'aa bayna as-safaa wal-marwati an yahilla‏.‏ qaalat 'aa'ishatu fadukhila 'alaynaa yawma an-nahri bilahmi baqarin faqultu maa hadhaa faqaala nahara rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam 'an azwaajihi‏.‏ qaala yahyaa fadhakartu hadhaa al-hadeetha lilqaasimi ibni muhammadin faqaala atatka wal-lahi bil-hadeethi 'alaa wajhihi‏.‏

haddathanaa 'aliyyu ibnu 'abdi Allah, haddathanaa sufyaanu, qaala haddathanee az-zuhriyyu, 'an 'ubaydi Allah, 'ani ibni 'abbaasin radiya Allah 'anhuma qaala kharaja an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam fee ramadaana, fasaama hattaa balagha al-kadeeda aftara‏.‏ qaala sufyaanu qaala az-zuhriyyu akhbaranee 'ubaydu Allah 'ani ibni 'abbaasin‏.‏ wasaaqa al-hadeetha‏.‏

waqaala ibnu wahbin akhbaranee 'amrunw, 'an bukayrin, 'an sulaymaana ibni yasaarin, 'an abee hurayrata radiya Allah 'anhu annahu qaala ba'athanaa rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam fee ba'thin, waqaala lanaa ‏"‏ in laqeetum fulanan wafulanan ‏"‏‏.‏ lirajulayni min qurayshin sammaahumaa faharriqoohumaa bin-naari‏.‏ qaala thumma ataynaahu nuwaddi'uhu heena aradnaa al-khurooja faqaala ‏"‏ innee kuntu amartukum an tuharriqoo fulanan wafulanan bin-naari, wa'inna an-naara la yu'adhdhibu bihaa ila Allah, fa'in akhadhtumoohumaa faaqtuloohumaa ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa aboo kuraybin, wamoosaa ibnu hizaamin, qaala haddathanaa husaynu ibnu 'aliyyin, 'an zaa'idata, 'an maysarata al-ashja'iyyi, 'an abee haazimin, 'an abee hurayrata radiya Allah 'anhu qaala qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ istawsoo bin-nisaa'i, fa'inna al-mar'ata khuliqat min dila'in, wa'inna a'waja shaa'in fee ad-dila'i a'lahu, fa'in dhahabta tuqeemuhu kasartahu, wa'in taraktahu lam yazal a'waja, faastawsoo bin-nisaa'i ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa aboo an-nu'maani, haddathanaa hammaadu ibnu zaydin, 'an 'ubaydi Allah ibni abee bakri ibni anasin, 'an anasi ibni maalikin radiya Allah 'anhu 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ inna Allah wakkala fee ar-rahimi malakan fayaqoolu yaa rabbi nutfatun, yaa rabbi 'alaqatun, yaa rabbi mudghatun, fa'idhaa araada an yakhluqahaa qaala yaa rabbi, adhakarun am yaa rabbi unthaa yaa rabbi shaqiyyun am sa'eedun famaa ar-rizqu famaa al-ajalu fayuktabu kadhalika fee batni ummihi ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa qaysu ibnu hafsin, haddathanaa khaalidu ibnu al-haarithi, haddathanaa shu'batu, 'an abee 'imraana al-jawniyyi, 'an anasin, yarfa'uhu ‏ "‏ anna Allah, yaqoolu l'ahwani ahli an-naari 'adhaaban law anna laka maa fee al-ardi min shaa'in kunta taftadee bihi qaala na'am‏.‏ qaala faqad sa'altuka maa huwa ahwanu min hadhaa wa'anta fee sulbi 'aadama an la tushrika bee‏.‏ fa'abayta ila ash-shirka ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa 'umaru ibnu hafsi ibni ghiyaathin, haddathanaa abee, haddathanaa al-a'mashu, qaala haddathanee 'abdu Allah ibnu murrata, 'an masrooqin, 'an 'abdi Allah radiya Allah 'anhu qaala qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ la tuqtalu nafsun zulman ila kaana 'alaa ibni 'aadama al-awwali kiflun min damihaa, l'annahu awwalu man sanna al-qatla ‏"‏‏.‏

qaala qaala al-laythu 'an yahyaa ibni sa'eedin, 'an 'amrata, 'an 'aa'ishata, radiya Allah 'anha qaalat sami'tu an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam yaqoolu ‏ "‏ al-arwaahu junoodun mujannadatun, famaa ta'aarafa minhaa i'talafa, wamaa tanaakara minhaa ikhtalafa ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala yahyaa ibnu ayyooba haddathanee yahyaa ibnu sa'eedin bihadhaa‏.‏

haddathanaa 'abdaanu, akhbaranaa 'abdu Allah, 'an yoonusa, 'ani az-zuhriyyi, qaala saalimun waqaala ibnu 'umara radiya Allah 'anhuma qaama rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam fee an-naasi fa'athnaa 'alaa Allah bimaa huwa ahluhu, thumma dhakara ad-dajjaala, faqaala ‏ "‏ innee l'undhirukumoohu, wamaa min nabiyyin ila andharahu qawmahu, laqad andhara noohun qawmahu, walakinnee aqoolu lakum feehi qawlan lam yaqulhu nabiyyun liqawmihi, ta'lamoona annahu a'waru, wa'anna Allah laysa bi'a'wara ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa aboo nu'aymin, haddathanaa shaybaanu, 'an yahyaa, 'an abee salamata, sami'tu abaa hurayrata radiya Allah 'anhu qaala qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ ala uhaddithukum hadeethan 'ani ad-dajjaali maa haddatha bihi nabiyyun qawmahu, innahu a'waru, wa'innahu yajee'u ma'ahu bimithaali al-jannati wan-naari, faallatee yaqoolu innahaa al-jannatu‏.‏ hiya an-naaru, wa'innee undhirukum kamaa andhara bihi noohun qawmahu ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa nasru ibnu 'aliyyi ibni nasrin, akhbaranaa aboo ahmada, 'an sufyaana, 'an abee ishaaqa, 'ani al-aswadi ibni yazeeda, 'an 'abdi Allah radiya Allah 'anhu anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qara'a ‏{‏fahal min muddakirin‏}‏ mithla qiraa'ati al-'aammati‏.‏

haddathanee muhammadu ibnu 'ar'arata, haddathanaa shu'batu, 'ani al-hakami, 'an mujaahidin, 'ani ibni 'abbaasin radiya Allah 'anhuma 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ nusirtu bis-sabaa, wa'uhlikat 'aadun bid-daboori ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa khaalidu ibnu yazeeda, haddathanaa israa'eelu, 'an abee ishaaqa, 'ani al-aswadi, qaala sami'tu 'abda Allah, qaala sami'tu an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam yaqra'u ‏{‏fahal min muddakirin ‏}‏‏.‏

haddathanaa yahyaa ibnu bukayrin, haddathanaa al-laythu, 'an 'uqaylin, 'ani ibni shihaabin, 'an 'urwata ibni az-zubayri, anna zaynaba ibnata abee salamata, haddathathu 'an ummi habeebata binti abee sufyaana, 'an zaynaba ibnati jahshin radiya Allah 'anhunna anna an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam dakhala 'alayhaa fazi'an yaqoolu ‏"‏ la ilaha ila Allah, waylun lil'arabi min sharrin qadi iqtaraba futiha al-yawma min radmi ya'ajooja wama'ajooja mithlu hadhihi ‏"‏‏.‏ wahallaqa bi'isba'ihi al-ibhaami waallatee taleehaa‏.‏ qaalat zaynabu ibnatu jahshin faqultu yaa rasoola Allah anahliku wafeenaa as-saalihoona qaala ‏"‏ na'am, idhaa kathura al-khubthu ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa muslimu ibnu ibraaheema, haddathanaa wuhaybun, haddathanaa ibnu taawusin, 'an abeehi, 'an abee hurayrata radiya Allah 'anhu 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ fataha Allah min radmi ya'ajooja wama'ajooja mithla hadhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ wa'aqada biyadihi tis'eena‏.‏

haddathanaa yahyaa ibnu sulaymaana, qaala haddathanee ibnu wahbin, qaala akhbaranee 'amrunw, anna bukayran, haddathahu 'an kuraybin, mawlaa ibni 'abbaasin 'ani ibni 'abbaasin radiya Allah 'anhuma qaala dakhala an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam al-bayta fawajada feehi soorata ibraaheema wasoorata maryama faqaala ‏ "‏ amaa lahum, faqad sami'oo anna al-mala'ikata la tadkhulu baytan feehi sooratun, hadhaa ibraaheemu musawwarun famaa lahu yastaqsimu ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa 'abdu Allah ibnu yoosufa, akhbaranaa maalikun, 'ani ibni shihaabin, 'an 'urwata ibni az-zubayri, 'an 'aa'ishata radiya Allah 'anha annahaa qaalat maa khuyyira rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam bayna amrayni ila akhadha aysarahumaa, maa lam yakun ithman, fa'in kaana ithman kaana ab'ada an-naasi minhu, wamaa intaqama rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam linafsihi, ila an tuntahaka hurmatu Allah fayantaqima lillah bihaa‏.‏

haddathanee al-hasanu ibnu muhammadin, haddathanaa aboo 'abbaadin, yahyaa ibnu 'abbaadin haddathanaa al-maajishoonu, akhbaranaa 'abdu Allah ibnu deenaarin, qaala nazara ibnu 'umara yawman wahwa fee al-masjidi ilaa rajulin yashabu thiyaabahu fee naahiyatin mina al-masjidi faqaala inzur man hadhaa layta hadhaa 'indee‏.‏ qaala lahu insaanun amaa ta'rifu hadhaa yaa abaa 'abdi ar-rahmani hadhaa muhammadu ibnu usaamata, qaala fata'ata'a ibnu 'umara ra'asahu, wanaqara biyadayhi fee al-ardi, thumma qaala law ra'aahu rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam l'ahabbahu‏.‏

haddathanaa moosaa ibnu ismaa'eela, haddathanaa mu'tamirun, qaala sami'tu abee, haddathanaa aboo 'uthmaana, 'an usaamata ibni zaydin radiya Allah 'anhuma haddatha 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam annahu kaana ya'akhudhuhu wal-hasana fayaqoolu ‏ "‏ al-lahumma ahibbahumaa fa'innee uhibbuhumaa ‏"‏‏.‏

waqaala nu'aymun 'ani ibni al-mubaaraki, akhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani az-zuhriyyi, akhbaranee mawlana, l'usaamata ibni zaydin‏.‏ anna al-hajjaaja ibna aymana ibni ummi aymana,, wakaana, aymanu ibnu ummi aymana akhaa usaamata l'ummihi, wahwa rajulun mina al-ansaari, fara'aahu ibnu 'umara lam yutimma rukoo'ahu wala sujoodahu faqaala a'id‏.‏

qaala aboo 'abdi Allah wahaddathanee sulaymaanu ibnu 'abdi ar-rahmani, haddathanaa al-waleedu, haddathanaa 'abdu ar-rahmani ibnu namirin, 'ani az-zuhriyyi, haddathanee harmalatu, mawlaa usaamata ibni zaydin annahu baynamaa huwa ma'a 'abdi Allah ibni 'umara idh dakhala al-hajjaaju ibnu aymana falam yutimma rukoo'ahu wala sujoodahu, faqaala a'id‏.‏ falammaa wallaa qaala lee ibnu 'umara man hadhaa qultu al-hajjaaju ibnu aymana ibni ummi aymana‏.‏ faqaala ibnu 'umara law ra'aa hadhaa rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam l'ahabbahu, fadhakara hubbahu wamaa waladathu ummu aymana‏.‏ qaala wahaddathanee ba'du ashaabee 'an sulaymaana wakaanat haadinata an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam‏.‏

haddathanaa yahyaa ibnu sulaymaana, haddathanaa ibnu wahbin, 'an yoonusa, 'ani az-zuhriyyi, 'an saalimin, 'ani ibni 'umara, 'an ukhtihi, hafsata anna an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala lahaa ‏ "‏ inna 'abda Allah rajulun saalihun ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa 'amroo ibnu 'aliyyin, haddathanaa 'abdu al-a'laa, haddathanaa khaalidun, 'an abee qilabata, qaala haddathanee anasu ibnu maalikin, anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ inna likulli ummatin ameenan, wa'inna ameenanaa ayyatuhaa al-ummatu aboo 'ubaydata ibnu al-jarraahi ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa muslimu ibnu ibraaheema, haddathanaa shu'batu, 'an abee ishaaqa, 'an silata, 'an hudhayfata radiya Allah 'anhu qaala qaala an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam l'ahli najraana ‏ "‏ l'ab'athanna ya'nee 'alaykum ya'nee ameenan haqqa ameenin ‏"‏‏.‏ fa'ashrafa ashaabuhu, faba'atha abaa 'ubaydata radiya Allah 'anhu‏.‏

haddathanaa sadaqatu, haddathanaa ibnu 'uyaynata, haddathanaa aboo moosaa, 'ani al-hasani, sami'a abaa bakrata, sami'tu an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam 'alaa al-minbari wal-hasanu ilaa janbihi, yanzuru ilaa an-naasi marratan wa'ilayhi marratan, wayaqoolu ‏ "‏ ibnee hadhaa sayyidun, wala'alla Allah an yusliha bihi bayna fi'atayni mina al-muslimeena ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa al-mu'tamiru, qaala sami'tu abee qaala, haddathanaa aboo 'uthmaana, 'an usaamata ibni zaydin radiya Allah 'anhuma 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam annahu kaana ya'akhudhuhu wal-hasana wayaqoolu ‏ "‏ al-lahumma innee uhibbuhumaa fa'ahibbahumaa ‏"‏‏.‏ aw kamaa qaala‏.‏

haddathanee muhammadu ibnu al-husayni ibni ibraaheema, qaala haddathanee husaynu ibnu muhammadin, haddathanaa jareerun, 'an muhammadin, 'an anasi ibni maalikin radiya Allah 'anhu utiya 'ubaydu Allah ibnu ziyaadin bira'asi al-husayni 'alayhi as-salamu faju'ila fee tastin, faja'ala yankutu, waqaala fee husnihi shay'an‏.‏ faqaala anasun kaana ashbahahum birasooli Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam, wakaana makhdooban bil-wasmati‏.‏

haddathanaa hajjaaju ibnu al-minhaali, haddathanaa shu'batu, qaala akhbaranee 'adiyyun, qaala sami'tu al-baraa'a radiya Allah 'anhu qaala ra'aytu an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam wal-hasanu 'alaa 'aatiqihi yaqoolu ‏ "‏ al-lahumma innee uhibbuhu fa'ahibbahu ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa 'abdaanu, akhbaranaa 'abdu Allah, qaala akhbaranee 'umaru ibnu sa'eedi ibni abee husaynin, 'ani ibni abee mulaykata, 'an 'uqbata ibni al-haarithi, qaala ra'aytu abaa bakrin radiya Allah 'anhu wahamala al-hasana wahwa yaqoolu bi'abee shabeehun bin-nabiyyi, laysa shabeehun bi'aliyyin‏.‏ wa'aliyyun yadhaku‏.‏

haddathanee 'abdu Allah ibnu muhammadin, qaala amlaa 'alaa hishaamu ibnu yoosufa min hifzihi akhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani az-zuhriyyi, qaala qaala lee al-waleedu ibnu 'abdi al-maliki abalaghaka anna 'aliyyan, kaana feeman qadhafa 'aa'ishata qultu la‏.‏ walakin qad akhbaranee rajulani min qawmiki aboo salamata ibnu 'abdi ar-rahmani wa'aboo bakri ibnu 'abdi ar-rahmani ibni al-haarithi anna 'aa'ishata radiya Allah 'anha qaalat lahumaa kaana 'aliyyun musalliman fee sha'anihaa‏.‏ faraaja'oohu falam yarji' waqaala musalliman bilaa shakkin feehi wa'alayhi kaana fee asli al-'ateeqi kadhalika

haddathanee yahyaa, haddathanaa wakee'un, 'an naafi'i ibni 'umara, 'ani ibni abee mulaykata, 'an 'aa'ishata radiya Allah 'anha kaanat taqra'u ‏{‏idh taliqoonahu bi'alsinatikum‏}‏ wataqoolu al-walqu al-kadhibu‏.‏ qaala ibnu abee mulaykata wakaanat a'lama min ghayrihaa bidhalika l'annahu nazala feehaa‏.‏

haddathanaa 'uthmaanu ibnu abee shaybata, haddathanaa 'abdatu, 'an hishaamin, 'an abeehi, qaala dhahabtu asubbu hassaana 'inda 'aa'ishata faqaalat la tasubbahu, fa'innahu kaana yunaafihu 'an rasooli Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam‏.‏ waqaalat 'aa'ishatu ista'adhana an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam fee hijaa'i al-mushrikeena qaala ‏ "‏ kayfa binasabee ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala l'asullannaka minhum kamaa tusallu ash-sha'ratu mina al-'ajeeni‏.‏ waqaala muhammadun haddathanaa 'uthmaanu ibnu farqadin, sami'tu hishaaman, 'an abeehi, qaala sababtu hassaana, wakaana mimman kaththara 'alayhaa‏.‏

haddathanaa hudbatu ibnu khaalidin, haddathanaa hammaamun, 'an qataadata, anna anasan radiya Allah 'anhu akhbarahu qaala i'tamara rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam arba'a 'umarin kulluhunna fee dhee al-qa'dati, ila allatee kaanat ma'a hajjatihi‏.‏ 'umratan mina al-hudaybiyati fee dhee al-qa'dati, wa'umratan mina al-'aami al-muqbili fee dhee al-qa'dati, wa'umratan mina al-ji'raanati haythu qasama ghanaa'ima hunaynin fee dhee al-qa'dati, wa'umratan ma'a hajjatihi‏.‏

haddathanaa sa'eedu ibnu ar-rabee'i, haddathanaa 'aliyyu ibnu al-mubaaraki, 'an yahyaa, 'an 'abdi Allah ibni abee qataadata, anna abaahu, haddathahu qaala intalaqnaa ma'a an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam 'aama al-hudaybiyati fa'ahrama ashaabuhu, walam uhrim‏.‏

haddathanee fadlu ibnu ya'qooba, haddathanaa al-hasanu ibnu muhammadi ibni a'yana aboo 'aliyyin al-harraaniyyu, haddathanaa zuhayrun, haddathanaa aboo ishaaqa, qaala anba'anaa al-baraa'u ibnu 'aazibin radiya Allah 'anhuma annahum kaanoo ma'a rasooli Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam yawma al-hudaybiyati alfan wa'arba'ami'atin aw akthara, fanazaloo 'alaa bi'rin fanazahoohaa, fa'ataw rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam fa'ataa al-bi'ra, waqa'ada 'alaa shafeerihaa thumma qaala ‏"‏ i'toonee bidalwin min maa'ihaa ‏"‏‏.‏ fa'utiya bihi fabasaqa fada'aa thumma qaala ‏"‏ da'oohaa saa'atan ‏"‏‏.‏ fa'arwaw anfusahum warikaabahum hattaa irtahaloo‏.‏

haddathanaa as-saltu ibnu muhammadin, haddathanaa yazeedu ibnu zuray'in, 'an sa'eedin, 'an qataadata, qultu lisa'eedi ibni al-musayyabi balaghanee anna jaabira ibna 'abdi Allah, kaana yaqoolu kaanoo arba'a 'ashrata mi'atan‏.‏ faqaala lee sa'eedun haddathanee jaabirun kaanoo khamsa 'ashrata mi'atan alladheena baaya'oo an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam yawma al-hudaybiyati‏.‏ taaba'ahu aboo daawuda haddathanaa qurratu 'an qataadata

haddathanaa 'aliyyun, haddathanaa sufyaanu, qaala 'amrunw sami'tu jaabira ibna 'abdi Allah radiya Allah 'anhuma qaala qaala lanaa rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam yawma al-hudaybiyati ‏ "‏ antum khayru ahli al-ardi ‏"‏‏.‏ wakunnaa alfan wa'arba'ami'atin, walaw kuntu ubsiru al-yawma l'araytukum makaana ash-shajarati‏.‏ taaba'ahu al-a'mashu sami'a saaliman sami'a jaabiran alfan wa'arba'ami'atin‏.‏

waqaala 'ubaydu Allah ibnu mu'aadhin haddathanaa abee, haddathanaa shu'batu, 'an 'amriw ibni murrata, haddathanee 'abdu Allah ibnu abee awfaa radiya Allah 'anhuma kaana ashaabu ash-shajarati alfan wathalathami'atin, wakaanat aslamu thumna al-muhaajireena‏.‏ taaba'ahu muhammadu ibnu bashshaarin haddathanaa aboo daawuda haddathanaa shu'batu‏.‏

haddathanaa ibraaheemu ibnu moosaa, akhbaranaa 'eesaa, 'an ismaa'eela, 'an qaysin, annahu sami'a mirdaasan al-aslamiyya, yaqoolu wakaana min ashaabi ash-shajarati yuqbadu as-saalihoona al-awwalu fal-awwalu, watabqaa hufaalatun kahufaalati at-tamri wash-sha'eeri, la ya'ba'u Allah bihim shay'an‏.‏

haddathanaa 'aliyyu ibnu 'abdi Allah, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'ani az-zuhriyyi, 'an 'urwata, 'an marwaana, wal-miswari ibni makhramata, qaala kharaja an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam 'aama al-hudaybiyati fee bid'a 'ashrata mi'atan min ashaabihi, falammaa kaana bidhee al-hulayfati qallada al-hada wa'ash'ara wa'ahrama minhaa‏.‏ la uhsee kam sami'tuhu min sufyaana hattaa sami'tuhu yaqoolu la ahfazu mina az-zuhriyyi al-ish'aara wat-taqleeda, fala adree ya'nee mawdi'a al-ish'aari wat-taqleedi, awi al-hadeetha kullahu‏.‏

haddathanaa al-hasanu ibnu khalafin, qaala haddathanaa ishaaqu ibnu yoosufa, 'an abee bishrin, warqaa'a, 'ani ibni abee najeehin, 'an mujaahidin, qaala haddathanee 'abdu ar-rahmani ibnu abee laylaa, 'an ka'bi ibni 'ujrata, anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ra'aahu waqamluhu yasqutu 'alaa wajhihi faqaala ‏ "‏ ayu'dheeka hawaammuka ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala na'am‏.‏ fa'amarahu rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam an yahliqa wahwa bil-hudaybiyati, lam yubayyin lahum annahum yahilloona bihaa, wahum 'alaa tama'in an yadkhuloo makkata, fa'anzala Allah al-fidyata, fa'amarahu rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam an yut'ima faraqan bayna sittati masaakeena, aw yuhdiya shaatan, aw yasooma thalathata ayyaamin‏.‏

haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu muqaatilin aboo al-hasani, akhbaranaa hajjaajun, 'ani ibni jurayjin, qaala akhbaranee ya'laa, 'an sa'eedi ibni jubayrin, 'ani ibni 'abbaasin radiya Allah 'anhuma ‏{‏in kaana bikum adhana min matarin aw kuntum mardaa‏}‏ qaala 'abdu ar-rahmani ibnu 'awfi kaana jareehan‏.‏

haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu muqaatilin, akhbaranaa 'abdu Allah, akhbaranaa hishaamu ibnu 'urwata, 'an abeehi, 'an 'aa'ishata radiya Allah 'anha ‏{‏wa'ini imra'atun khaafat min ba'lihaa nushoozan aw i'raadan‏}‏‏.‏ qaalati ar-rajulu takoonu 'indahu al-mar'atu laysa bimustakthirin minhaa yureedu an yufaariqahaa fataqoolu aj'aluka min sha'anee fee hillin‏.‏ fanazalat hadhihi al-'aayatu fee dhalika‏.‏

haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an sufyaana, qaala haddathanee al-a'mashu, 'an abee waa'ilin, 'an 'abdi Allah, 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ maa yanbaghee l'ahadin an yaqoola anaa khayrun min yoonusa ibni mattaa ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu sinaanin, haddathanaa fulayhun, haddathanaa hilalun, 'an 'ataa'i ibni yasaarin, 'an abee hurayrata radiya Allah 'anhu 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ man qaala anaa khayrun min yoonusa ibni mattaa faqad kadhaba ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa sulaymaanu ibnu harbin, haddathanaa shu'batu, 'an abee ishaaqa, sami'tu al-baraa'a radiya Allah 'anhu qaala 'aakhiru sooratin nazalat baraa'ata, wa'aakhiru 'aayatin nazalat ‏{‏yastaftoonaka ‏}‏

haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu bashshaarin, haddathanaa 'abdu ar-rahmani, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an qaysin, 'an taariqi ibni shihaabin, qaalati al-yahoodu li'umara innakum taqra'oona 'aayatan law nazalat feenaa lattakhadhnaahaa 'eedan‏.‏ faqaala 'umaru innee l'a'lamu haythu unzilat, wa'ayna unzilat, wa'ayna rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam heena unzilat yawma 'arafata, wa'innaa wal-lahi bi'arafata qaala sufyaanu wa'ashukku kaana yawma al-jumu'ati am la – ‏{‏al-yawma akmaltu lakum deenakum‏}‏

haddathanaa aboo nu'aymin, haddathanaa israa'eelu, 'an mukhaariqin, 'an taariqi ibni shihaabin, sami'tu ibna mas'oodin radiya Allah 'anhu qaala shahidtu mina al-miqdaadi (h) wahaddathanee hamdaanu ibnu 'umara haddathanaa aboo an-nadri haddathanaa al-ashja'iyyu 'an sufyaana 'an mukhaariqin 'an taariqin 'an 'abdi Allah qaala qaala al-miqdaadu yawma badrin yaa rasoola Allah innaa la naqoolu laka kamaa qaalat banoo israa'eela limoosaa ‏{‏faadhhab anta warabbuka faqaatila innaa haa hunaa qaa'idoona‏}‏ walakini imdi wanahnu ma'aka‏.‏ faka'annahu surriya 'an rasooli Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam‏.‏ warawaahu wakee'un 'an sufyaana 'an mukhaariqin 'an taariqin anna al-miqdaada qaala dhalika lilnnabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam‏.‏

haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu yoosufa, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an ismaa'eela, 'ani ash-sha'biyyi, 'an masrooqin, 'an 'aa'ishata radiya Allah 'anha qaalat man haddathaka anna muhammadan salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam katama shay'an mimmaa unzila 'alayhi, faqad kadhaba, wal-lahu yaqoolu ‏{‏yaa ayyuhaa ar-rasoolu balligh maa unzila ilayka‏}‏ al-'aayata‏.‏

haddathanaa 'aliyyu ibnu salamata, haddathanaa maaliku ibnu su'ayrin, haddathanaa hishaamun, 'ani abeehi, 'an 'aa'ishata radiya Allah 'anha unzilat hadhihi al-'aayatu ‏{‏la yu'aakhidhukumu Allah bil-laghwi fee aymaanikum‏}‏ fee qawli ar-rajuli la wal-lahi, wabalaa wal-lahi‏.‏

haddathanaa ahmadu ibnu abee rajaa'in, haddathanaa an-nadru, 'an hishaamin, qaala akhbaranee abee, 'an 'aa'ishata radiya Allah 'anha anna abaahaa, kaana la yahnathu fee yameenin hattaa anzala Allah kaffaarata al-yameeni‏.‏ qaala aboo bakrin la araa yameenan uraa ghayrahaa khayran minhaa, ila qabiltu rukhsata Allah, wafa'altu alladhee huwa khayrun‏.‏

haddathanaa 'amroo ibnu 'awnin, haddathanaa khaalidun, 'an ismaa'eela, 'an qaysin, 'an 'abdi Allah, radiya Allah 'anhu qaala kunnaa naghzoo ma'a an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam walaysa ma'anaa nisaa'un faqulnaa ala nakhtasee fanahaanaa 'an dhalika, farakhkhasa lanaa ba'da dhalika an natazawwaja al-mar'ata bith-thawbi, thumma qara'a ‏{‏yaa ayyuhaa alladheena 'aamanoo la tuharrimoo tayyibaati maa ahalla Allah lakum ‏}‏

haddathanaa ishaaqu ibnu ibraaheema, akhbaranaa muhammadu ibnu bishrin, haddathanaa 'abdu al-'azeezi ibnu 'umara ibni 'abdi al-'azeezi, qaala haddathanee naafi'un, 'ani ibni 'umara radiya Allah 'anhuma qaala nazala tahreemu al-khamri wa'inna fee al-madeenati yawma'idhin lakhamsata ashribatin, maa feehaa sharaabu al-'inabi‏.‏

haddathanaa aboo nu'aymin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an mansoorin, 'an ibraaheema, 'an 'abdi ar-rahmani ibni yazeeda, 'an abee mas'oodin radiya Allah 'anhu qaala qaala an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ man qara'a bil-'aayatayni min 'aakhiri soorati al-baqarati fee laylatin kafataahu‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa 'amroo ibnu khaalidin, haddathanaa zuhayrun, haddathanaa aboo ishaaqa, 'ani al-baraa'i, qaala kaana rajulun yaqra'u soorata al-kahfi wa'ilaa jaanibihi hisaanun marbootun bishatanayni fataghashshathu sahaabatun faja'alat tadnoo watadnoo waja'ala farasuhu yanfiru falammaa asbaha ataa an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam fadhakara dhalika lahu faqaala ‏ "‏ tilka as-sakeenatu tanazzalat bil-qur'aani ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa 'abdu Allah ibnu yoosufa, akhbaranaa maalikun, 'an 'abdi ar-rahmani ibni 'abdi Allah ibni 'abdi ar-rahmani ibni abee sa'sa'ata, 'an abeehi, 'an abee sa'eedin al-khudriyyi, anna rajulan, sami'a rajulan, yaqra'u ‏{‏qul huwa Allah ahadun‏}‏ yuraddiduhaa falammaa asbaha jaa'a ilaa rasooli Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam fadhakara dhalika lahu waka'anna ar-rajula yataqaalluhaa faqaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏"‏ waalladhee nafsee biyadihi innahaa lata'dilu thulutha al-qur'aani ‏"‏‏.‏

wazaada aboo ma'marin haddathanaa ismaa'eelu ibnu ja'farin, 'an maaliki ibni anasin, 'an 'abdi ar-rahmani ibni 'abdi Allah ibni 'abdi ar-rahmani ibni abee sa'sa'ata, 'an abeehi, 'an abee sa'eedin al-khudriyyi, akhbaranee akhee, qataadatu ibnu an-nu'maani anna rajulan, qaama fee zamani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam yaqra'u mina as-sahari ‏{‏qul huwa Allah ahadun‏}‏ la yazeedu 'alayhaa, falammaa asbahnaa ataa rajulun an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam nahwahu‏.‏

haddathanaa 'umaru ibnu hafsin, haddathanaa abee, haddathanaa al-a'mashu, haddathanaa ibraaheemu, wad-dahhaaku al-mashriqiyyu, 'an abee sa'eedin al-khudriyyi, radiya Allah 'anhu qaala qaala an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam l'ashaabihi ‏"‏ aya'jizu ahadukum an yaqra'a thulutha al-qur'aani fee laylatin ‏"‏‏.‏ fashaqqa dhalika 'alayhim waqaaloo ayyunaa yuteequ dhalika yaa rasoola Allah faqaala ‏"‏ Allah al-waahidu as-samadu thuluthu al-qur'aani ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala aboo 'abdi Allah 'an ibraaheema mursalun wa'ani ad-dahhaaki al-mashriqiyyi musnadun‏.‏

haddathanaa 'abdu Allah ibnu yoosufa, akhbaranaa maalikun, 'ani ibni shihaabin, 'an 'urwata, 'an 'aa'ishata, radiya Allah 'anha anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam kaana idhaa ishtakaa yaqra'u 'alaa nafsihi bil-mu'awwidhaati wayanfuthu, falammaa ishtadda waja'uhu kuntu aqra'u 'alayhi wa'amsahu biyadihi rajaa'a barakatihaa‏.‏

haddathanaa qutaybatu ibnu sa'eedin, haddathanaa al-mufaddalu, 'an 'uqaylin, 'ani ibni shihaabin, 'an 'urwata, 'an 'aa'ishata, anna an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam kaana idhaa awaa ilaa firaashihi kulla laylatin jama'a kaffayhi thumma nafatha feehimaa faqara'a feehimaa ‏{‏qul huwa Allah ahadun‏}‏ wa‏{‏qul a'oodhu birabbi al-falaqi‏}‏ wa‏{‏qul a'oodhu birabbi an-naasi‏}‏ thumma yamsahu bihimaa maa istataa'a min jasadihi yabda'u bihimaa 'alaa ra'asihi wawajhihi wamaa aqbala min jasadihi yaf'alu dhalika thalatha marraatin‏.‏

haddathanaa qutaybatu ibnu sa'eedin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'abdi al-'azeezi ibni rufay'in, qaala dakhaltu anaa washaddaadu ibnu ma'qilin, 'alaa ibni 'abbaasin radiya Allah 'anhuma faqaala lahu shaddaadu ibnu ma'qilin ataraka an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam min shaa'in qaala maa taraka ila maa bayna ad-daffatayni‏.‏ qaala wadakhalnaa 'alaa muhammadi ibni al-hanafiyyati fasa'alnaahu faqaala maa taraka ila maa bayna ad-daffatayni‏.‏

haddathanaa hudbatu ibnu khaalidin aboo khaalidin, haddathanaa hammaamun, haddathanaa qataadatu, haddathanaa anasun, 'an abee moosaa, 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ mathalu alladhee yaqra'u al-qur'aana kal-utrujjati ta'muhaa tayyibun wareehuhaa tayyibun waalladhee la yaqra'u al-qur'aana kat-tamrati ta'muhaa tayyibun wala reeha lahaa, wamathalu al-faajiri alladhee yaqra'u al-qur'aana kamathali ar-rayhaanati reehuhaa tayyibun wata'muhaa murrun, wamathalu al-faajiri alladhee la yaqra'u al-qur'aana kamathali al-hanzalati ta'muhaa murrun wala reeha lahaa ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu yoosufa, haddathanaa maaliku ibnu mighwalin, haddathanaa talhatu, qaala sa'altu 'abda Allah ibna abee awfaa awsaa an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam faqaala la‏.‏ faqultu kayfa kutiba 'alaa an-naasi al-wasiyyatu, umiroo bihaa walam yoosi qaala awsaa bikitaabi Allah‏.‏
