haddathanaa yahyaa ibnu bukayrin, qaala haddathanee al-laythu, 'an 'uqaylin, 'ani ibni shihaabin, qaala akhbaranee aboo salamata ibnu 'abdi ar-rahmani, 'an abee hurayrata radiya Allah 'anhu annahu kaana yaqoolu qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ lam ya'adhani Allah lishaa'in maa adhina lilnnabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam yataghannaa bil-qur'aani ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala saahibun lahu yureedu yajharu bihi‏.‏

haddathanaa 'aliyyu ibnu 'abdi Allah, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'ani az-zuhriyyi, 'an abee salamata, 'an abee hurayrata, 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ maa adhina Allah lishaa'in maa adhina lilnnabiyyi an yataghannaa bil-qur'aani ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala sufyaanu tafseeruhu yastaghnee bihi‏.‏

haddathanaa hajjaaju ibnu minhaalin, haddathanaa shu'batu, qaala akhbaranee 'alqamatu ibnu marthadin, sami'tu sa'da ibna 'ubaydata, 'an abee 'abdi ar-rahmani as-sulamiyyi, 'an 'uthmaana radiya Allah 'anhu 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ khayrukum man ta'allama al-qur'aana wa'allamahu ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala wa'aqra'a aboo 'abdi ar-rahmani fee imrati 'uthmaana hattaa kaana al-hajjaaju, qaala wadhaaka alladhee aq'adanee maq'adee hadhaa‏.‏

haddathanaa 'abdu Allah ibnu yoosufa, akhbaranaa maalikun, 'an naafi'in, 'ani ibni 'umara radiya Allah 'anhuma anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ innamaa mathalu saahibi al-qur'aani kamathali saahibi al-ibili al-mu'aqqalati in 'aahada 'alayhaa amsakahaa wa'in atlaqahaa dhahabat ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa qutaybatu, 'an maalikin, 'an ishaaqa ibni abee talhata, annahu sami'a anasa ibna maalikin, yaqoolu inna khayyaatan da'aa rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam lita'aamin sana'ahu qaala anasun fadhahabtu ma'a rasooli Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam fara'aytuhu yatatabba'u ad-dubbaa'a min hawaalaa al-qas'ati qaala falam azal uhibbu ad-dubbaa'a min yawmi'idhin‏.‏

haddathanaa 'abdaanu, akhbaranaa 'abdu Allah, akhbaranaa shu'batu, 'an ash'atha, 'an abeehi, 'an masrooqin, 'an 'aa'ishata radiya Allah 'anha qaalat kaana an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam yuhibbu at-tayammuna maa istataa'a fee tuhoorihi watana''ulihi watarajjulihi‏.‏ wakaana qaala biwaasitin qabla hadhaa fee sha'anihi kullihi‏.‏

haddathanaa muslimun, haddathanaa wuhaybun, haddathanaa mansoorun, 'an ummihi, 'an 'aa'ishata radiya Allah 'anha tuwuffiya an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam heena shabi'naa mina al-aswadayni at-tamri wal-maa'i‏.‏

haddathanaa 'aliyyu ibnu 'abdi Allah, haddathanaa sufyaanu, qaala yahyaa ibnu sa'eedin sami'tu bushayra ibna yasaarin, yaqoolu haddathanaa suwaydu ibnu an-nu'maani, qaala kharajnaa ma'a rasooli Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ilaa khaybara, falammaa kunnaa bis-sahbaa'i qaala yahyaa waha min khaybara 'alaa rawhatin da'aa rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam bita'aamin, famaa utiya ila bisaweeqin, faluknaahu fa'akalnaa minhu, thumma da'aa bimaa'in famadmada wamadmadnaa, fasallaa binaa al-maghriba walam yatawadda'a‏.‏ qaala sufyaanu sami'tuhu minhu 'awdan wabad'an‏.‏

haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu sinaanin, haddathanaa hammaamun, 'an qataadata, qaala kunnaa 'inda anasin wa'indahu khabbaazun lahu faqaala maa akala an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam khubzan muraqqaqan wala shaatan masmootatan hattaa laqiya Allah‏.‏

haddathanaa 'aliyyu ibnu 'abdi Allah, haddathanaa mu'aadhu ibnu hishaamin, qaala haddathanee abee, 'an yoonusa qaala 'aliyyun huwa al-iskaafu 'an qataadata, 'an anasin, radiya Allah 'anhu qaala maa 'alimtu an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam akala 'alaa sukurrujatin qattu, wala khubiza lahu muraqqaqun qattu, wala akala 'alaa khiwaanin‏.‏ qeela liqataadata fa'alaa maa kaanoo ya'akuloona qaala 'alaa as-sufari‏.‏

haddathanaa ibnu abee maryama, akhbaranaa muhammadu ibnu ja'farin, akhbaranee humaydun, annahu sami'a anasan, yaqoolu qaama an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam yabnee bisafiyyata fada'awtu al-muslimeena ilaa waleematihi amara bil-antaa'i fabusitat fa'ulqiya 'alayhaa at-tamru wal-aqitu was-samnu‏.‏ waqaala 'amrunw 'an anasin banaa bihaa an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam thumma sana'a haysan fee nita'in‏.‏

haddathanaa muhammadun, akhbaranaa aboo mu'aawiyata, haddathanaa hishaamun, 'an abeehi, wa'an wahbi ibni kaysaana, qaala kaana ahlu ash-sha'ami yu'ayyiroona ibna az-zubayri yaqooloona yaa ibna dhaati an-nitaaqayni‏.‏ faqaalat lahu asmaa'u yaa bunaa innahum yu'ayyiroonaka bin-nitaaqayni, hal tadree maa kaana an-nitaaqaani innamaa kaana nitaaqee shaqaqtuhu nisfayni, fa'awkaytu qirbata rasooli Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam bi'ahadihimaa, waja'altu fee sufratihi 'aakhara, qaala fakaana ahlu ash-sha'ami idhaa 'ayyaroohu bin-nitaaqayni yaqoolu eehan wal-ilah‏.‏ tilka shakaatun zaahirun 'anka 'aaruhaa‏.‏

haddathanaa aboo an-nu'maani, haddathanaa aboo 'awaanata, 'an abee bishrin, 'an sa'eedi ibni jubayrin, 'ani ibni 'abbaasin, anna umma hufaydin binta al-haarithi ibni hazn ٍ khaalata ibni 'abbaasin ahdat ilaa an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam samnan wa'aqitan wa'adubban, fada'aa bihinna fa'ukilna 'alaa maa'idatihi, watarakahunna an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam kal-mustaqdhiri lahunna, walaw kunna haraaman maa ukilna 'alaa maa'idati an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam wala amara bi'aklihinna‏.‏

haddathanaa sulaymaanu ibnu harbin, haddathanaa hammaadun, 'an yahyaa, 'an bushayri ibni yasaarin, 'an suwaydi ibni an-nu'maani, annahu akhbarahu annahum, kaanoo ma'a an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam bis-sahbaa'i waha 'alaa rawhatin min khaybara fahadarati as-salatu, fada'aa bita'aamin falam yajidhu ila saweeqan, falaka minhu faluknaa ma'ahu, thumma da'aa bimaa'in famadmada, thumma salla wasallaynaa, walam yatawadda'a‏.‏

haddathanaa 'abdu Allah ibnu yoosufa, akhbaranaa maalikun, wahaddathanaa ismaa'eelu, qaala haddathanee maalikun, 'an abee az-zinaadi, 'ani al-a'raji, 'an abee hurayrata radiya Allah 'anhu annahu qaala qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ ta'aamu al-ithnayni kaafee ath-thalathati, wata'aamu ath-thalathati kaafee al-arba'ati ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu bashshaarin, haddathanaa 'abdu as-samadi, haddathanaa shu'batu, 'an waaqidi ibni muhammadin, 'an naafi'in, qaala kaana ibnu 'umara la ya'akulu hattaa yu'taa bimiskeenin ya'akulu ma'ahu, fa'adkhaltu rajulan ya'akulu ma'ahu fa'akala katheeran faqaala yaa naafi'u la tudkhil hadhaa 'alaa sami'tu an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam yaqoolu ‏ "‏ al-mu'minu ya'akulu fee mi'ana waahidin wal-kaafiru ya'akulu fee sab'ati am'aa'in ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanee 'abdu Allah ibnu muhammadin, haddathanaa 'abdu al-maliki ibnu 'amrinw, haddathanaa zuhayru ibnu muhammadin, 'an muhammadi ibni 'amriw ibni halhalata, 'an 'ataa'i ibni yasaarin, 'an abee sa'eedin al-khudriyyi, wa'an abee hurayrata, 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ maa yuseebu al-muslima min nasabin wala wasabin wala hammin wala huznin wala adhana wala ghammin hattaa ash-shawkati yushaakuhaa, ila kaffara Allah bihaa min khataayaahu ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa 'abdu Allah ibnu yoosufa, akhbaranaa maalikun, 'an muhammadi ibni 'abdi Allah ibni 'abdi ar-rahmani ibni abee sa'sa'ata, annahu qaala sami'tu sa'eeda ibna yasaarin abaa al-hubaabi, yaqoolu sami'tu abaa hurayrata, yaqoolu qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ man yuridi Allah bihi khayran yusib minhu ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu al-muthannaa, haddathanaa aboo ahmada az-zubayriyyu, haddathanaa 'umaru ibnu sa'eedi ibni abee husaynin, qaala haddathanee 'ataa'u ibnu abee rabaahin, 'an abee hurayrata radiya Allah 'anhu 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ maa anzala Allah daa'an ila anzala lahu shifaa'an ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanee yahyaa ibnu sulaymaana, haddathanee ibnu wahbin, qaala haddathanee maalikun, 'an naafi'in, 'ani ibni 'umara radiya Allah 'anhuma 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ al-hummaa min fayhi jahannama fa'atfi'oohaa bil-maa'i ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala naafi'un wakaana 'abdu Allah yaqoolu ikshif 'annaa ar-rijza‏.‏

haddathanaa 'abdu Allah ibnu maslamata, 'an maalikin, 'an hishaamin, 'an faatimata binti al-mundhiri, anna asmaa'a binta abee bakrin radiya Allah 'anhuma kaanat idhaa utiyat bil-mar'ati qad hummat tad'oo lahaa, akhadhati al-maa'a fasabbathu baynahaa wabayna jaybihaa qaalat wakaana rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ya'amurunaa an nabrudahaa bil-maa'i‏.‏

haddathanee muhammadu ibnu al-muthannaa, haddathanaa yahyaa, haddathanaa hishaamun, akhbaranee abee, 'an 'aa'ishata, 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ al-hummaa min fayhi jahannama faabrudoohaa bil-maa'i ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa aboo al-ahwasi, haddathanaa sa'eedu ibnu masrooqin, 'an 'abaayata ibni rifaa'ata, 'an jaddihi, raafi'i ibni khadeejin qaala sami'tu an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam yaqoolu ‏ "‏ al-hummaa min fawhi jahannama, faabrudoohaa bil-maa'i ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa hafsu ibnu 'umara, haddathanaa shu'batu, qaala akhbaranee habeebu ibnu abee thaabitin, qaala sami'tu ibraaheema ibna sa'din, qaala sami'tu usaamata ibna zaydin, yuhaddithu sa'dan 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ idhaa sami'tum bit-taa'ooni bi'ardin fala tadkhuloohaa, wa'idhaa waqa'a bi'ardin wa'antum bihaa fala takhrujoo minhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ faqultu anta sami'tahu yuhaddithu sa'dan wala yunkiruhu qaala na'am‏.‏

haddathanaa 'abdu Allah ibnu yoosufa, akhbaranaa maalikun, 'ani ibni shihaabin, 'an 'abdi Allah ibni 'aamirin, anna 'umara, kharaja ilaa ash-sha'ami, falammaa kaana bisargha balaghahu anna al-wabaa'a qad waqa'a bish-sha'ami, fa'akhbarahu 'abdu ar-rahmani ibnu 'awfin anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ idhaa sami'tum bihi bi'ardin fala taqdamoo 'alayhi wa'idhaa waqa'a bi'ardin wa'antum bihaa fala takhrujoo firaaran minhu ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa 'abdu Allah ibnu yoosufa, akhbaranaa maalikun, 'an nu'aymin al-mujmiri, 'an abee hurayrata radiya Allah 'anhu qaala qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ la yadkhulu al-madeenata al-maseehu wala at-taa'oonu ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa moosaa ibnu ismaa'eela, haddathanaa 'abdu al-waahidi, haddathanaa 'aasimun, haddathatnee hafsatu bintu seereena, qaalat qaala lee anasu ibnu maalikin radiya Allah 'anhu yahyaa bimaa maata qultu mina at-taa'ooni‏.‏ qaala qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ at-taa'oonu shahaadatun likulli muslimin ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa aboo 'aasimin, 'an maalikin, 'an sumaa, 'an abee saalihin, 'an abee hurayrata, 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ al-mabtoonu shaheedun, wal-mat'oonu shaheedun ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa ishaaqu, akhbaranaa habbaanu, haddathanaa daawudu ibnu abee al-furaati, haddathanaa 'abdu Allah ibnu buraydata, 'an yahyaa ibni ya'mara, 'an 'aa'ishata, zawji an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam annahaa akhbaratnaa annahaa sa'alat rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam 'ani at-taa'ooni fa'akhbarahaa nabiyyu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ annahu kaana 'adhaaban yab'athuhu Allah 'alaa man yashaa'u, faja'alahu Allah rahmatan lilmu'mineena, falaysa min 'abdin yaqa'u at-taa'oonu fayamkuthu fee baladihi saabiran, ya'lamu annahu lan yuseebahu ila maa kataba Allah lahu, ila kaana lahu mithlu ajri ash-shaheedi ‏"‏‏.‏ taaba'ahu an-nadru 'an daawuda‏.‏

haddathanee ibraaheemu ibnu moosaa, akhbaranaa hishaamun, 'an ma'marin, 'ani az-zuhriyyi, 'an 'urwata, 'an 'aa'ishata radiya Allah 'anha anna an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam kaana yanfuthu 'alaa nafsihi fee al-maradi alladhee maata feehi bil-mu'awwidhaati, falammaa thaqula kuntu anfithu 'alayhi bihinna, wa'amsahu biyadi nafsihi libarakatihaa‏.‏ fasa'altu az-zuhriyya kayfa yanfithu qaala kaana yanfithu 'alaa yadayhi, thumma yamsahu bihimaa wajhahu‏.‏

haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu katheerin, akhbaranaa sufyaanu, qaala haddathanee ma'badu ibnu khaalidin, qaala sami'tu 'abda Allah ibna shaddaadin, 'an 'aa'ishata radiya Allah 'anha qaalat amaranee rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam aw amara an yustarqaa mina al-'ayni‏.‏

haddathanee 'abdu Allah ibnu muhammadin, haddathanaa hishaamun, akhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani az-zuhriyyi, 'ani ibni al-musayyabi, 'an abee hurayrata radiya Allah 'anhu 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ kullu 'amali ibni 'aadama lahu, ila as-sawma fa'innahu lee, wa'anaa ajzee bihi, walakhaloofu fami as-saa'imi atyabu 'inda Allah min reehi al-miski ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa yahyaa ibnu bukayrin, haddathanaa al-laythu, 'an 'uqaylin, 'ani ibni shihaabin, qaala akhbaranee anasu ibnu maalikin, anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ man ahabba an yubsata lahu fee rizqihi, wayunsa'a lahu fee atharihi, falyasil rahimahu ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa al-hakamu ibnu naafi'in, akhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani az-zuhriyyi, akhbaranaa sa'eedu ibnu al-musayyabi, anna abaa hurayrata, qaala sami'tu rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam yaqoolu ‏ "‏ ja'ala Allah ar-rahmata mi'ata juz'in, fa'amsaka 'indahu tis'atan watis'eena juz'an, wa'anzala fee al-ardi juz'an waahidan, famin dhalika al-juz'i yataraahamu al-khalqu, hattaa tarfa'a al-farasu haafirahaa 'an waladihaa khashyata an tuseebahu ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa aboo nu'aymin, haddathanaa zakariyyaa'u, 'an 'aamirin, qaala sami'tuhu yaqoolu sami'tu an-nu'maana ibna basheerin, yaqoolu qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ taraa al-mu'mineena fee taraahumihim watawaaddihim wata'aatufihim kamathali al-jasadi idhaa ishtakaa 'udwan tadaa'aa lahu saa'iru jasadihi bis-sahari wal-hummaa ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa 'umaru ibnu hafsin, haddathanaa abee, haddathanaa al-a'mashu, qaala haddathanee zaydu ibnu wahbin, qaala sami'tu jareera ibna 'abdi Allah, 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ man la yarhamu la yurhamu ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa hafsu ibnu 'umara, haddathanaa shu'batu, 'an sulaymaana, sami'tu abaa waa'ilin, sami'tu masrooqan, qaala qaala 'abdu Allah ibnu 'amrinw‏.‏ haddathanaa qutaybatu, haddathanaa jareerun, 'ani al-a'mashi, 'an shaqeeqi ibni salamata, 'an masrooqin, qaala dakhalnaa 'alaa 'abdi Allah ibni 'amrinw heena qadima ma'a mu'aawiyata ilaa al-koofati fadhakara rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam faqaala lam yakun faahishan wala mutafahhishan, waqaala qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ inna min akhyarikum ahsanakum khuluqan ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu yoosufa, akhbaranaa sufyaanu, 'ani al-a'mashi, 'an abee waa'ilin, 'ani ibni mas'oodin radiya Allah 'anhu qaala qasama rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qismatan, faqaala rajulun mina al-ansaari wal-lahi maa araada muhammadun bihadhaa wajha Allah‏.‏ fa'ataytu rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam fa'akhbartuhu, fatama''ara wajhuhu waqaala ‏ "‏ rahima Allah moosaa, laqad oodhiya bi'akthara min hadhaa fasabara ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu sabbaahin, haddathanaa ismaa'eelu ibnu zakariyyaa'a, haddathanaa buraydu ibnu 'abdi Allah ibni abee burdata, 'an abee burdata, 'an abee moosaa, qaala sami'a an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam rajulan yuthnee 'alaa rajulin wayutreehi fee al-midhati faqaala ‏ "‏ ahlaktum aw qata'tum zahra ar-rajuli ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa 'aadamu, haddathanaa shu'batu, 'an khaalidin, 'an 'abdi ar-rahmani ibni abee bakrata, 'an abeehi, anna rajulan, dhukira 'inda an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam fa'athnaa 'alayhi rajulun khayran, faqaala an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏"‏ wayhaka qata'ta 'unuqa saahibika yaqooluhu miraaran in kaana ahadukum maadihan la mahaalata falyaqul ahsibu kadhaa wakadhaa‏.‏ in kaana yuraa annahu kadhalika, wahaseebuhu Allah, wala yuzakkee 'alaa Allah ahadan ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala wuhaybun 'an khaalidin ‏"‏ waylaka ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa 'aliyyu ibnu 'abdi Allah, haddathanaa sufyaanu, haddathanaa moosaa ibnu 'uqbata, 'an saalimin, 'an abeehi, anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam heena dhakara fee al-izaari maa dhakara, qaala aboo bakrin yaa rasoola Allah inna izaaree yasqutu min ahadi shiqqayhi‏.‏ qaala ‏ "‏ innaka lasta minhum ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa bishru ibnu muhammadin, akhbaranaa 'abdu Allah, akhbaranaa ma'marun, 'an hammaami ibni munabbihin, 'an abee hurayrata, 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ iyyaakum waz-zanna, fa'inna az-zanna akdhabu al-hadeethi, wala tahassasoo, wala tajassasoo, wala tahaasadoo, wala tadaabaroo, wala tabaaghadoo, wakoonoo 'ibaada Allah ikhwaanan ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa aboo al-yamaani, akhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani az-zuhriyyi, qaala haddathanee anasu ibnu maalikin radiya Allah 'anhu anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ la tabaaghadoo, wala tahaasadoo, wala tadaabaroo, wakoonoo 'ibaada Allah ikhwaanan, wala yahillu limuslimin an yahjura akhaahu fawqa thalathati ayyaamin ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa 'abdu Allah ibnu yoosufa, akhbaranaa maalikun, 'an abee az-zinaadi, 'ani al-a'raji, 'an abee hurayrata radiya Allah 'anhu anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ iyyaakum waz-zanna, fa'inna az-zanna akdhabu al-hadeethi, wala tahassasoo, wala tajassasoo, wala tanaajashoo, wala tahaasadoo, wala tabaaghadoo, wala tadaabaroo, wakoonoo 'ibaada Allah ikhwaanan ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa sa'eedu ibnu 'ufayrin, haddathanaa al-laythu, 'an 'uqaylin, 'ani ibni shihaabin, 'an 'urwata, 'an 'aa'ishata, qaalat qaala an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ maa azunnu fulanan wafulanan ya'rifaani min deeninaa shay'an ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala al-laythu kaanaa rajulayni mina al-munaafiqeena‏.‏

haddathanaa ibnu bukayrin, haddathanaa al-laythu, bihadhaa waqaalat dakhala 'alaa an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam yawman waqaala ‏ "‏ yaa 'aa'ishatu maa azunnu fulanan wafulanan ya'rifaani deenanaa alladhee nahnu 'alayhi ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa 'abdu al-'azeezi ibnu 'abdi Allah, haddathanaa ibraaheemu ibnu sa'din, 'ani ibni akhee ibni shihaabin, 'ani ibni shihaabin, 'an saalimi ibni 'abdi Allah, qaala sami'tu abaa hurayrata, yaqoolu sami'tu rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam yaqoolu ‏ "‏ kullu ummatee mu'aafana ila al-mujaahireena, wa'inna mina al-majaanati an ya'mala ar-rajulu bil-layli 'amalan, thumma yusbiha waqad satarahu Allah, fayaqoola yaa fulanu 'amiltu al-baarihata kadhaa wakadhaa, waqad baata yasturuhu rabbuhu wayusbihu yakshifu sitra Allah 'anhu ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa aboo 'awaanata, 'an qataadata, 'an safwaana ibni muhrizin, anna rajulan, sa'ala ibna 'umara kayfa sami'ta rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam yaqoolu fee an-najwaa qaala ‏ "‏ yadnoo ahadukum min rabbihi hattaa yada'a kanafahu 'alayhi fayaqoolu 'amilta kadhaa wakadhaa‏.‏ fayaqoolu na'am‏.‏ wayaqoolu 'amilta kadhaa wakadhaa‏.‏ fayaqoolu na'am‏.‏ fayuqarriruhu thumma yaqoolu innee satartu 'alayka fee ad-dunyaa, fa'anaa aghfiruhaa laka al-yawma ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu katheerin, akhbaranaa sufyaanu, haddathanaa ma'badu ibnu khaalidin al-qaysiyyu, 'an haarithata ibni wahbin al-khuzaa'iyyi, 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ ala ukhbirukum bi'ahli al-jannati, kullu da'eefin mutadaa'ifin, law aqsama 'alaa Allah l'abarrahu, ala ukhbirukum bi'ahli an-naari kullu 'utullin jawwaazin mustakbirin ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa 'uthmaanu ibnu abee shaybata, haddathanaa jareerun, 'an mansoorin, 'an abee waa'ilin, 'an 'abdi Allah radiya Allah 'anhu 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ inna as-sidqa yahdee ilaa al-birri, wa'inna al-birra yahdee ilaa al-jannati, wa'inna ar-rajula layasduqu hattaa yakoona siddeeqan, wa'inna al-kadhiba yahdee ilaa al-fujoori, wa'inna al-fujoora yahdee ilaa an-naari, wa'inna ar-rajula layakdhibu, hattaa yuktaba 'inda Allah kadhdhaaban ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa 'abdu Allah ibnu yoosufa, akhbaranaa maalikun, 'ani ibni shihaabin, 'an sa'eedi ibni al-musayyabi, 'an abee hurayrata radiya Allah 'anhu anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ laysa ash-shadeedu bis-sura'ati, innamaa ash-shadeedu alladhee yamliku nafsahu 'inda al-ghadabi ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanee yahyaa ibnu yoosufa, akhbaranaa aboo bakrin huwa ibnu 'ayyaashin 'an abee haseenin, 'an abee saalihin, 'an abee hurayrata radiya Allah 'anhu anna rajulan, qaala lilnnabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam awsinee‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ la taghdab ‏"‏‏.‏ faraddada miraaran, qaala ‏"‏ la taghdab ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa 'aadamu, haddathanaa shu'batu, 'an abee at-tayyaahi, qaala sami'tu anasa ibna maalikin radiya Allah 'anhu qaala qaala an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ yassiroo wala tu'assiroo, wasakkinoo wala tunaffiroo ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa qutaybatu, haddathanaa al-laythu, 'an 'uqaylin, 'ani az-zuhriyyi, 'ani ibni al-musayyabi, 'an abee hurayrata radiya Allah 'anhu 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam annahu qaala ‏ "‏ la yuldaghu al-mu'minu min juhrin waahidin marratayni ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa 'aliyyu ibnu 'abdi Allah, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'ani az-zuhriyyi, 'an 'ataa'i ibni yazeeda al-laythiyyi, 'an abee ayyooba radiya Allah 'anhu 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ la yahillu limuslimin an yahjura akhaahu fawqa thalathin, yaltaqiyaani fayasuddu hadhaa, wayasuddu hadhaa, wakhayruhumaa alladhee yabda'u bis-salami ‏"‏‏.‏ wadhakara sufyaanu annahu sami'ahu minhu thalatha marraatin‏.‏

haddathanaa aboo ma'marin, haddathanaa 'abdu al-waarithi, haddathanaa al-husaynu, haddathanaa 'abdu Allah ibnu buraydata, 'an bushayri ibni ka'bin al-'adawiyyi, qaala haddathanee shaddaadu ibnu awsin radiya Allah 'anhu 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏"‏ sayyidu al-istighfaari an taqoola al-lahumma anta rabbee, la ilaha ila anta, khalaqtanee wa'anaa 'abduka, wa'anaa 'alaa 'ahdika wawa'dika maa istata'tu, a'oodhu bika min sharri maa sana'tu, aboo'u laka bini'matika 'alaa wa'aboo'u laka bidhanbee, faaghfir lee, fa'innahu la yaghfiru adh-dhunooba ila anta ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ waman qaalahaa mina an-nahaari mooqinan bihaa, famaata min yawmihi qabla an yumsiya, fahuwa min ahli al-jannati, waman qaalahaa mina al-layli wahwa mooqinun bihaa, famaata qabla an yusbiha, fahwa min ahli al-jannati ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa aboo al-yamaani, akhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani az-zuhriyyi, qaala akhbaranee aboo salamata ibnu 'abdi ar-rahmani, qaala qaala aboo hurayrata sami'tu rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam yaqoolu ‏ "‏ wal-lahi innee l'astaghfiru Allah wa'atoobu ilayhi fee al-yawmi akthara min sab'eena marratan ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa ishaaqu, akhbaranaa habbaanu, haddathanaa hammaamun, haddathanaa qataadatu, haddathanaa anasu ibnu maalikin, 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam‏.‏ wahaddathanaa hudbatu, haddathanaa hammaamun, haddathanaa qataadatu, 'an anasin radiya Allah 'anhu qaala qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ Allah afrahu bitawbati 'abdihi min ahadikum saqata 'alaa ba'eerihi, waqad adallahu fee ardi falatin ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa 'abdu Allah ibnu maslamata, 'an maalikin, 'an sumaa, 'an abee saalihin, 'an abee hurayrata radiya Allah 'anhu anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ man qaala subhaana Allah wabihamdihi‏.‏ fee yawmin mi'ata marratin huttat khataayaahu, wa'in kaanat mithla zabadi al-bahri ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa zuhayru ibnu harbin, haddathanaa ibnu fudaylin, 'an 'umaarata, 'an abee zur'ata, 'an abee hurayrata, 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ kalimataani khafeefataani 'alaa al-lisaani, thaqeelataani fee al-meezaani, habeebataani ilaa ar-rahmani, subhaana Allah al-'azeemi, subhaana Allah wabihamdihi ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu al-'ala'i, haddathanaa aboo usaamata, 'an buraydi ibni 'abdi Allah, 'an abee burdata, 'an abee moosaa radiya Allah 'anhu qaala qaala an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ mathalu alladhee yadhkuru rabbahu waalladhee la yadhkuru mathalu al-haa wal-mayyiti ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa al-makkiyyu ibnu ibraaheema, akhbaranaa 'abdu Allah ibnu sa'eedin huwa ibnu abee hindin 'an abeehi, 'ani ibni 'abbaasin radiya Allah 'anhuma qaala qaala an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ ni'mataani maghboonun feehimaa katheerun mina an-naasi, as-sihhatu wal-faraaghu ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala 'abbaasun al-'anbariyyu haddathanaa safwaanu ibnu 'eesaa, 'an 'abdi Allah ibni sa'eedi ibni abee hindin, 'an abeehi, sami'tu ibna 'abbaasin, 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam mithlahu‏.‏

haddathanaa 'aliyyu ibnu 'abdi Allah, haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu 'abdi ar-rahmani aboo al-mundhiri at-tufaawiyyu, 'an sulaymaana al-a'mashi, qaala haddathanee mujaahidun, 'an 'abdi Allah ibni 'umara radiya Allah 'anhuma qaala akhadha rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam bimankibee faqaala ‏ "‏ kun fee ad-dunyaa ka'annaka ghareebun, aw 'aabiru sabeelin ‏"‏‏.‏ wakaana ibnu 'umara yaqoolu idhaa amsayta fala tantaziri as-sabaaha, wa'idhaa asbahta fala tantaziri al-masaa'a, wakhudh min sihhatika limaradika, wamin hayaatika limawtika‏.‏

haddathanaa 'aliyyu ibnu 'abdi Allah, haddathanaa aboo safwaana 'abdu Allah ibnu sa'eedin, haddathanaa yoonusu, 'ani ibni shihaabin, qaala akhbaranee sa'eedu ibnu al-musayyabi, anna abaa hurayrata radiya Allah 'anhu qaala sami'tu rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam yaqoolu ‏ "‏ la yazaalu qalbu al-kabeeri shaabban fee ithnatayni fee hubbi ad-dunyaa, watooli al-amali ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala al-laythu haddathanee yoonusu waabnu wahbin 'an yoonusa 'ani ibni shihaabin qaala akhbaranee sa'eedun wa'aboo salamata‏.‏

haddathanaa muslimu ibnu ibraaheema, haddathanaa hishaamun, haddathanaa qataadatu, 'an anasin radiya Allah 'anhu qaala qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ yakbaru ibnu 'aadama wayakbaru ma'ahu ithnaani hubbu al-maali, watoolu al-'umuri ‏"‏‏.‏ rawaahu shu'batu 'an qataadata‏.‏

haddathanaa mu'aadhu ibnu asadin, akhbaranaa 'abdu Allah, akhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani az-zuhriyyi, qaala akhbaranee mahmoodu ibnu ar-rabee'i, waza'ama, mahmoodun annahu 'aqala rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam waqaala wa'aqala majjatan majjahaa min dalwin kaanat fee daarihim‏.‏

qaala sami'tu 'itbaana ibna maalikin al-ansaariyya, thumma ahada banee saalimin qaala ghadaa 'alaa rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam faqaala ‏ "‏ lan yuwaafiya 'abdun yawma al-qiyaamati yaqoolu la ilaha ila Allah‏.‏ yabtaghee bihi wajha Allah, ila harrama Allah 'alayhi an-naara ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa qutaybatu, haddathanaa ya'qoobu ibnu 'abdi ar-rahmani, 'an 'amrinw, 'an sa'eedin al-maqburiyyi, 'an abee hurayrata, anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ yaqoolu Allah ta'aalaa maa li'abdee al-mu'mini 'indee jazaa'un, idhaa qabadtu safiyyahu min ahli ad-dunyaa, thumma ihtasabahu ila al-jannatu ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa qutaybatu ibnu sa'eedin, haddathanaa al-laythu, 'an yazeeda ibni abee habeebin, 'an abee al-khayri, 'an 'uqbata ibni 'aamirin, anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam kharaja yawman fasallaa 'alaa ahli uhudin salatahu 'alaa al-mayyiti, thumma insarafa ilaa al-minbari faqaala ‏ "‏ innee faratukum wa'anaa shaheedun 'alaykum, wa'innee wal-lahi l'anzuru ilaa hawdee al-'aana, wa'innee qad u'teetu mafaateeha khazaa'ini al-ardi aw mafaateeha al-ardi wa'innee wal-lahi maa akhaafu 'alaykum an tushrikoo ba'dee, walakinnee akhaafu 'alaykum an tanaafasoo feehaa ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa 'abdaanu, 'an abee hamzata, 'ani al-a'mashi, 'an ibraaheema, 'an 'abeedata, 'an 'abdi Allah radiya Allah 'anhu 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ khayru an-naasi qarnee, thumma alladheena yaloonahum, thumma alladheena yaloonahum, thumma yajee'u min ba'dihim qawmun tasbiqu shahaadatuhum aymaanahum wa'aymaanuhum shahaadatahum ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanee yahyaa ibnu moosaa, haddathanaa wakee'un, haddathanaa ismaa'eelu, 'an qaysin, qaala sami'tu khabbaaban, waqadi iktawaa yawma'idhin sab'an fee batnihi waqaala lawla anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam nahaanaa an nad'uwa bil-mawti lada'awtu bil-mawti, inna ashaaba muhammadin salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam madaw walam tanqushumu ad-dunyaa bishaa'in, wa'innaa asabnaa mina ad-dunyaa maa la najidu lahu mawdi'an ila at-turaaba‏.‏

haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu al-muthannaa, haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an ismaa'eela, qaala haddathanee qaysun, qaala ataytu khabbaaban wahwa yabnee haa'itan lahu faqaala inna ashaabanaa alladheena madaw lam tanqushumu ad-dunyaa shay'an, wa'innaa asabnaa min ba'dihim shay'an, la najidu lahu mawdi'an ila at-turaaba‏.‏
haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu katheerin, 'an sufyaana, 'ani al-a'mashi, 'an abee waa'ilin, 'an khabbaab ٍ radiya Allah 'anhu qaala haajarnaa ma'a rasooli Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam‏.‏

haddathanee yahyaa ibnu hammaadin, haddathanaa aboo 'awaanata, 'an bayaanin, 'an qaysi ibni abee haazimin, 'an mirdaasin al-aslamiyyi, qaala qaala an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ yadhhabu as-saalihoona al-awwalu fal-awwalu, wayabqaa hufaalatun kahufaalati ash-sha'eeri awi at-tamri, la yubaaleehimu Allah baalatan ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala aboo 'abdi Allah yuqaalu hufaalatun wahuthaalatun‏.‏

haddathanee yahyaa ibnu yoosufa, akhbaranaa aboo bakrin, 'an abee haseenin, 'an abee saalihin, 'an abee hurayrata radiya Allah 'anhu qaala qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ ta'isa 'abdu ad-deenaari wad-dirhami wal-qateefati wal-khameesati, in u'tiya radiya, wa'in lam yu'ta lam yarda ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa ahmadu ibnu yoonusa, haddathanaa aboo bakrin, haddathanaa aboo haseenin, 'an abee saalihin, 'an abee hurayrata, 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ laysa al-ghinaa 'an kathrati al-'aradi, walakinna al-ghinaa ghinaa an-nafsi ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanee muhammadu ibnu 'ar'arata, haddathanaa shu'batu, 'an sa'di ibni ibraaheema, 'an abee salamata, 'an 'aa'ishata radiya Allah 'anha annahaa qaalat su'ila an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam aa al-a'maali ahabbu ilaa Allah qaala ‏"‏ adwamuhaa wa'in qalla ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala ‏"‏ iklafoo mina al-a'maali maa tuteeqoona ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanee 'abdu al-'azeezi ibnu 'abdi Allah, haddathanaa ibraaheemu ibnu sa'din, 'ani ibni shihaabin, 'an abee salamata, 'an abee hurayrata radiya Allah 'anhu qaala qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ man kaana yu'minu bil-lahi wal-yawmi al-'aakhiri falyaqul khayran, aw liyasmut, waman kaana yu'minu bil-lahi wal-yawmi al-'aakhiri fala yu'dhi jaarahu, waman kaana yu'minu bil-lahi wal-yawmi al-'aakhiri falyukrim dayfahu ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanee ibraaheemu ibnu hamzata, haddathanee ibnu abee haazimin, 'an yazeeda, 'an muhammadi ibni ibraaheema, 'an 'eesaa ibni talhata at-taymiyyi, 'an abee hurayrata, sami'a rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam yaqoolu ‏ "‏ inna al-'abda layatakallamu bil-kalimati maa yatabayyanu feehaa, yazillu bihaa fee an-naari ab'ada mimmaa bayna al-mashriqi ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa ismaa'eelu, qaala haddathanee maalikun, 'an abee az-zinaadi, 'ani al-a'raji, 'an abee hurayrata, anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ hujibati an-naaru bish-shahawaati, wahujibati al-jannatu bil-makaarihi ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa ismaa'eelu, qaala haddathanee maalikun, 'an abee az-zinaadi, 'ani al-a'raji, 'an abee hurayrata, 'an rasooli Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ idhaa nazara ahadukum ilaa man fuddila 'alayhi fee al-maali wal-khalqi, falyanzur ilaa man huwa asfala minhu ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanee muhammadu ibnu 'uthmaana, haddathanaa khaalidu ibnu makhladin, haddathanaa sulaymaanu ibnu bilalin, haddathanee shareeku ibnu 'abdi Allah ibni abee namirin, 'an 'ataa'in, 'an abee hurayrata, qaala qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ inna Allah qaala man 'aadaa lee waliyyan faqad 'aadhantuhu bil-harbi, wamaa taqarraba ilaa 'abdee bishaa'in ahabba ilaa mimmaa iftaradtu 'alayhi, wamaa yazaalu 'abdee yataqarrabu ilaa bin-nawaafili hattaa uhibbahu, fa'idhaa ahbabtuhu kuntu sam'ahu alladhee yasma'u bihi, wabasarahu alladhee yubsiru bihi, wayadahu allatee yabtushu bihaa warijlahu allatee yamshee bihaa, wa'in sa'alanee l'u'tiyannahu, wala'ini ista'aadhanee l'u'eedhannahu, wamaa taraddadtu 'an shaa'in anaa faa'iluhu taraddudee 'an nafsi al-mu'mini, yakrahu al-mawta wa'anaa akrahu masaa'atahu ‏"‏‏.‏
haddathanaa aboo al-waleedi, haddathanaa shu'batu, 'an qataadata, 'an anasin, 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏"‏ ibnu ukhti al-qawmi minhum ‏"‏‏.‏ aw ‏"‏ min anfusihim ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa aboo al-waleedi, haddathanaa shu'batu, 'an 'adiyyin, 'an abee haazimin, 'an abee hurayrata, 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ man taraka maalan faliwarathatihi, waman taraka kalan fa'ilaynaa ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa aboo 'aasimin, 'ani ibni jurayjin, 'ani ibni shihaabin, 'an 'aliyyi ibni husaynin, 'an 'amriw ibni 'uthmaana, 'an usaamata ibni zaydin radiya Allah 'anhuma anna an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ la yarithu al-muslimu al-kaafira, wala al-kaafiru al-muslima ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa khaalidun huwa ibnu 'abdi Allah haddathanaa khaalidun, 'an abee 'uthmaana, 'an sa'din radiya Allah 'anhu qaala sami'tu an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam yaqoolu ‏ "‏ mani adda'aa ilaa ghayri abeehi, wahwa ya'lamu annahu ghayru abeehi, fal-jannatu 'alayhi haraamun ‏"‏‏.‏ fadhakartuhu l'abee bakrata faqaala wa'anaa sami'athu udhunaaa, wawa'aahu, qalbee min rasooli Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam‏.‏

haddathanaa asbaghu ibnu al-faraji, haddathanaa ibnu wahbin, akhbaranee 'amrunw, 'an ja'fari ibni rabee'ata, 'an 'iraakin, 'an abee hurayrata, 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ la targhaboo 'an 'aabaa'ikum, faman raghiba 'an abeehi fahuwa kufrun ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa qutaybatu ibnu sa'eedin, haddathanaa al-laythu, 'ani ibni shihaabin, 'an 'urwata, 'an 'aa'ishata radiya Allah 'anha qaalat inna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam dakhala 'alaa masrooran tabruqu asaareeru wajhihi faqaala ‏ "‏ alam taraa anna mujazzizan nazara 'aanifan ilaa zaydi ibni haarithata wa'usaamata ibni zaydin, faqaala inna hadhihi al-aqdaama ba'duhaa min ba'din ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa qutaybatu ibnu sa'eedin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'ani az-zuhriyyi, 'an 'urwata, 'an 'aa'ishata, qaalat dakhala 'alaa rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam dhaata yawmin wahwa masroorun faqaala ‏ "‏ yaa 'aa'ishatu alam taraa anna mujazzizan al-mudlijiyya dakhala fara'aa usaamata wazaydan wa'alayhimaa qateefatun, qad ghattayaa ru'oosahumaa wabadat aqdaamuhumaa, faqaala inna hadhihi al-aqdaama ba'duhaa min ba'din ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanee yahyaa ibnu bukayrin, haddathanaa al-laythu, 'an 'uqaylin, 'ani ibni shihaabin, 'an abee bakri ibni 'abdi ar-rahmani, 'an abee hurayrata, anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ la yaznee az-zaanee heena yaznee wahwa mu'minun, wala yashrabu al-khamra heena yashrabu wahwa mu'minun, wala yasriqu heena yasriqu wahwa mu'minun, wala yantahibu nuhbatan yarfa'u an-naasu ilayhi feehaa absaarahum wahwa mu'minun ‏"‏‏.‏ wa'ani ibni shihaabin, 'an sa'eedi ibni al-musayyabi, wa'abee, salamata 'an abee hurayrata, 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam bimithlihi, ila an-nuhbata‏.‏

haddathanaa hafsu ibnu 'umara, haddathanaa hishaamun, 'an qataadata, 'an anasin, anna an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam (h) haddathanaa 'aadamu haddathanaa shu'batu haddathanaa qataadatu 'an anasi ibni maalikin radiya Allah 'anhu anna an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam daraba fee al-khamri bil-jareedi wan-ni'aali, wajalada aboo bakrin arba'eena‏.‏

haddathanaa qutaybatu, haddathanaa 'abdu al-wahhaabi, 'an ayyooba, 'ani ibni abee mulaykata, 'an 'uqbata ibni al-haarithi, qaala jee'a bin-nu'aymaani aw bibni an-nu'aymaani shaariban, fa'amara an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam man kaana bil-bayti an yadriboohu‏.‏ qaala fadaraboohu, fakuntu anaa feeman darabahu bin-ni'aali‏.‏

haddathanaa sulaymaanu ibnu harbin, haddathanaa wuhaybu ibnu khaalidin, 'an ayyooba, 'an 'abdi Allah ibni abee mulaykata, 'an 'uqbata ibni al-haarithi, anna an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam utiya binu'aymaana aw bibni nu'aymaana wahwa sakraanu fashaqqa 'alayhi, wa'amara man fee al-bayti an yadriboohu, fadaraboohu bil-jareedi wan-ni'aali, wakuntu feeman darabahu‏.‏

haddathanaa muslimun, haddathanaa hishaamun, haddathanaa qataadatu, 'an anasin, qaala jalada an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam fee al-khamri bil-jareedi wan-ni'aali, wajalada aboo bakrin arba'eena‏.‏

haddathanaa yahyaa ibnu bukayri, haddathanaa al-laythu, 'an 'uqaylin, 'ani ibni shihaabin, anna saaliman, akhbarahu anna 'abda Allah ibna 'umara radiya Allah 'anhuma akhbarahu anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ al-muslimu akhoo al-muslimi, la yazlimuhu, wala yuslimuhu, waman kaana fee haajati akheehi, kaana Allah fee haajatihi ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa aboo al-yamaani, akhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani az-zuhriyyi, haddathanee 'urwatu, anna 'aa'ishata radiya Allah 'anha qaalat jaa'at hindun bintu 'utbata ibni rabee'ata faqaalat yaa rasoola Allah, wal-lahi maa kaana 'alaa zahri al-ardi ahlu khibaa'in ahabba ilaa an yadhilloo min ahli khibaa'ika, wamaa asbaha al-yawma 'alaa zahri al-ardi ahlu khibaa'in ahabba ilaa an ya'izzoo min ahli khibaa'ika‏.‏ thumma qaalat inna abaa sufyaana rajulun misseekun, fahal 'alaa min harajin an ut'ima alladhee lahu 'iyaalanaa qaala lahaa ‏ "‏ la haraja 'alayki an tut'imeehim min ma'roofin ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanee muhammadu ibnu bashshaarin, haddathanaa ghundarun, haddathanaa shu'batu, qaala sami'tu qataadata, 'an anasi ibni maalikin, qaala lammaa araada an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam an yaktuba ilaa ar-roomi qaaloo innahum la yaqra'oona kitaaban ila makhtooman‏.‏ faattakhadha an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam khaataman min fiddatin, ka'annee anzuru ilaa wabeesihi, wanaqshuhu muhammadun rasoolu Allah‏.‏

wa'ani az-zuhriyyi, qaala haddathanee saalimu ibnu 'abdi Allah, an 'abda Allah ibna 'umara, qaala sami'tu 'umara, yaqoolu kaana an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam yu'teenee al-'ataa'a fa'aqoolu a'tihi afqara ilayhi minnee‏.‏ hattaa a'taanee marratan maalan faqultu a'tihi man huwa afqaru ilayhi minnee‏.‏ faqaala an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ khudhhu fatamawwalhu watasaddaq bihi, famaa jaa'aka min hadhaa al-maali wa'anta ghayru mushrifin wala saa'ilin fakhudhhu, wamaa la fala tutbi'hu nafsaka ‏"‏‏.‏
haddathanaa 'aliyyu ibnu 'abdi Allah, haddathanaa sufyaanu, qaala az-zuhriyyu 'an sahli ibni sa'din, qaala shahidtu al-mutala'inayni wa'anaa ibnu khamsa, 'ashrata furriqa baynahumaa‏.‏

haddathanaa yahyaa, haddathanaa 'abdu ar-razzaaqi, akhbaranaa ibnu jurayjin, akhbaranee ibnu shihaabin, 'an sahlin, akhee banee saa'idata anna rajulan, mina al-ansaari jaa'a ilaa an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam faqaala ara'ayta rajulan wajada ma'a imra'atihi rajulan, ayaqtuluhu fatala'anaa fee al-masjidi wa'anaa shaahidun‏.‏

haddathanaa yahyaa ibnu bukayrin, haddathanee al-laythu, 'an 'uqaylin, 'ani ibni shihaabin, 'an abee salamata, wasa'eedi ibni al-musayyabi, 'an abee hurayrata, qaala ataa rajulun rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam wahwa fee al-masjidi fanaadaahu faqaala yaa rasoola Allah innee zanaytu‏.‏ fa'a'rada 'anhu‏.‏ falammaa shahida 'alaa nafsihi arba'an qaala ‏"‏ abika junoonun ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala la‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ idhhaboo bihi faarjumoohu ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa 'abdu Allah ibnu maslamata, 'an maalikin, 'an hishaamin, 'an abeehi, 'an zaynaba ibnati abee salamata, 'an ummi salamata radiya Allah 'anha anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ innamaa anaa basharun, wa'innakum takhtasimoona ilaa, wala'alla ba'dakum an yakoona alhana bihujjatihi min ba'din fa'aqdee nahwa maa asma'u, faman qadaytu lahu bihaqqi akheehi shay'an fala ya'akhudhhu, fa'innamaa aqta'u lahu qit'atan mina an-naari ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa 'abdu al-'azeezi ibnu 'abdi Allah, haddathanaa ibraaheemu, 'ani ibni shihaabin, 'an 'aliyyi ibni husaynin, anna an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam atathu safiyyatu bintu huyaa falammaa raja'ati intalaqa ma'ahaa, famarra bihi rajulani mina al-ansaari fada'aahumaa faqaala ‏"‏ innamaa hiya safiyyatu ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala subhaana Allah‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ inna ash-shaytaana yajree mini ibni 'aadama majraa ad-dami ‏"‏‏.‏ rawaahu shu'aybun waabnu musaafirin waabnu abee 'ateeqin wa'ishaaqu ibnu yahyaa 'ani az-zuhriyyi 'an 'aliyyin ya'nee ibna husaynin 'an safiyyata 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam‏.‏

haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu bashshaarin, haddathanaa al-'aqadiyyu, haddathanaa shu'batu, 'an sa'eedi ibni abee burdata, qaala sami'tu abee qaala, ba'atha an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam abee wamu'aadha ibna jabalin 'alaa al-yamani faqaala ‏"‏ yassiraa wala tu'assiraa, wabashshiraa wala tunaffiraa, watataawa'aa ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala lahu aboo moosaa innahu yusna'u bi'ardinaa al-bit'u‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ kullu muskirin haraamun ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala an-nadru wa'aboo daawuda wayazeedu ibnu haaroona wawakee'un 'an shu'bata 'an sa'eedin 'an abeehi 'an jaddihi 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam‏.‏

haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yahyaa ibnu sa'eedin, 'an sufyaana, haddathanee mansoorun, 'an abee waa'ilin, 'an abee moosaa, 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ fukkoo al-'aaniya wa'ajeeboo ad-daa'iya ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa 'uthmaanu ibnu saalihin, haddathanaa 'abdu Allah ibnu wahbin, akhbaranee ibnu jurayjin, anna naafi'an, akhbarahu anna ibna 'umara radiya Allah 'anhuma akhbarahu qaala kaana saalimun mawlaa abee hudhayfata ya'ummu al-muhaajireena al-awwaleena wa'ashaaba an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam fee masjidi qubaa'in, feehim aboo bakrin wa'umaru wa'aboo salamata wazaydun wa'aamiru ibnu rabee'ata‏.‏

haddathanaa ismaa'eelu ibnu abee uwaysin, haddathanee ismaa'eelu ibnu ibraaheema, 'an 'ammihi, moosaa ibni 'uqbata qaala ibnu shihaabin haddathanee 'urwatu ibnu az-zubayri, anna marwaana ibna al-hakami, wal-miswara ibna makhramata, akhbaraahu anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala heena adhina lahumu al-muslimoona fee 'itqi saba hawaazina ‏ "‏ innee la adree man adhina minkum mimman lam ya'adhan, faarji'oo hattaa yarfa'a ilaynaa 'urafaa'ukum amrakum ‏"‏‏.‏ faraja'a an-naasu fakallamahum 'urafaa'uhum, faraja'oo ilaa rasooli Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam fa'akhbaroohu anna an-naasa qad tayyaboo wa'adhinoo‏.‏

haddathanaa ismaa'eelu, haddathanee maalikun, 'an abee az-zinaadi, 'ani al-a'raji, 'an abee hurayrata, 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ da'oonee maa taraktukum, innamaa halaka man kaana qablakum bisu'aalihim waakhtilafihim 'alaa anbiyaa'ihim, fa'idhaa nahaytukum 'an shaa'in faajtaniboohu, wa'idhaa amartukum bi'amrin fa'atoo minhu maa istata'tum ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa 'umaru ibnu hafsin, haddathanaa abee, haddathanaa al-a'mashu, sami'tu abaa saalihin, 'an abee hurayrata radiya Allah 'anhu qaala qaala an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ yaqoolu Allah ta'aalaa anaa 'inda zanni 'abdee bee, wa'anaa ma'ahu idhaa dhakaranee, fa'in dhakaranee fee nafsihi dhakartuhu fee nafsee, wa'in dhakaranee fee mal'in dhakartuhu fee mal'in khayrin minhum, wa'in taqarraba ilaa bishibrin taqarrabtu ilayhi dhiraa'an, wa'in taqarraba ilaa dhiraa'an taqarrabtu ilayhi baa'an, wa'in ataanee yamshee ataytuhu harwalatan ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanaa qutaybatu ibnu sa'eedin, haddathanaa al-mugheeratu ibnu 'abdi ar-rahmani, 'an abee az-zinaadi, 'ani al-a'raji, 'an abee hurayrata, anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ yaqoolu Allah idhaa araada 'abdee an ya'mala sayyi'atan fala taktuboohaa 'alayhi hattaa ya'malahaa, fa'in 'amilahaa faaktuboohaa bimithlihaa wa'in tarakahaa min ajlee faaktuboohaa lahu hasanatan wa'idhaa araada an ya'mala hasanatan falam ya'malhaa faaktuboohaa lahu hasanatan, fa'in 'amilahaa faaktuboohaa lahu bi'ashri amthaalihaa ilaa sab'imi'atin ‏"‏‏.‏

haddathanee muhammadu ibnu 'ubaydin al-ghubariyyu, wa'aboo kaamilin al-jahdariyyu wa'ahmadu ibnu 'abdata qaaloo haddathanaa hammaadu ibnu zaydin, 'an matarin al-warraaqi, 'an 'abdi Allah ibni buraydata, 'an yahyaa ibni ya'mara, qaala lammaa takallama ma'badun bimaa takallama bihi fee sha'ani al-qadari ankarnaa dhalika ‏.‏ qaala fahajajtu anaa wahumaydu ibnu 'abdi ar-rahmani al-himyariyyu hijjatan ‏.‏ wasaaqoo al-hadeetha bima'naa hadeethi kahmasin wa'isnaadihi ‏.‏ wafeehi ba'du ziyaadatin wanuqsaanu ahrufin ‏.‏

wahaddathanee muhammadu ibnu haatimin, haddathanaa yahyaa ibnu sa'eedin al-qattaanu, haddathanaa 'uthmaanu ibnu ghiyaathin, haddathanaa 'abdu Allah ibnu buraydata, 'an yahyaa ibni ya'mara, wahumaydi ibni 'abdi ar-rahmani, qaala laqeenaa 'abda Allah ibna 'umara fadhakarnaa al-qadara wamaa yaqooloona feehi ‏.‏ faaqtassa al-hadeetha kanahwi hadeethihim 'an 'umara - radiya Allah 'anhu - 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam wafeehi shaa'un min ziyaadatin waqad naqasa minhu shay'an ‏.‏

haddathanee yahyaa ibnu ayyooba, waqutaybatu ibnu sa'eedin, jamee'an 'an ismaa'eela ibni ja'farin, 'an abee suhaylin, 'an abeehi, 'an talhata ibni 'ubaydi Allah, 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam bihadhaa al-hadeethi nahwa hadeethi maalikin ghayra annahu qaala faqaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏"‏ aflaha wa'abeehi in sadaqa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ aw ‏"‏ dakhala al-jannata wa'abeehi in sadaqa ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanee 'abdu Allah ibnu haashimin al-'abdiyyu, haddathanaa bahzun, haddathanaa sulaymaanu ibnu al-mugheerati, 'an thaabitin, qaala qaala anasun kunnaa nuheenaa fee al-qur'aani an nas'ala rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam 'an shaa'in ‏.‏ wasaaqa al-hadeetha bimithlihi ‏.‏

haddathanaa yahyaa ibnu yahyaa at-tameemiyyu, akhbaranaa aboo al-ahwasi, (h) wahaddathanaa aboo bakri ibnu abee shaybata, haddathanaa aboo al-ahwasi, 'an abee ishaaqa, 'an moosaa ibni talhata, 'an abee ayyooba, qaala jaa'a rajulun ilaa an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam faqaala dullanee 'alaa 'amalin a'maluhu yudneenee mina al-jannati wayubaa'idunee mina an-naari ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ ta'budu Allah la tushriku bihi shay'an watuqeemu as-salata watu'tee az-zakaata watasilu dhaa rahimika ‏"‏ falammaa adbara qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏"‏ in tamassaka bimaa umira bihi dakhala al-jannata ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wafee riwaayati ibni abee shaybata ‏"‏ in tamassaka bihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa aboo bakri ibnu abee shaybata, wa'aboo kuraybin - wal-lafzu l'abee kuraybin - qaala haddathanaa aboo mu'aawiyata, 'ani al-a'mashi, 'an abee sufyaana, 'an jaabirin, qaala ataa an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam an-nu'maanu ibnu qawqalin faqaala yaa rasoola Allah ara'ayta idhaa sallaytu al-maktoobata waharramtu al-haraama wa'ahlaltu al-halala a'adkhulu al-jannata faqaala an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ na'am ‏"‏ ‏.‏

wahaddathanee salamatu ibnu shabeebin, haddathanaa al-hasanu ibnu a'yana, haddathanaa ma'qilun, - wahuwa ibnu 'ubaydi Allah - 'an abee az-zubayri, 'an jaabirin, anna rajulan, sa'ala rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam faqaala ara'ayta idhaa sallaytu as-salawaati al-maktoobaati wasumtu ramadaana wa'ahlaltu al-halala waharramtu al-haraama walam azid 'alaa dhalika shay'an a'adkhulu al-jannata qaala ‏ "‏ na'am ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala wal-lahi la azeedu 'alaa dhalika shay'an ‏.‏

haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu 'abdi Allah ibni numayrin al-hamdaaniyyu, haddathanaa aboo khaalidin, - ya'nee sulaymaana ibna hayyaana al-ahmara - 'an abee maalikin al-ashja'iyyi, 'an sa'di ibni 'ubaydata, 'ani ibni 'umara, 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ buniya al-islamu 'alaa khamsatin 'alaa an yuwahhada Allah wa'iqaami as-salati wa'eetaa'i az-zakaati wasiyaami ramadaana wal-hajji ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala rajulun al-hajji wasiyaami ramadaana qaala la ‏.‏ siyaami ramadaana wal-hajji ‏.‏ hakadhaa sami'tuhu min rasooli Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏.‏

wahaddathanaa sahlu ibnu 'uthmaana al-'askariyyu, haddathanaa yahyaa ibnu zakariyyaa'a, haddathanaa sa'du ibnu taariqin, qaala haddathanee sa'du ibnu 'ubaydata as-sulamiyyu, 'ani ibni 'umara, 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ buniya al-islamu 'alaa khamsin 'alaa an yu'bada Allah wayukfara bimaa doonahu wa'iqaami as-salati wa'eetaa'i az-zakaati wahajji al-bayti wasawmi ramadaana ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu yahyaa ibni abee 'umara al-makkiyyu, wabishru ibnu al-hakami, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu al-'azeezi, - wahuwa ibnu muhammadin - ad-daraawardiyyu 'an yazeeda ibni al-haadi, 'an muhammadi ibni ibraaheema, 'an 'aamiri ibni sa'din, 'ani al-'abbaasi ibni 'abdi al-muttalibi, annahu sami'a rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam yaqoolu ‏ "‏ dhaaqa ta'ma al-eemaani man radiya bil-lahi rabban wabil'islami deenan wabimuhammadin rasoolan ‏"‏ ‏‏

haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu al-muthannaa, wamuhammadu ibnu bashshaarin, - wal-lafzu libni al-muthannaa - qaala haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'batu, 'an qataadata, qaala sami'tu abaa as-sawwaari, yuhaddithu annahu sami'a 'imraana ibna husaynin, yuhaddithu 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam annahu qaala ‏ "‏ al-hayaa'u la ya'atee ila bikhayrin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala bushayru ibnu ka'bin innahu maktoobun fee al-hikmati anna minhu waqaaran waminhu sakeenatan ‏.‏ faqaala 'imraanu uhaddithuka 'an rasooli Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam watuhaddithunee 'an suhufika ‏.‏

haddathanaa aboo bakri ibnu abee shaybata, haddathanaa aboo mu'aawiyata, wawakee'un, 'ani al-a'mashi, 'an abee saalihin, 'an abee hurayrata, qaala qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ la tadkhuloona al-jannata hattaa tu'minoo wala tu'minoo hattaa tahaabboo ‏.‏ awala adullukum 'alaa shaa'in idhaa fa'altumoohu tahaababtum afshoo as-salama baynakum ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu 'abbaadin al-makkiyyu, haddathanaa sufyaanu, qaala qultu lisuhaylin inna 'amran haddathanaa 'ani al-qa'qaa'i, 'an abeeka, qaala warajawtu an yusqita, 'annee rajulan qaala faqaala sami'tuhu mina alladhee sami'ahu minhu abee kaana sadeeqan lahu bish-shaami thumma haddathanaa sufyaanu 'an suhaylin 'an 'ataa'i ibni yazeeda 'an tameemin ad-daariyyi anna an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏"‏ ad-deenu an-naseehatu ‏"‏ qulnaa liman qaala ‏"‏ lillah walikitaabihi walirasoolihi wal'a'immati al-muslimeena wa'aammatihim ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa 'uthmaanu ibnu abee shaybata, haddathanaa jareerun, 'ani al-hasani ibni 'ubaydi Allah, 'an abee 'amrinw ash-shaybaaniyyi, 'an 'abdi Allah, 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ afdalu al-a'maali - awi al-'amali - as-salatu liwaqtihaa wabirru al-waalidayni ‏"‏ ‏.‏

wahaddathanaa muhammadu ibnu bashshaarin, haddathanaa aboo daawuda, haddathanaa shu'batu, 'an abaana ibni taghliba, 'an fudaylin, 'an ibraaheema, 'an 'alqamata, 'an 'abdi Allah, 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ la yadkhulu al-jannata man kaana fee qalbihi mithqaalu dharratin min kibrin ‏"‏ ‏.‏

wahaddathanaa muhammadu ibnu al-muthannaa, waabnu, bashshaarin qaala ibnu al-muthannaa haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'batu, 'an waasilin al-ahdabi, 'ani al-ma'roori ibni suwaydin, qaala sami'tu abaa dharrin, yuhaddithu 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam annahu qaala ‏"‏ ataanee jibreelu - 'alayhi as-salamu - fabashsharanee annahu man maata min ummatika la yushriku bil-lahi shay'an dakhala al-jannata ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qultu wa'in zanaa wa'in saraqa ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ wa'in zanaa wa'in saraqa ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu 'abbaadin, waabnu abee 'umara, jamee'an 'an marwaana al-fazaariyyi, qaala ibnu 'abbaadin haddathanaa marwaanu, 'an yazeeda, - ya'nee ibna kaysaana - 'an abee haazimin, 'an abee hurayrata, qaala qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ bada'a al-islamu ghareeban wasaya'oodu kamaa bada'a ghareeban fatoobaa lilghurabaa'i ‏"‏ ‏.‏

wahaddathanaa 'ubaydu Allah ibnu 'umara al-qawaareeriyyu, wamuhammadu ibnu abee bakri al-muqaddamiyyu, wamuhammadu ibnu 'abdi al-maliki al-umawiyyu, qaaloo haddathanaa aboo 'awaanata, 'an 'abdi al-maliki ibni 'umayrin, 'an 'abdi Allah ibni al-haarithi ibni nawfalin, 'ani al-'abbaasi ibni 'abdi al-muttalibi, annahu qaala yaa rasoola Allah hal nafa'ta abaa taalibin bishaa'in fa'innahu kaana yahootuka wayaghdabu laka qaala ‏ "‏ na'am huwa fee dahdaahin min naarin walawla anaa lakaana fee ad-darki al-asfali mina an-naari ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa ibnu abee 'umara, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'abdi al-maliki ibni 'umayrin, 'an 'abdi Allah ibni al-haarithi, qaala sami'tu al-'abbaasa, yaqoolu qultu yaa rasoola Allah inna abaa taalibin kaana yahootuka wayansuruka fahal nafa'ahu dhalika qaala ‏ "‏ na'am wajadtuhu fee ghamaraatin mina an-naari fa'akhrajtuhu ilaa dahdaahin ‏"‏ ‏.‏

wahaddathanaa qutaybatu ibnu sa'eedin, haddathanaa laythun, 'ani ibni al-haadi, 'an 'abdi Allah ibni khabbaabin, 'an abee sa'eedin al-khudriyyi, anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam dhukira 'indahu 'ammuhu aboo taalibin faqaala ‏ "‏ la'allahu tanfa'uhu shafaa'atee yawma al-qiyaamati fayuj'alu fee dahdaahin min naarin yablughu ka'bayhi yaghlee minhu dimaaghuhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa aboo bakri ibnu abee shaybata, haddathanaa yahyaa ibnu abee bukayrin, haddathanaa zuhayru ibnu muhammadin, 'an suhayli ibni abee saalihin, 'ani an-nu'maani ibni abee 'ayyaashin, 'an abee sa'eedin al-khudriyyi, anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ inna adnaa ahli an-naari 'adhaaban yanta'ilu bina'layni min naarin yaghlee dimaaghuhu min haraarati na'layhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏

wahaddathanaa aboo bakri ibnu abee shaybata, haddathanaa 'affaanu, haddathanaa hammaadu ibnu salamata, haddathanaa thaabitun, 'an abee 'uthmaana an-nahdiyyi, 'ani ibni 'abbaasin, anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ ahwanu ahli an-naari 'adhaaban aboo taalibin wahuwa munta'ilun bina'layni yaghlee minhumaa dimaaghuhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏

wahaddathanaa muhammadu ibnu al-muthannaa, waabnu, bashshaarin - wal-lafzu libni al-muthannaa - qaala haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'batu, qaala sami'tu abaa ishaaqa, yaqoolu sami'tu an-nu'maana ibna basheerin, yakhtubu wahwa yaqoolu sami'tu rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam yaqoolu ‏ "‏ inna ahwana ahli an-naari 'adhaaban yawma al-qiyaamati larajulun tooda'u fee akhmasi qadamayhi jamrataani yaghlee minhumaa dimaaghuhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏

wahaddathanaa aboo bakri ibnu abee shaybata, haddathanaa aboo usaamata, 'ani al-a'mashi, 'an abee ishaaqa, 'ani an-nu'maani ibni basheerin, qaala qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ inna ahwana ahli an-naari 'adhaaban man lahu na'lani washiraakaani min naarin yaghlee minhumaa dimaaghuhu kamaa yaghlee al-mirjalu maa yaraa anna ahadan ashaddu minhu 'adhaaban wa'innahu l'ahwanuhum 'adhaaban ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanee aboo bakri ibnu abee shaybata, haddathanaa hafsu ibnu ghiyaathin, 'an daawuda, 'ani ash-sha'biyyi, 'an masrooqin, 'an 'aa'ishata, qaalat qultu yaa rasoola Allah ibnu jud'aana kaana fee al-jaahiliyyati yasilu ar-rahima wayut'imu al-miskeena fahal dhaaka naafi'uhu qaala ‏ "‏ la yanfa'uhu innahu lam yaqul yawman rabbi ighfir lee khatee'atee yawma ad-deeni ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanee ahmadu ibnu hanbalin, haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'batu, 'an ismaa'eela ibni abee khaalidin, 'an qaysin, 'an 'amriw ibni al-'aasi, qaala sami'tu rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam jihaaran ghayra sirrin yaqoolu ‏ "‏ ala inna 'aala abee - ya'nee fulanan - laysoo lee bi'awliyaa'a innamaa waliyyiya Allah wasaalihu al-mu'mineena ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa 'abdu ar-rahmani ibnu salami ibni 'ubaydi Allah al-jumahiyyu, haddathanaa ar-rabee'u, - ya'nee ibna muslimin - 'an muhammadi ibni ziyaadin, 'an abee hurayrata, anna an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏"‏ yadkhulu min ummatee al-jannata sab'oona alfan bighayri hisaabin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala rajulun yaa rasoola Allah id'u Allah an yaj'alanee minhum ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ al-lahumma ij'alhu minhum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma qaama 'aakharu faqaala yaa rasoola Allah id'u Allah an yaj'alanee minhum ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ sabaqaka bihaa 'ukkaashatu ‏"‏ ‏.‏

wahaddathanaa muhammadu ibnu bashshaarin, haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'batu, qaala sami'tu muhammada ibna ziyaadin, qaala sami'tu abaa hurayrata, yaqoolu sami'tu rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam yaqoolu ‏.‏ bimithli hadeethi ar-rabee'i ‏.‏

haddathanaa ishaaqu ibnu mansoorin, haddathanaa habbaanu ibnu hilalin, haddathanaa abaanun, haddathanaa yahyaa, anna zaydan, haddathahu anna abaa salamin haddathahu 'an abee maalikin al-ash'ariyyi, qaala qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ at-tuhooru shatru al-eemaani wal-hamdu lillah taml'u al-meezaana ‏.‏ wasubhaana Allah wal-hamdu lillah taml'aani - aw taml'u - maa bayna as-samawaati wal-ardi was-salatu noorun was-sadaqatu burhaanun was-sabru diyaa'un wal-qur'aanu hujjatun laka aw 'alayka kullu an-naasi yaghdoo fabaa'i'un nafsahu famu'tiquhaa aw moobiquhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa yahyaa ibnu ayyooba, waqutaybatu ibnu sa'eedin, wa'aliyyu ibnu hujrin, kulluhum 'an ismaa'eela, - qaala ibnu ayyooba haddathanaa ismaa'eelu ibnu ja'farin, - akhbaranee al-'ala'u ibnu 'abdi ar-rahmani ibni ya'qooba, mawlaa al-huraqati 'an abeehi, 'an abee hurayrata, anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ as-salatu al-khamsu wal-jumu'atu ilaa al-jumu'ati kaffaaratun limaa baynahunna maa lam tughsha al-kabaa'iru ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa suwaydu ibnu sa'eedin, 'an maaliki ibni anasin, (h) wahaddathanaa aboo at-taahiri, - wal-lafzu lahu - akhbaranaa 'abdu Allah ibnu wahbin, 'an maaliki ibni anasin, 'an suhayli ibni abee saalihin, 'an abeehi, 'an abee hurayrata, anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ idhaa tawadda'a al-'abdu al-muslimu - awi al-mu'minu - faghasala wajhahu kharaja min wajhihi kullu khatee'atin nazara ilayhaa bi'aynayhi ma'a al-maa'i - aw ma'a 'aakhiri qatri al-maa'i - fa'idhaa ghasala yadayhi kharaja min yadayhi kullu khatee'atin kaana batashathaa yadaahu ma'a al-maa'i - aw ma'a 'aakhiri qatri al-maa'i - fa'idhaa ghasala rijlayhi kharajat kullu khatee'atin mashathaa rijlahu ma'a al-maa'i - aw ma'a 'aakhiri qatri al-maa'i - hattaa yakhruja naqiyyan mina adh-dhunoobi ‏"‏ ‏.‏

wahaddathanee zuhayru ibnu harbin, haddathanaa yahyaa, - ya'nee ibna sa'eedin - 'an hammaadi ibni salamata, haddathanaa thaabitun, 'an anasi ibni maalikin, qaala kaana rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam yugheeru idhaa tala'a al-fajru wakaana yastami'u al-adhaana fa'in sami'a adhaanan amsaka wa'ila aghaara fasami'a rajulan yaqoolu Allah akbaru Allah akbaru ‏.‏ faqaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏"‏ 'alaa al-fitrati ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma qaala ashhadu an la ilaha ila Allah ashhadu an la ilaha ila Allah ‏.‏ faqaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏"‏ kharajta mina an-naari ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fanazaroo fa'idhaa huwa raa'ee mi'zana ‏.‏

haddathanee yahyaa ibnu yahyaa, qaala qara'atu 'alaa maalikin 'ani ibni shihaabin, 'an 'ataa'i ibni yazeeda al-laythiyyi, 'an abee sa'eedin al-khudriyyi, anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ idhaa sami'tumu an-nidaa'a faqooloo mithla maa yaqoolu al-mu'adhdhinu ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu salamata al-muraadiyyu, haddathanaa 'abdu Allah ibnu wahbin, 'an haywata, wasa'eedi ibni abee ayyooba, waghayrihimaa, 'an ka'bi ibni 'alqamata, 'an 'abdi ar-rahmani ibni jubayrin, 'an 'abdi Allah ibni 'amriw ibni al-'aasi, annahu sami'a an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam yaqoolu ‏ "‏ idhaa sami'tumu al-mu'adhdhina faqooloo mithla maa yaqoolu thumma salloo 'alaa fa'innahu man salla 'alaa salatan salla Allah 'alayhi bihaa 'ashran thumma saloo Allah liya al-waseelata fa'innahaa manzilatun fee al-jannati la tanbaghee ila li'abdin min 'ibaadi Allah wa'arjoo an akoona anaa huwa faman sa'ala liya al-waseelata hallat lahu ash-shafaa'atu ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu rumhin, akhbaranaa al-laythu, 'ani al-hukaymi ibni 'abdi Allah ibni qaysin al-qurashiyyi, (h) wahaddathanaa qutaybatu ibnu sa'eedin, haddathanaa laythun, 'ani al-hukaymi ibni 'abdi Allah, 'an 'aamiri ibni sa'di ibni abee waqqaasin, 'an sa'di ibni abee waqqaasin, 'an rasooli Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam annahu qaala ‏"‏ man qaala heena yasma'u al-mu'adhdhina ashhadu an la ilaha ila Allah wahdahu la shareeka lahu wa'anna muhammadan 'abduhu warasooluhu radeetu bil-lahi rabban wabimuhammadin rasoolan wabil'islami deenan ‏.‏ ghufira lahu dhanbuhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala ibnu rumhin fee riwaayatihi ‏"‏ man qaala heena yasma'u al-mu'adhdhina wa'anaa ashhadu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ walam yadhkur qutaybatu qawlahu wa'anaa ‏.‏

haddathanaa qutaybatu ibnu sa'eedin, wa'uthmaanu ibnu abee shaybata, wa'ishaaqu ibnu ibraaheema, qaala ishaaqu akhbaranaa waqaala al-'aakharaani, haddathanaa jareerun, 'ani al-a'mashi, 'an abee sufyaana, 'an jaabirin, qaala sami'tu an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam yaqoolu ‏ "‏ inna ash-shaytaana idhaa sami'a an-nidaa'a bis-salati dhahaba hattaa yakoona makaana ar-rawhaa'i ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala sulaymaanu fasa'altuhu 'ani ar-rawhaa'i ‏.‏ faqaala hiya mina al-madeenati sittatun wathalathoona meelan ‏.‏

haddathanaa qutaybatu ibnu sa'eedin, wazuhayru ibnu harbin, wa'ishaaqu ibnu ibraaheema, - wal-lafzu liqutaybata - qaala ishaaqu akhbaranaa waqaala al-'aakharaani, haddathanaa jareerun, 'ani al-a'mashi, 'an abee saalihin, 'an abee hurayrata, 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ inna ash-shaytaana idhaa sami'a an-nidaa'a bis-salati ahaala lahu duraatun hattaa la yasma'a sawtahu fa'idhaa sakata raja'a fawaswasa fa'idhaa sami'a al-iqaamata dhahaba hattaa la yasma'a sawtahu fa'idhaa sakata raja'a fawaswasa ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanee 'abdu al-hameedi ibnu bayaanin al-waasitiyyu, haddathanaa khaalidun, - ya'nee ibna 'abdi Allah - 'an suhaylin, 'an abeehi, 'an abee hurayrata, qaala qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ idhaa adhdhana al-mu'adhdhinu adbara ash-shaytaanu walahu husaasun ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanee umayyatu ibnu bistaama, haddathanaa yazeedu, - ya'nee ibna zuray'in - haddathanaa rawhun, 'an suhaylin, qaala arsalanee abee ilaa banee haarithata - qaala - wama'ee ghulamun lanaa - aw saahibun lanaa - fanaadaahu munaadin min haa'itin bismihi - qaala - wa'ashrafa alladhee ma'ee 'alaa al-haa'iti falam yara shay'an fadhakartu dhalika l'abee faqaala law sha'artu annaka talqaa hadhaa lam ursilka walakin idhaa sami'ta sawtan fanaadi bis-salati fa'innee sami'tu abaa hurayrata yuhaddithu 'an rasooli Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam annahu qaala ‏ "‏ inna ash-shaytaana idhaa noodiya bis-salati wallaa walahu husaasun ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa qutaybatu ibnu sa'eedin, haddathanaa al-mugheeratu, - ya'nee al-hizaamiyya - 'an abee az-zinaadi, 'ani al-a'raji, 'an abee hurayrata, anna an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ idhaa noodiya lilssalati adbara ash-shaytaanu lahu duraatun hattaa la yasma'a at-ta'adheena fa'idhaa qudiya at-ta'adheenu aqbala hattaa idhaa thuwwiba bis-salati adbara hattaa idhaa qudiya at-tathweebu aqbala hattaa yakhtira bayna al-mar'i wanafsihi yaqoolu lahu idhkur kadhaa waadhkur kadhaa limaa lam yakun yadhkuru min qablu hattaa yazalla ar-rajulu maa yadree kam salla ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa yahyaa ibnu yahyaa at-tameemiyyu, wasa'eedu ibnu mansoorin, wa'aboo bakri ibnu abee shaybata wa'amrunw an-naaqidu wazuhayru ibnu harbin waabnu numayrin kulluhum 'an sufyaana ibni 'uyaynata, - wal-lafzu liyahyaa qaala akhbaranaa sufyaanu ibnu 'uyaynata, - 'ani az-zuhriyyi, 'an saalimin, 'an abeehi, qaala ra'aytu rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam idhaa iftataha as-salata rafa'a yadayhi hattaa yuhaadhiya mankibayhi waqabla an yarka'a wa'idhaa rafa'a mina ar-rukoo'i wala yarfa'uhumaa bayna as-sajdatayni ‏.‏

haddathanee muhammadu ibnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu ar-razzaaqi, akhbaranaa ibnu jurayjin, haddathanee ibnu shihaabin, 'an saalimi ibni 'abdi Allah, anna ibna 'umara, qaala kaana rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam idhaa qaama lilssalati rafa'a yadayhi hattaa takoonaa hadhwa mankibayhi thumma kabbara fa'idhaa araada an yarka'a fa'ala mithla dhalika wa'idhaa rafa'a mina ar-rukoo'i fa'ala mithla dhalika wala yaf'aluhu heena yarfa'u ra'asahu mina as-sujoodi ‏.‏

wahaddathanaa haaroonu ibnu ma'roofin, wa'amroo ibnu sawwaadin, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu Allah ibnu wahbin, 'an 'amriw ibni al-haarithi, 'an 'umaarata ibni ghaziyyata, 'an sumaa, mawlaa abee bakrin annahu sami'a abaa saalihin, dhakwaana yuhaddithu 'an abee hurayrata, anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ aqrabu maa yakoonu al-'abdu min rabbihi wahuwa saajidun fa'akthiroo ad-du'aa'a ‏"‏ ‏.‏

wahaddathanee qutaybatu ibnu sa'eedin, haddathanaa al-fazaariyyu, 'an 'ubaydi Allah ibni al-asammi, haddathanaa yazeedu ibnu al-asammi, 'an abee hurayrata, anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ la'ana Allah al-yahooda wan-nasaaraa attakhadhoo quboora anbiyaa'ihim masaajida ‏"‏ ‏.‏

wahaddathanee haaroonu ibnu sa'eedin al-ayliyyu, waharmalatu ibnu yahyaa, qaala harmalatu akhbaranaa waqaala, haaroonu haddathanaa ibnu wahbin, akhbaranee yoonusu, 'ani ibni shihaabin, akhbaranee 'ubaydu Allah ibnu 'abdi Allah, anna 'aa'ishata, wa'abda Allah ibna 'abbaasin, qaala lammaa nazalat birasooli Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam tafiqa yatrahu khameesatan lahu 'alaa wajhihi fa'idhaa ightamma kashafahaa 'an wajhihi faqaala wahuwa kadhalika ‏ "‏ la'natu Allah 'alaa al-yahoodi wan-nasaaraa attakhadhoo quboora anbiyaa'ihim masaajida ‏"‏ ‏.‏ yuhadhdhiru mithla maa sana'oo ‏.‏

haddathanaa aboo bakri ibnu abee shaybata, wa'ishaaqu ibnu ibraaheema, - wal-lafzu l'abee bakrin - qaala ishaaqu akhbaranaa waqaala aboo bakrin, haddathanaa zakariyyaa'u ibnu 'adiyyin, 'an 'ubaydi Allah ibni 'amrinw, 'an zaydi ibni abee unaysata, 'an 'amriw ibni murrata, 'an 'abdi Allah ibni al-haarithi an-najraaniyyi, qaala haddathanee jundabun, qaala sami'tu an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qabla an yamoota bikhamsin wahuwa yaqoolu ‏ "‏ innee abra'u ilaa Allah an yakoona lee minkum khaleelun fa'inna Allah ta'aalaa qadi attakhadhanee khaleelan kamaa attakhadha ibraaheema khaleelan walaw kuntu muttakhidhan min ummatee khaleelan lattakhadhtu abaa bakrin khaleelan ala wa'inna man kaana qablakum kaanoo yattakhidhoona quboora anbiyaa'ihim wasaaliheehim masaajida ala fala tattakhidhoo al-quboora masaajida innee anhaakum 'an dhalika ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanee haaroonu ibnu sa'eedin al-ayliyyu, wa'ahmadu ibnu 'eesaa, qaala haddathanaa ibnu wahbin, akhbaranee 'amrunw, anna bukayran, haddathahu anna 'aasima ibna 'umara ibni qataadata haddathahu annahu, sami'a 'ubayda Allah al-khawlaniyya, yadhkuru annahu sami'a 'uthmaana ibna 'affaana, 'inda qawli an-naasi feehi heena banaa masjida ar-rasooli salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏.‏ innakum qad akthartum wa'innee sami'tu rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam yaqoolu ‏"‏ man banaa masjidan lillah ta'aalaa - qaala bukayrun hasibtu annahu qaala - yabtaghee bihi wajha Allah - banaa Allah lahu baytan fee al-jannati ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waqaala ibnu 'eesaa fee riwaayatihi ‏"‏ mithlahu fee al-jannati ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa zuhayru ibnu harbin, wamuhammadu ibnu al-muthannaa, - wal-lafzu libni al-muthannaa - qaala haddathanaa ad-dahhaaku ibnu makhladin, akhbaranaa 'abdu al-hameedi ibnu ja'farin, haddathanee abee, 'an mahmoodi ibni labeedin, anna 'uthmaana ibna 'affaana, araada binaa'a al-masjidi fakariha an-naasu dhalika fa'ahabboo an yada'ahu 'alaa hay'atihi faqaala sami'tu rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam yaqoolu ‏ "‏ man banaa masjidan lillah banaa Allah lahu fee al-jannati mithlahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa 'abdu Allah ibnu 'abdi ar-rahmani ad-daarimiyyu, akhbaranaa 'ubaydu Allah ibnu moosaa, 'an israa'eela, 'an mansoorin, 'an ibraaheema, 'an 'alqamata, wal-aswadi, annahumaa dakhala 'alaa 'abdi Allah faqaala asallaa man khalfakum qaala na'am ‏.‏ faqaama baynahumaa waja'ala ahadahumaa 'an yameenihi wal-'aakhara 'an shimaalihi thumma raka'naa fawada'naa aydiyanaa 'alaa rukabinaa fadaraba aydiyanaa thumma tabbaqa bayna yadayhi thumma ja'alahumaa bayna fakhidhayhi falammaa salla qaala hakadhaa fa'ala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏.‏

haddathanaa qutaybatu ibnu sa'eedin, wa'aboo kaamilin al-jahdariyyu - wal-lafzu liqutaybata - qaala haddathanaa aboo 'awaanata, 'an abee ya'foorin, 'an mus'abi ibni sa'din, qaala sallaytu ilaa janbi abee qaala waja'altu yadaa bayna rukbataa faqaala lee abee idrib bikaffayka 'alaa rukbatayka ‏.‏ qaala thumma fa'altu dhalika marratan ukhraa fadaraba yadaa waqaala innaa nuheenaa 'an hadhaa wa'umirnaa an nadriba bil-akuffi 'alaa ar-rukabi ‏.‏

haddathanaa aboo bakri ibnu abee shaybata, haddathanaa wakee'un, 'an ismaa'eela ibni abee khaalidin, 'ani az-zubayri ibni 'adiyyin, 'an mus'abi ibni sa'din, qaala raka'tu faqultu biyadaa hakadhaa - ya'nee tabbaqa bihimaa wawada'ahumaa bayna fakhidhayhi - faqaala abee qad kunnaa naf'alu hadhaa thumma umirnaa bir-rukabi ‏.‏

haddathanee al-hakamu ibnu moosaa, haddathanaa 'eesaa ibnu yoonusa, haddathanaa ismaa'eelu ibnu abee khaalidin, 'ani az-zubayri ibni 'adiyyin, 'ani mus'abi ibni sa'di ibni abee waqqaasin, qaala sallaytu ilaa janbi abee falammaa raka'tu shabbaktu asaabi'ee waja'altuhumaa bayna rukbataa fadaraba yadaa falammaa salla qaala qad kunnaa naf'alu hadhaa thumma umirnaa an narfa'a ilaa ar-rukabi ‏.‏

haddathanaa ishaaqu ibnu ibraaheema, akhbaranaa muhammadu ibnu bakrin, (h) qaala wahaddathanaa hasanun al-hulwaaniyyu, haddathanaa 'abdu ar-razzaaqi, - wataqaarabaa fee al-lafzi - qaala jamee'an akhbaranaa ibnu jurayjin akhbaranee aboo az-zubayri annahu sami'a taawusan yaqoolu qulnaa libni 'abbaasin fee al-iq'aa'i 'alaa al-qadamayni faqaala hiya as-sunnatu ‏.‏ faqulnaa lahu innaa lanaraahu jafaa'an bir-rajuli ‏.‏ faqaala ibnu 'abbaasin bal hiya sunnatu nabiyyika salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏.‏

wahaddathanaahu ibnu abee 'umara, haddathanaa 'abdu al-wahhaabi, 'an ayyooba, qaala qaala lee aboo qilabata haddathanaa maaliku ibnu al-huwayrithi aboo sulaymaana, qaala ataytu rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam fee naasin wanahnu shababatun mutaqaariboona ‏.‏ waaqtassaa jamee'an al-hadeetha binahwi hadeethi ibni 'ulayyata ‏.‏

wahaddathanaa ishaaqu ibnu ibraaheema al-hanzaliyyu, akhbaranaa 'abdu al-wahhaabi ath-thaqafiyyu, 'an khaalidin al-hadhdhaa'i, 'an abee qilabata, 'an maaliki ibni al-huwayrithi, qaala ataytu an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam anaa wasaahibun lee falammaa aradnaa al-iqfaala min 'indihi qaala lanaa ‏ "‏ idhaa hadarati as-salatu fa'adhdhinaa thumma aqeemaa walya'ummakumaa akbarukumaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu al-muthannaa, haddathanaa mu'aadhu ibnu hishaamin, haddathanee abee, 'an yahyaa ibni abee katheerin, qaala haddathanaa aboo salamata ibnu 'abdi ar-rahmani, annahu sami'a abaa hurayrata, yaqoolu wal-lahi l'uqarribanna bikum salata rasooli Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏.‏ fakaana aboo hurayrata yaqnutu fee az-zuhri wal-'ishaa'i al-'aakhirati wasalati as-subhi wayad'oo lilmu'mineena wayal'anu al-kuffaara ‏.‏

wahaddathanaa yahyaa ibnu yahyaa, qaala qara'atu 'alaa maalikin 'an ishaaqa ibni 'abdi Allah ibni abee talhata, 'an anasi ibni maalikin, qaala da'aa rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam 'alaa alladheena qataloo ashaaba bi'ri ma'oonata thalatheena sabaahan yad'oo 'alaa ri'lin wadhakwaana walihyaana wa'usayyata 'asati Allah warasoolahu ‏.‏ qaala anasun anzala Allah 'azza wajalla fee alladheena qutiloo bibi'ri ma'oonata qur'aanan qara'anaahu hattaa nusikha ba'du an ballighoo qawmanaa an qad laqeenaa rabbanaa faradiya 'annaa waradeenaa 'anhu ‏.‏

wahaddathanee 'amrunw an-naaqidu, wazuhayru ibnu harbin, qaala haddathanaa ismaa'eelu, 'an ayyooba, 'an muhammadin, qaala qultu l'anasin hal qanata rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam fee salati as-subhi qaala na'am ba'da ar-rukoo'i yaseeran ‏.‏

wahaddathanee 'ubaydu Allah ibnu mu'aadhin al-'anbariyyu, wa'aboo kuraybin wa'ishaaqu ibnu ibraaheema wamuhammadu ibnu 'abdi al-a'laa - wal-lafzu libni mu'aadhin - haddathanaa al-mu'tamiru ibnu sulaymaana, 'an abeehi, 'an abee mijlazin, 'an anasi ibni maalikin, qanata rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam shahran ba'da ar-rukoo'i fee salati as-subhi yad'oo 'alaa ri'lin wadhakwaana wayaqoolu ‏ "‏ 'usayyatu 'asati Allah warasoolahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏

wahaddathanee muhammadu ibnu haatimin, haddathanaa bahzu ibnu asadin, haddathanaa hammaadu ibnu salamata, akhbaranaa anasu ibnu seereena, 'an anasi ibni maalikin, anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qanata shahran ba'da ar-rukoo'i fee salati al-fajri yad'oo 'alaa banee 'usayyata ‏.‏

wahaddathanaa aboo bakri ibnu abee shaybata, wa'aboo kuraybin qaala haddathanaa aboo mu'aawiyata, 'an 'aasimin, 'an anasin, qaala sa'altuhu 'ani al-qunooti, qabla ar-rukoo'i aw ba'da ar-rukoo'i faqaala qabla ar-rukoo'i ‏.‏ qaala qultu fa'inna naasan yaz'umoona anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qanata ba'da ar-rukoo'i ‏.‏ faqaala innamaa qanata rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam shahran yad'oo 'alaa unaasin qataloo unaasan min ashaabihi yuqaalu lahumu al-qurraa'u ‏.‏

haddathanaa 'abdu Allah ibnu barraadin al-ash'ariyyu, wamuhammadu ibnu al-'ala'i, qaala haddathanaa aboo usaamata, 'an buraydin, 'an abee burdata, 'an abee moosaa, 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ mathalu al-bayti alladhee yudhkaru Allah feehi wal-bayti alladhee la yudhkaru Allah feehi mathalu al-haa wal-mayyiti ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa qutaybatu ibnu sa'eedin, wamuhammadu ibnu 'ubaydin al-ghubariyyu, jamee'an 'an abee 'awaanata, - qaala ibnu 'ubaydin haddathanaa aboo 'awaanata, - 'an qataadata, 'an zuraarata ibni awfaa, 'an sa'di ibni hishaamin, 'an 'aa'ishata, qaalat qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ al-maahiru bil-qur'aani ma'a as-safarati al-kiraami al-bararati waalladhee yaqra'u al-qur'aana wayatata'ta'u feehi wahuwa 'alayhi shaaqqun lahu ajraani ‏"‏ ‏.‏

wahaddathanaa aboo bakri ibnu abee shaybata, wa'aboo kuraybin jamee'an 'an hafsin, - qaala aboo bakrin haddathanaa hafsu ibnu ghiyaathin, - 'ani al-a'mashi, 'an ibraaheema, 'an 'ubaydata, 'an 'abdi Allah, qaala qaala lee rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏"‏ iqra'a 'alaa al-qur'aana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faqultu yaa rasoola Allah aqra'u 'alayka wa'alayka unzila qaala ‏"‏ innee ashtahee an asma'ahu min ghayree ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqara'atu an-nisaa'a hattaa idhaa balaghtu ‏{‏ fakayfa idhaa ji'naa min kulli ummatin bishaheedin waji'naa bika 'alaa ha'ula'i shaheedan‏}‏ rafa'tu ra'asee aw ghamazanee rajulun ilaa janbee farafa'tu ra'asee fara'aytu dumoo'ahu taseelu ‏.‏

haddathanaa aboo bakri ibnu abee shaybata, wa'aboo sa'eedin al-ashajju qaala haddathanaa wakee'un, 'ani al-a'mashi،'an abee saalihin, 'an abee hurayrata, qaala qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏"‏ ayuhibbu ahadukum idhaa raja'a ilaa ahlihi an yajida feehi thalatha khalifaatin 'izaamin simaanin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qulnaa na'am ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ fathalathu 'aayaatin yaqra'u bihinna ahadukum fee salatihi khayrun lahu min thalathi khalifaatin 'izaamin simaanin ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanee al-hasanu ibnu 'aliyyin al-hulwaaniyyu, haddathanaa aboo tawbata, - wahuwa ar-rabee'u ibnu naafi'in - haddathanaa mu'aawiyatu, - ya'nee ibna salamin - 'an zaydin, annahu sami'a abaa salamin, yaqoolu haddathanee aboo umaamata, al-baahiliyyu qaala sami'tu rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam yaqoolu ‏ "‏ iqra'oo al-qur'aana fa'innahu ya'atee yawma al-qiyaamati shafee'an l'ashaabihi iqra'oo az-zahraawayni al-baqarata wasoorata 'aali 'imraana fa'innahumaa ta'atiyaani yawma al-qiyaamati ka'annahumaa ghamaamataani aw ka'annahumaa ghayaayataani aw ka'annahumaa firqaani min tayrin sawaaffa tuhaajjaani 'an ashaabihimaa iqra'oo soorata al-baqarati fa'inna akhdhahaa barakatun watarkahaa hasratun wala tastatee'uhaa al-batalatu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala mu'aawiyatu balaghanee anna al-batalata as-saharatu ‏.‏

haddathanee ishaaqu ibnu mansoorin, akhbaranaa yazeedu ibnu 'abdi rabbihi, haddathanaa al-waleedu ibnu muslimin, 'an muhammadi ibni muhaajirin, 'ani al-waleedi ibni 'abdi ar-rahmani al-jurashiyyi, 'an jubayri ibni nufayrin, qaala sami'tu an-nawwaasa, ibna sam'aana al-kilabiyya yaqoolu sami'tu an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam yaqoolu ‏"‏ yu'taa bil-qur'aani yawma al-qiyaamati wa'ahlihi alladheena kaanoo ya'maloona bihi taqdumuhu sooratu al-baqarati wa'aalu 'imraana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wadaraba lahumaa rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam thalathata amthaalin maa naseetuhunna ba'du qaala ‏"‏ ka'annahumaa ghamaamataani aw zullataani sawdaawaani baynahumaa sharqun aw ka'annahumaa hizqaani min tayrin sawaaffa tuhaajjaani 'an saahibihimaa

haddathanaa hasanu ibnu ar-rabee'i, wa'ahmadu ibnu jawwaasin al-hanafiyyu, qaala haddathanaa aboo al-ahwasi, 'an 'ammaari ibni ruzayqin, 'an 'abdi Allah ibni 'eesaa, 'an sa'eedi ibni jubayrin, 'ani ibni 'abbaasin, qaala baynamaa jibreelu qaa'idun 'inda an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam sami'a naqeedan min fawqihi farafa'a ra'asahu faqaala hadhaa baabun mina as-samaa'i futiha al-yawma lam yuftah qattu ila al-yawma fanazala minhu malakun faqaala hadhaa malakun nazala ilaa al-ardi lam yanzil qattu ila al-yawma fasallama waqaala abshir binoorayni ooteetahumaa lam yu'tahumaa nabiyyun qablaka faatihatu al-kitaabi wakhawaateemu soorati al-baqarati lan taqra'a biharfin minhumaa ila u'teetahu ‏.‏

wahaddathanaa ahmadu ibnu yoonusa, haddathanaa zuhayrun, haddathanaa mansoorun, 'an ibraaheema, 'an 'abdi ar-rahmani, ibni yazeeda qaala laqeetu abaa mas'oodin 'inda al-bayti faqultu hadeethun balaghanee 'anka fee al-'aayatayni fee soorati al-baqarati ‏.‏ faqaala na'am ‏.‏ qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ al-'aayataani min 'aakhiri soorati al-baqarati man qara'ahumaa fee laylatin kafataahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa minjaabu ibnu al-haarithi at-tameemiyyu, akhbaranaa ibnu mushirin, 'ani al-a'mashi, 'an ibraaheema, 'an 'abdi ar-rahmani ibni yazeeda, 'an 'alqamata ibni qaysin, 'an abee mas'oodin al-ansaariyyi, qaala qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ man qara'a haatayni al-'aayatayni min 'aakhiri soorati al-baqarati fee laylatin kafataahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala 'abdu ar-rahmani falaqeetu abaa mas'oodin wahuwa yatoofu bil-bayti fasa'altuhu fahaddathanee bihi 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏.‏

wahaddathanaa yahyaa ibnu yahyaa, qaala qara'atu 'alaa maalikin (h) wahaddathanaa qutaybatu ibnu sa'eedin, 'an maaliki ibni anasin, 'an abee az-zinaadi, 'ani al-a'raji, 'an abee hurayrata, anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam dhakara yawma al-jumu'ati faqaala ‏ "‏ feehi saa'atun la yuwaafiquhaa 'abdun muslimun wahuwa yusallee yas'alu Allah shay'an ila a'taahu iyyaahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ zaada qutaybatu fee riwaayatihi wa'ashaara biyadihi yuqalliluhaa

wahaddathanee harmalatu ibnu yahyaa, akhbaranaa ibnu wahbin, akhbaranee yoonusu, 'ani ibni shihaabin, akhbaranee 'abdu ar-rahmani al-a'raju, annahu sami'a abaa hurayrata, yaqoolu qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ khayru yawmin tala'at 'alayhi ash-shamsu yawmu al-jumu'ati feehi khuliqa 'aadamu wafeehi udkhila al-jannata wafeehi ukhrija minhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa yahyaa ibnu yahyaa, akhbaranaa wakee'un, (h) wahaddathanaa aboo bakri ibnu abee shaybata, haddathanaa ghundarun, wawakee'un, jamee'an 'an shu'bata, (h) wahaddathanaa muhammadu ibnu al-muthannaa, - wal-lafzu lahu - qaala haddathanaa yahyaa, ibnu sa'eedin haddathanaa shu'batu, haddathanaa aboo jamrata, 'ani ibni 'abbaasin, qaala ju'ila fee qabri rasooli Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qateefatun hamraa'u ‏.‏ qaala muslimun aboo jamrata ismuhu nasru ibnu 'imraana wa'aboo at-tayyaahi ismuhu yazeedu ibnu humaydin maataa bisarakhsa ‏.‏

wahaddathanee aboo at-taahiri, ahmadu ibnu 'amrinw haddathanaa ibnu wahbin, akhbaranee 'amroo ibnu al-haarithi, (h) wahaddathanee haaroonu ibnu sa'eedin al-ayliyyu, haddathanaa ibnu wahbin, haddathanee 'amroo ibnu al-haarithi, - fee riwaayati abee at-taahiri - anna abaa 'aliyyin al-hamdaaniyya, haddathahu - wafee, riwaayati haaroona - anna thumaamata ibna, shufaa haddathahu qaala kunnaa ma'a fadaalata ibni 'ubaydin bi'ardi ar-roomi biroodisa fatuwuffiya saahibun lanaa fa'amara fadaalatu ibnu 'ubaydin biqabrihi fasuwwiya thumma qaala sami'tu rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ya'amuru bitaswiyatihaa ‏.‏
