haddathanaa yahyaa ibnu yahyaa, wa'aboo bakri ibnu abee shaybata wazuhayru ibnu harbin qaala yahyaa akhbaranaa waqaala al-'aakharaani, haddathanaa wakee'un, 'an sufyaana, 'an habeebi ibni abee thaabitin, 'an abee waa'ilin, 'an abee, al-hayyaaji al-asadiyyi qaala qaala lee 'aliyyu ibnu abee taalibin ala ab'athuka 'alaa maa ba'athanee 'alayhi rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam an la tada'a timthaalan ila tamastahu wala qabran mushrifan ila sawwaytahu ‏.‏ wahaddathaneehi aboo bakri ibnu khaladin al-baahiliyyu, haddathanaa yahyaa, - wahuwa al-qattaanu - haddathanaa sufyaanu, haddathanee habeebun, bihadhaa al-isnaadi waqaala wala sooratan ila tamastahaa ‏.‏

haddathanaa aboo bakri ibnu abee shaybata, haddathanaa hafsu ibnu ghiyaathin, 'ani ibni jurayjin, 'an abee, az-zubayri 'an jaabirin, qaala nahaa rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam an yujassasa al-qabru wa'an yuq'ada 'alayhi wa'an yubnaa 'alayhi ‏.‏
wahaddathanaa yahyaa ibnu yahyaa, akhbaranaa ismaa'eelu ibnu 'ulayyata, 'an ayyooba, 'an abee az-zubayri, 'an jaabirin, qaala nuhiya 'an taqseesi al-quboori, ‏.‏

wahaddathanee zuhayru ibnu harbin, haddathanaa jareerun, 'an suhaylin, 'an abeehi, 'an abee hurayrata, qaala qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ l'an yajlisa ahadukum 'alaa jamratin fatuhriqa thiyaabahu fatakhlusa ilaa jildihi khayrun lahu min an yajlisa 'alaa qabrin ‏"‏ ‏.‏

wahaddathanee 'aliyyu ibnu hujrin as-sa'diyyu, haddathanaa al-waleedu ibnu muslimin, 'ani ibni jaabirin, 'an busri, ibni 'ubaydi Allah 'an waathilata, 'an abee marthadin al-ghanawiyyi, qaala qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ la tajlisoo 'alaa al-quboori wala tusalloo ilayhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏

wahaddathanaa hasanu ibnu ar-rabee'i al-bajaliyyu, haddathanaa ibnu al-mubaaraki, 'an 'abdi ar-rahmani ibni yazeeda, 'an busri ibni 'ubaydi Allah, 'an abee idreesa al-khawlaniyyi, 'an waathilata ibni al-asqa'i, 'an abee marthadin al-ghanawiyyi, qaala sami'tu rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam yaqoolu ‏ "‏ la tusalloo ilaa al-quboori wala tajlisoo 'alayhaa‏"‏ ‏.‏

wahaddathanee 'aliyyu ibnu hujrin as-sa'diyyu, wa'ishaaqu ibnu ibraaheema al-hanzaliyyu, - wal-lafzu l'ishaaqa - qaala 'aliyyun haddathanaa waqaala, ishaaqu akhbaranaa 'abdu al-'azeezi ibnu muhammadin, 'an 'abdi al-waahidi ibni hamzata, 'an 'abbaadi ibni 'abdi Allah ibni az-zubayri, anna 'aa'ishata, amarat an yumarra, bijanaazati sa'di ibni abee waqqaasin fee al-masjidi fatusalliya 'alayhi fa'ankara an-naasu dhalika 'alayhaa faqaalat maa asra'a maa nasiya an-naasu maa salla rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam 'alaa suhayli ibni al-baydaa'i ila fee al-masjidi ‏.‏

wahaddathanee haaroonu ibnu 'abdi Allah, wamuhammadu ibnu raafi'in, - wal-lafzu libni raafi'in - qaala haddathanaa ibnu abee fudaykin, akhbaranaa ad-dahhaaku, - ya'nee ibna 'uthmaana - 'an abee an-nadri, 'an abee salamata ibni, 'abdi ar-rahmani anna 'aa'ishata, lammaa tuwuffiya sa'du ibnu abee waqqaasin qaalati idkhuloo bihi al-masjida hattaa usalliya 'alayhi ‏.‏ fa'unkira dhalika 'alayhaa faqaalat wal-lahi laqad salla rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam 'alaa ibnaa baydaa'a fee al-masjidi suhaylin wa'akheehi ‏.‏ qaala muslimun suhaylu ibnu da'din wahuwa ibnu al-baydaa'i ummuhu baydaa'u ‏.‏

haddathanaa yahyaa ibnu yahyaa at-tameemiyyu, wayahyaa ibnu ayyooba, waqutaybatu ibnu sa'eedin, qaala yahyaa ibnu yahyaa akhbaranaa waqaala al-'aakharaani, haddathanaa ismaa'eelu ibnu ja'farin, 'an shareekin, - wahuwa ibnu abee namirin - 'an 'ataa'i ibni yasaarin, 'an 'aa'ishata, annahaa qaalat kaana rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam - kullamaa kaana laylatuhaa min rasooli Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam - yakhruju min 'aakhiri al-layli ilaa al-baqee'i fayaqoolu ‏"‏ as-salamu 'alaykum daara qawmin mu'mineena wa'ataakum maa too'adoona ghadan mu'ajjaloona wa'innaa in shaa'a Allah bikum lahiqoona al-lahumma ighfir l'ahli baqee'i al-gharqadi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ walam yuqim qutaybatu qawlahu ‏"‏ wa'ataakum ‏"‏ ‏.‏

wahaddathanee aboo kuraybin, muhammadu ibnu al-'ala'i haddathanaa aboo usaamata, haddathanaa fudaylu ibnu marzooqin, haddathanee 'adiyyu ibnu thaabitin, 'an abee haazimin, 'an abee hurayrata, qaala qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏"‏ ayyuhaa an-naasu inna Allah tayyibun la yaqbalu ila tayyiban wa'inna Allah amara al-mu'mineena bimaa amara bihi al-mursaleena faqaala ‏{‏ yaa ayyuhaa ar-rusulu kuloo mina at-tayyibaati waa'maloo saalihan innee bimaa ta'maloona 'aleemun‏}‏ waqaala ‏{‏ yaa ayyuhaa alladheena 'aamanoo kuloo min tayyibaati maa razaqnaakum‏}‏ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma dhakara ar-rajula yuteelu as-safara ash'atha aghbara yamuddu yadayhi ilaa as-samaa'i yaa rabbi yaa rabbi wamat'amuhu haraamun wamashrabuhu haraamun wamalbasuhu haraamun waghudhiya bil-haraami fa'annaa yustajaabu lidhalika ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa haddaabu ibnu khaalidin, haddathanaa hammaamu ibnu yahyaa, haddathanaa qataadatu, 'an abee nadrata, 'an abee sa'eedin al-khudriyyi, - radiya Allah 'anhu - qaala ghazawnaa ma'a rasooli Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam lisitta 'ashrata madat min ramadaana faminnaa man saama waminnaa man aftara falam ya'ibi as-saa'imu 'alaa al-muftiri wala al-muftiru 'alaa as-saa'imi ‏.‏

haddathanaa nasru ibnu 'aliyyin al-jahdamiyyu, haddathanaa bishrun, - ya'nee ibna mufaddalin - 'an abee maslamata, 'an abee nadrata, 'an abee sa'eedin, - radiya Allah 'anhu - qaala kunnaa nusaafiru ma'a rasooli Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam fee ramadaana famaa yu'aabu 'alaa as-saa'imi sawmuhu wala 'alaa al-muftiri iftaaruhu ‏.‏

haddathanee 'amrunw an-naaqidu, haddathanaa ismaa'eelu ibnu ibraaheema, 'ani al-jurayriyyi, 'an abee nadrata, 'an abee sa'eedin al-khudriyyi, - radiya Allah 'anhu - qaala kunnaa naghzoo ma'a rasooli Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam fee ramadaana faminnaa as-saa'imu waminnaa al-muftiru fala yajidu as-saa'imu 'alaa al-muftiri wala al-muftiru 'alaa as-saa'imi yarawna anna man wajada quwwatan fasaama fa'inna dhalika hasanun wayarawna anna man wajada da'fan fa'aftara fa'inna dhalika hasanun ‏.‏

haddathanaa sa'eedu ibnu 'amrinw al-ash'athiyyu, wasahlu ibnu 'uthmaana, wasuwaydu ibnu sa'eedin, wahusaynu, ibnu huraythin kulluhum 'an marwaana, - qaala sa'eedun akhbaranaa marwaanu ibnu mu'aawiyata, - 'an 'aasimin, qaala sami'tu abaa nadrata, yuhaddithu 'an abee sa'eedin al-khudriyyi, wajaabiri ibni 'abdi Allah, - radiya Allah 'anhum - qaala saafarnaa ma'a rasooli Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam fayasoomu as-saa'imu wayuftiru al-muftiru fala ya'eebu ba'duhum 'alaa ba'din ‏.‏

haddathanaa yahyaa ibnu yahyaa, akhbaranaa aboo khaythamata, 'an humaydin, qaala su'ila anasun - radiya Allah 'anhu - 'an sawmi ramadaana fee as-safari faqaala saafarnaa ma'a rasooli Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam fee ramadaana falam ya'ibi as-saa'imu 'alaa al-muftiri wala al-muftiru 'alaa as-saa'imi ‏.‏

wahaddathanaa aboo bakri ibnu abee shaybata, haddathanaa aboo khaalidin al-ahmaru, 'an humaydin, qaala kharajtu fasumtu faqaaloo lee a'id ‏.‏ qaala faqultu inna anasan akhbaranee anna ashaaba rasooli Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam kaanoo yusaafiroona fala ya'eebu as-saa'imu 'alaa al-muftiri wala al-muftiru 'alaa as-saa'imi ‏.‏ falaqeetu ibna abee mulaykata fa'akhbaranee 'an 'aa'ishata - radiya Allah 'anha - bimithlihi ‏.‏

wahaddathanaa aboo kuraybin, haddathanaa hafsun, 'an 'aasimin al-ahwali, 'an muwarriqin, 'an anasin, - radiya Allah 'anhu - qaala kaana rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam fee safarin fasaama ba'dun wa'aftara ba'dun fatahazzama al-muftiroona wa'amiloo wada'ufa as-suwwaamu 'an ba'di al-'amali - qaala - faqaala fee dhalika ‏ "‏ dhahaba al-muftiroona al-yawma bil-ajri ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa qutaybatu ibnu sa'eedin, haddathanaa laythun, 'an hishaami ibni 'urwata, 'an abeehi, 'an 'aa'ishata, - radiya Allah 'anha - annahaa qaalat sa'ala hamzatu ibnu 'amrinw al-aslamiyyu rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam 'ani as-siyaami fee as-safari faqaala ‏ "‏ in shi'ta fasum wa'in shi'ta fa'aftir ‏"‏ ‏.‏

wahaddathanaa aboo ar-rabee'i az-zahraaniyyu, haddathanaa hammaadun, - wahuwa ibnu zaydin - haddathanaa hishaamun, 'an abeehi, 'an 'aa'ishata, - radiya Allah 'anha - anna hamzata ibna 'amrinw al-aslamiyya, sa'ala rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam faqaala yaa rasoola Allah innee rajulun asrudu as-sawma ‏.‏ afa'asoomu fee as-safari qaala ‏ "‏ sum in shi'ta wa'a��tir in shi'ta ‏"‏ ‏.‏

wahaddathanee aboo at-taahiri, wahaaroonu ibnu sa'eedin al-ayliyyu, - qaala haaroonu haddathanaa waqaala aboo at-taahiri akhbaranaa ibnu wahbin, akhbaranee 'amroo ibnu al-haarithi, 'an abee al-aswadi, 'an 'urwata ibni az-zubayri, 'an abee muraawihin, 'an hamzata ibni 'amrinw al-aslamiyyi, - radiya Allah 'anhu - annahu qaala yaa rasoola Allah ajidu bee quwwatan 'alaa as-siyaami fee as-safari fahal 'alaa junaahun faqaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏"‏ hiya rukhsatun mina Allah faman akhadha bihaa fahasanun waman ahabba an yasooma fala junaaha 'alayhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala haaroonu fee hadeethihi ‏"‏ hiya rukhsatun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ walam yadhkur mina Allah ‏.‏

wahaddathanaahu ibnu numayrin, haddathanaa abee, haddathanaa 'ubaydu Allah, 'an naafi'in, qaala araada ibnu 'umara al-hajja heena nazala al-hajjaaju bibni az-zubayri ‏.‏ waaqtassa al-hadeetha bimithli hadhihi al-qissati waqaala fee 'aakhiri al-hadeethi wakaana yaqoolu man jama'a bayna al-hajji wal-'umrati kafaahu tawaafun waahidun walam yahilla hattaa yahilla minhumaa jamee'an ‏.‏

haddathanaa yahyaa ibnu ayyooba, wa'abdu Allah ibnu 'awnin al-hilaliyyu, qaala haddathanaa 'abbaadu ibnu 'abbaadin, al-muhallabiyyu haddathanaa 'ubaydu Allah ibnu 'umara, 'an naafi'in, 'ani ibni 'umara, - fee riwaayati yahyaa - qaala ahlalnaa ma'a rasooli Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam bil-hajji mufradan wafee riwaayati ibni 'awnin anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ahalla bil-hajji mufradan ‏.‏

wahaddathanaa surayju ibnu yoonusa, haddathanaa hushaymun, haddathanaa humaydun, 'an bakrin, 'an anasin, - radiya Allah 'anhu - qaala sami'tu an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam yulabbee bil-hajji wal-'umrati jamee'an ‏.‏ qaala bakrun fahaddathtu bidhalika ibna 'umara faqaala labbaa bil-hajji wahdahu ‏.‏ falaqeetu anasan fahaddathtuhu biqawli ibni 'umara faqaala anasun maa ta'uddoonanaa ila sibyaanan sami'tu rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam yaqoolu ‏ "‏ labbayka 'umratan wahajjan ‏"‏ ‏.‏

wahaddathanee umayyatu ibnu bistaama al-'ayshiyyu, haddathanaa yazeedu, - ya'nee ibna zuray'in - haddathanaa habeebu, ibnu ash-shaheedi 'an bakri ibni 'abdi Allah, haddathanaa anasun, radiya Allah 'anhu annahu ra'aa an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam jama'a baynahumaa bayna al-hajji wal-'umrati qaala fasa'altu ibna 'umara faqaala ahlalnaa bil-hajji ‏.‏ faraja'tu ilaa anasin fa'akhbartuhu maa qaala ibnu 'umara faqaala ka'annamaa kunnaa sibyaanan ‏.‏

haddathanaa yahyaa ibnu yahyaa, akhbaranaa 'abtharun, 'an ismaa'eela ibni abee khaalidin, 'an wabarata, qaala kuntu jaalisan 'inda ibni 'umara fajaa'ahu rajulun faqaala ayasluhu lee an atoofa bil-bayti qabla an 'aatiya al-mawqifa ‏.‏ faqaala na'am ‏.‏ faqaala fa'inna ibna 'abbaasin yaqoolu la tatuf bil-bayti hattaa ta'atiya al-mawqifa ‏.‏ faqaala ibnu 'umara faqad hajja rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam fataafa bil-bayti qabla an ya'atiya al-mawqifa fabiqawli rasooli Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ahaqqu an ta'akhudha aw biqawli ibni 'abbaasin in kunta saadiqan

haddathanee zuhayru ibnu harbin, haddathanaa sufyaanu ibnu 'uyaynata, 'an 'amriw ibni deenaarin, qaala sa'alnaa ibna 'umara 'an rajulin, qadima bi'umratin fataafa bil-bayti walam yatuf bayna as-safaa wal-marwati aya'atee imra'atahu faqaala qadima rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam fataafa bil-bayti sab'an wasallaa khalfa al-maqaami rak'atayni wabayna as-safaa wal-marwati sab'an waqad kaana lakum fee rasooli Allah uswatun hasanatun ‏.‏

haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu haatimin, haddathanaa rawhu ibnu 'ubaadata, haddathanaa shu'batu, 'an muslimin al-qurriyyi, qaala sa'altu ibna 'abbaasin - radiya Allah 'anhuma - 'an mut'ati al-hajji, farakhkhasa feehaa wakaana ibnu az-zubayri yanhaa 'anha faqaala hadhihi ummu ibni az-zubayri tuhaddithu anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam rakhkhasa feehaa faadkhuloo 'alayhaa faas'aloohaa qaala fadakhalnaa 'alayhaa fa'idhaa imra'atun dakhmatun 'amyaa'u faqaalat qad rakhkhasa rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam feehaa ‏.‏

wahaddathanaa 'ubaydu Allah ibnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa abee, haddathanaa shu'batu, haddathanaa muslimun al-qurriyyu, sami'a ibna 'abbaasin, - radiya Allah 'anhuma - yaqoolu ahalla an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam bi'umratin wa'ahalla ashaabuhu bihajjin falam yahilla an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam wala man saaqa al-hada min ashaabihi wahalla baqiyyatuhum fakaana talhatu ibnu 'ubaydi Allah feeman saaqa al-hada falam yahilla ‏.‏

wahaddathanee muhammadu ibnu haatimin, wa'ibraaheemu ibnu deenaarin, qaala haddathanaa hajjaajun, (h) wahaddathaneehi muhammadu, ibnu raafi'in haddathanaa 'abdu ar-razzaaqi, jamee'an 'ani ibni jurayjin, qaala akhbaranee 'amroo ibnu yahyaa ibni 'umaarata, annahu sami'a al-qarraaza, - wakaana min ashaabi abee hurayrata - yaz'umu annahu sami'a abaa hurayrata, yaqoolu qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ man araada ahlahaa bisoo'in - yureedu al-madeenata - adhaabahu Allah kamaa yadhoobu al-milhu fee al-maa'i ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala ibnu haatimin fee hadeethi ibni yuhannisa badala qawlihi bisoo'in sharran‏.‏

haddathanaa qutaybatu ibnu sa'eedin, haddathanaa haatimun, - ya'nee ibna ismaa'eela - 'an 'umara ibni nubayhin, akhbaranee deenaarun al-qarraazu, qaala sami'tu sa'da ibna abee waqqaasin, yaqoolu qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ man araada ahla al-madeenati bisoo'in adhaabahu Allah kamaa yadhoobu al-milhu fee al-maa'i ‏"‏ ‏.‏

wahaddathanaa aboo bakri ibnu abee shaybata, haddathanaa 'ubaydu Allah ibnu moosaa, haddathanaa usaamatu ibnu zaydin, 'an abee 'abdi Allah al-qarraazi, qaala sami'tuhu yaqoolu sami'tu abaa hurayrata, wasa'dan, yaqoolani qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏"‏ al-lahumma baarik l'ahli al-madeenati fee muddihim ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wasaaqa al-hadeetha wafeehi ‏"‏ man araada ahlahaa bisoo'in adhaabahu Allah kamaa yadhoobu al-milhu fee al-maa'i ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa aboo bakri ibnu abee shaybata, haddathanaa wakee'un, 'an hishaami ibni 'urwata, 'an abeehi, 'an 'abdi Allah ibni az-zubayri, 'an sufyaana ibni abee zuhayrin, qaala qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ yuftahu ash-shaamu fayakhruju mina al-madeenati qawmun bi'ahleehim yabussoona wal-madeenatu khayrun lahum law kaanoo ya'lamoona thumma yuftahu al-yamanu fayakhruju mina al-madeenati qawmun bi'ahleehim yabussoona wal-madeenatu khayrun lahum law kaanoo ya'lamoona thumma yuftahu al-'iraaqu fayakhruju mina al-madeenati qawmun bi'ahleehim yabussoona wal-madeenatu khayrun lahum law kaanoo ya'lamoona ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanee zuhayru ibnu harbin, haddathanaa aboo safwaana, 'an yoonusa ibni yazeeda, (h) wahaddathanee harmalatu, ibnu yahyaa - wal-lafzu lahu - akhbaranaa ibnu wahbin, akhbaranee yoonusu, 'ani ibni shihaabin, 'an sa'eedi ibni, al-musayyabi annahu sami'a abaa hurayrata, yaqoolu qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam lilmadeenati ‏ "‏ layatrukannahaa ahluhaa 'alaa khayri maa kaanat mudhallalatan lil'awaafee ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ya'nee as-sibaa'a wat-tayra ‏.‏ qaala muslimun aboo safwaana hadhaa huwa 'abdu Allah ibnu 'abdi al-maliki yateemu ibnu jurayjin 'ashra sineena kaana fee hajrihi ‏.‏

wahaddathanee 'abdu al-maliki ibnu shu'aybi ibni al-laythi, haddathanee abee, 'an jaddee, haddathanee 'uqaylu ibnu, khaalidin 'ani ibni shihaabin, annahu qaala akhbaranee sa'eedu ibnu al-musayyabi, anna abaa hurayrata, qaala sami'tu rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam yaqoolu ‏ "‏ yatrukoona al-madeenata 'alaa khayri maa kaanat la yaghshaahaa ila al-'awaafee - yureedu 'awaafiya as-sibaa'i wat-tayri - thumma yakhruju raa'iyaani min muzaynata yureedaani al-madeenata yan'iqaani bighanamihimaa fayajidaanihaa wahshan hattaa idhaa balaghaa thaniyyata al-wadaa'i kharraa 'alaa wujoohihimaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa qutaybatu ibnu sa'eedin, 'an maaliki ibni anasin, feemaa quri'a 'alayhi 'an 'abdi Allah ibni abee, bakrin 'an 'abbaadi ibni tameemin, 'an 'abdi Allah ibni zaydin al-maaziniyyi, anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ maa bayna baytee waminbaree rawdatun min riyaadi al-jannati ‏"‏ ‏.‏

wahaddathanaa yahyaa ibnu yahyaa, akhbaranaa 'abdu al-'azeezi ibnu muhammadin al-madaniyyu, 'an yazeeda ibni al-haadi, 'an abee bakrin, 'an 'abbaadi ibni tameemin, 'an 'abdi Allah ibni zaydin al-ansaariyyi, annahu sami'a rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam yaqoolu ‏ "‏ maa bayna minbaree wabaytee rawdatun min riyaadi al-jannati ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa zuhayru ibnu harbin, wamuhammadu ibnu al-muthannaa, qaala haddathanaa yahyaa ibnu sa'eedin, 'an 'ubaydi, Allah (h) wahaddathanaa ibnu numayrin, haddathanaa abee, haddathanaa 'ubaydu Allah, 'an khubaybi ibni 'abdi ar-rahmani, 'an hafsi, ibni 'aasimin 'an abee hurayrata, anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ maa bayna baytee waminbaree rawdatun min riyaadi al-jannati waminbaree 'alaa hawdee ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa 'abdu Allah ibnu maslamata al-qa'nabiyyu, haddathanaa sulaymaanu ibnu bilalin, 'an 'amriw ibni yahyaa, 'an 'abbaasi ibni sahlin as-saa'idiyyi, 'an abee humaydin, qaala kharajnaa ma'a rasooli Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam fee ghazwati tabooka ‏.‏ wasaaqa al-hadeetha wafeehi thumma aqbalnaa hattaa qadimnaa waadiya al-quraa faqaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏"‏ innee musri'un faman shaa'a minkum falyusri' ma'ee waman shaa'a falyamkuth ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fakharajnaa hattaa ashrafnaa 'alaa al-madeenati faqaala ‏"‏ hadhihi taabatu wahadhaa uhudun wahuwa jabalun yuhibbunaa wanuhibbuhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa 'ubaydu Allah ibnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa abee, haddathanaa qurratu ibnu khaalidin, 'an qataadata, haddathanaa anasu, ibnu maalikin qaala qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ inna uhudan jabalun yuhibbunaa wanuhibbuhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏

wahaddathaneehi 'ubaydu Allah ibnu 'umara al-qawaareeriyyu, haddathanee haramiyyu ibnu 'umaarata, haddathanaa qurratu, 'an qataadata, 'an anasin, qaala nazara rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ilaa uhudin faqaala ‏ "‏ inna uhudan jabalun yuhibbunaa wanuhibbuhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏

wahaddathanaa 'ubaydu Allah ibnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa abee, haddathanaa shu'batu, 'an humaydi ibni naafi'in, bil-hadeethayni jamee'an hadeethi ummi salamata fee al-kuhli wahadeethi ummi salamata wa'ukhraa min azwaaji an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ghayra annahu lam tusammihaa zaynabu nahwa hadeethi muhammadi ibni ja'farin ‏.‏

wahaddathanaa 'amrunw an-naaqidu, waabnu abee 'umara, - wal-lafzu li'amrinw - haddathanaa sufyaanu ibnu 'uyaynata, 'an ayyooba ibni moosaa, 'an humaydi ibni naafi'in, 'an zaynaba binti abee salamata, qaalat lammaa ataa umma habeebata na'iyyu abee sufyaana da'at fee al-yawmi ath-thaalithi bisufratin famasahat bihi dhiraa'ayhaa wa'aaridayhaa waqaalat kuntu 'an hadhaa ghaniyyatan sami'tu an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam yaqoolu ‏ "‏ la yahillu limra'atin tu'minu bil-lahi wal-yawmi al-'aakhiri an tuhidda fawqa thalathin ila 'alaa zawjin fa'innahaa tuhiddu 'alayhi arba'ata ashhurin wa'ashran ‏"‏‏.‏

wahaddathanaa yahyaa ibnu yahyaa, waqutaybatu, waabnu, rumhin 'ani al-laythi ibni sa'din, 'an naafi'in, anna safiyyata, binta abee 'ubaydin haddathathu 'an hafsata, aw 'an 'aa'ishata, aw 'an kiltayhimaa, anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ la yahillu limra'atin tu'minu bil-lahi wal-yawmi al-'aakhiri - aw tu'minu bil-lahi warasoolihi - an tuhidda 'alaa mayyitin fawqa thalathati ayyaamin ila 'alaa zawjihaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏

wahaddathanaahu aboo ghassaana al-misma'iyyu, wamuhammadu ibnu al-muthannaa, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu al-wahhaabi, qaala sami'tu yahyaa ibna sa'eedin, yaqoolu sami'tu naafi'an, yuhaddithu 'an safiyyata binti abee 'ubaydin, annahaa sami'at hafsata binta 'umara, zawja an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam tuhaddithu 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam bimithli hadeethi al-laythi waabni deenaarin wazaada ‏ "‏ fa'innahaa tuhiddu 'alayhi arba'ata ashhurin wa'ashran ‏"‏ ‏.‏

wahaddathanaa aboo ar-rabee'i, haddathanaa hammaadun, 'an ayyooba, (h) wahaddathanaa ibnu numayrin, haddathanaa abee, haddathanaa 'ubaydu Allah, jamee'an 'an naafi'in, 'an safiyyata binti abee 'ubaydin, 'an ba'di, azwaaji an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam bima'naa hadeethihim ‏.‏

wahaddathanaa yahyaa ibnu yahyaa, wa'aboo bakri ibnu abee shaybata wa'amrunw an-naaqidu wazuhayru ibnu harbin - wal-lafzu liyahyaa - qaala yahyaa akhbaranaa waqaala al-'aakharoona, haddathanaa sufyaanu ibnu 'uyaynata, 'ani az-zuhriyyi, 'an 'urwata, 'an 'aa'ishata, 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ la yahillu limra'atin tu'minu bil-lahi wal-yawmi al-'aakhiri an tuhidda 'alaa mayyitin fawqa thalathin ila 'alaa zawjihaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏

wahaddathanaa hasanu ibnu ar-rabee'i, haddathanaa ibnu idreesa, 'an hishaamin, 'an hafsata, 'an ummi 'atiyyata, anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ la tuhiddu imra'atun 'alaa mayyitin fawqa thalathin ila 'alaa zawjin arba'ata ashhurin wa'ashran wala talbasu thawban masbooghan ila thawba 'asbin wala taktahilu wala tamassu teeban ila idhaa tahurat nubdhatan min qustin aw azfaarin ‏"‏ ‏.‏

wahaddathanee aboo ar-rabee'i az-zahraaniyyu, haddathanaa hammaadun, haddathanaa ayyoobu, 'an hafsata, 'an ummi 'atiyyata, qaalat kunnaa nunhaa an nuhidda 'alaa mayyitin fawqa thalathin ila 'alaa zawjin arba'ata ashhurin wa'ashran wala naktahilu wala natatayyabu wala nalbasu thawban masbooghan waqad rukhkhisa lilmar'ati fee tuhrihaa idhaa ightasalat ihdaanaa min maheedihaa fee nubdhatin min qustin wa'azfaarin ‏.‏

wahaddathanee harmalatu ibnu yahyaa, akhbaranaa ibnu wahbin, akhbaranee yoonusu, 'ani ibni shihaabin, akhbaranee sahlu ibnu sa'din al-ansaariyyu, anna 'uwaymiran al-ansaariyya, min banee al-'ajlani ataa 'aasima ibna 'adiyyin ‏.‏ wasaaqa al-hadeetha bimithli hadeethi maalikin wa'adraja fee al-hadeethi qawlahu wakaana firaaquhu iyyaahaa ba'du sunnatan fee al-mutala'inayni ‏.‏ wazaada feehi qaala sahlun fakaanat haamilan fakaana ibnuhaa yud'aa ilaa ummihi ‏.‏ thumma jarati as-sunnatu annahu yarithuhaa watarithu minhu maa farada Allah lahaa ‏.‏

haddathanaa 'abdu Allah ibnu maslamata al-qa'nabiyyu, haddathanaa sulaymaanu, - ya'nee ibna bilalin - 'an moosaa, ibni abee tameemin 'an sa'eedi ibni yasaarin, 'an abee hurayrata, anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ ad-deenaaru bid-deenaari la fadla baynahumaa wad-dirhamu bid-dirhami la fadla baynahumaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa 'ubaydu Allah ibnu mu'aadhin al-'anbariyyu, haddathanaa abee, haddathanaa shu'batu, 'an habeebin, annahu sami'a abaa al-minhaali, yaqoolu sa'altu al-baraa'a ibna 'aazibin 'ani as-sarfi, faqaala sal zayda ibna arqama fahuwa a'lamu ‏.‏ fasa'altu zaydan faqaala sali al-baraa'a fa'innahu a'lamu thumma qaala nahaa rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam 'an bay'i al-wariqi bidh-dhahabi daynan

haddathanaa aboo ar-rabee'i al-'atakiyyu, haddathanaa 'abbaadu ibnu al-'awwaami, akhbaranaa yahyaa ibnu abee ishaaqa, haddathanaa 'abdu ar-rahmani ibnu abee bakrata, 'an abeehi, qaala nahaa rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam 'ani al-fiddati bil-fiddati wadh-dhahabi bidh-dhahabi ila sawaa'an bisawaa'in wa'amaranaa an nashtariya al-fiddata bidh-dhahabi kayfa shi'naa wanashtariya adh-dhahaba bil-fiddati kayfa shi'naa ‏.‏ qaala fasa'alahu rajulun faqaala yadan biyadin faqaala hakadhaa sami'tu ‏.‏

haddathanee aboo at-taahiri, ahmadu ibnu 'amriw ibni sarhin akhbaranaa ibnu wahbin, akhbaranee aboo haani'in al-khawlaniyyu annahu sami'a 'ulaa ibna rabaahin al-lakhmiyya, yaqoolu sami'tu fadaalata ibna 'ubaydin al-ansaariyya, yaqoolu utiya rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam wahuwa bikhaybara biqiladatin feehaa kharazun wadhahabun wahiya mina al-maghaanimi tubaa'u fa'amara rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam bidh-dhahabi alladhee fee al-qiladati fanuzi'a wahdahu thumma qaala lahum rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ adh-dhahabu bidh-dhahabi waznan biwaznin ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa qutaybatu ibnu sa'eedin, haddathanaa laythun, 'an abee shujaa'in, sa'eedi ibni yazeeda 'an khaalidi ibni, abee 'imraana 'an hanashin as-san'aaniyyi, 'an fadaalata ibni 'ubaydin, qaala ishtaraytu yawma khaybara qiladatan bithnaa 'ashara deenaaran feehaa dhahabun wakharazun fafassaltuhaa fawajadtu feehaa akthara mini ithnaa 'ashara deenaaran fadhakartu dhalika lilnnabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam faqaala ‏ "‏ la tubaa'u hattaa tufassala ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa qutaybatu ibnu sa'eedin, haddathanaa laythun, 'ani ibni abee ja'farin, 'ani al-julahi abee katheerin, haddathanee hanashun as-san'aaniyyu, 'an fadaalata ibni 'ubaydin, qaala kunnaa ma'a rasooli Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam yawma khaybara nubaayi'u al-yahooda al-wuqiyyata adh-dhahaba bid-deenaarayni wath-thalathati faqaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ la tabee'oo adh-dhahaba bidh-dhahabi ila waznan biwaznin ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanee aboo at-taahiri, akhbaranaa ibnu wahbin, 'an qurrata ibni 'abdi ar-rahmani al-ma'aafiriyyi, wa'amriw, ibni al-haarithi waghayrihimaa anna 'aamira ibna yahyaa al-ma'aafiriyya, akhbarahum 'an hanashin, annahu qaala kunnaa ma'a fadaalata ibni 'ubaydin fee ghazwatin fataarat lee wal'ashaabee qiladatun feehaa dhahabun wawariqun wajawharun fa'aradtu an ashtariyahaa fasa'altu fadaalata ibna 'ubaydin faqaala inzi' dhahabahaa faaj'alhu fee kiffatin waaj'al dhahabaka fee kiffatin thumma la ta'akhudhanna ila mithlan bimithlin fa'innee sami'tu rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam yaqoolu ‏ "‏ man kaana yu'minu bil-lahi wal-yawmi al-'aakhiri fala ya'akhudhanna ila mithlan bimithlin ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa yahyaa ibnu yahyaa, qaala qara'atu 'alaa maalikin 'an 'abdi al-majeedi ibni suhayli ibni 'abdi, ar-rahmani ibni 'awfin 'an sa'eedi ibni al-musayyabi, 'an abee sa'eedin al-khudriyyi, wa'an abee hurayrata, anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ista'mala rajulan 'alaa khaybara fajaa'ahu bitamrin janeebin faqaala lahu rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏"‏ akullu tamri khaybara hakadhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala la wal-lahi yaa rasoola Allah innaa lana'akhudhu as-saa'a min hadhaa bis-saa'ayni was-saa'ayni bith-thalathati ‏.‏ faqaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏"‏ fala taf'al bi'i al-jam'a bid-daraahimi thumma ibta' bid-daraahimi janeeban ‏"‏ ‏.‏

wahaddathanaa salamatu ibnu shabeebin, haddathanaa al-hasanu ibnu a'yana, haddathanaa ma'qilun, 'an abee qaza'ata, al-baahiliyyi 'an abee nadrata, 'an abee sa'eedin, qaala utiya rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam bitamrin faqaala ‏"‏ maa hadhaa at-tamru min tamrinaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala ar-rajulu yaa rasoola Allah bi'naa tamranaa saa'ayni bisaa'in min hadhaa ‏.‏ faqaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏"‏ hadhaa ar-ribaa faruddoohu thumma bee'oo tamranaa waashtaroo lanaa min hadhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa yahyaa ibnu ayyooba, waqutaybatu, - ya'nee ibna sa'eedin - waabnu hujrin qaaloo haddathanaa ismaa'eelu, - huwa ibnu ja'farin - 'ani al-'ala'i, 'an abeehi, 'an abee hurayrata, anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ idhaa maata al-insaanu inqata'a 'anhu 'amaluhu ila min thalathatin ila min sadaqatin jaariyatin aw 'ilmin yuntafa'u bihi aw waladin saalihin yad'oo lahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu abee bakrin al-muqaddamiyyu, haddathanaa sulaymaanu aboo daawuda, haddathanaa zaa'idatu, 'ani as-suddiyyi, 'an sa'di ibni 'ubaydata, 'an abee 'abdi ar-rahmani, qaala khataba 'aliyyun faqaala yaa ayyuhaa an-naasu aqeemoo 'alaa ariqqaa'ikumu al-hadda man ahsana minhum waman lam yuhsin fa'inna amatan lirasooli Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam zanat fa'amaranee an ajlidahaa fa'idhaa hiya hadeethu 'ahdin binifaasin fakhasheetu in anaa jaladtuhaa an aqtulahaa fadhakartu dhalika lilnnabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam faqaala ‏ "‏ ahsanta ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu al-muthannaa, wamuhammadu ibnu bashshaarin, qaala haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'batu, qaala sami'tu qataadata, yuhaddithu 'an anasi ibni maalikin, anna an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam utiya birajulin qad shariba al-khamra fajaladahu bijareedatayni nahwa arba'eena ‏.‏ qaala wafa'alahu aboo bakrin falammaa kaana 'umaru istashaara an-naasa faqaala 'abdu ar-rahmani akhaffa al-hudoodi thamaaneena ‏.‏ fa'amara bihi 'umaru ‏.‏

haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu al-muthannaa, haddathanaa mu'aadhu ibnu hishaamin, haddathanee abee, 'an qataadata, 'an anasi, ibni maalikin anna nabiyya Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam jalada fee al-khamri bil-jareedi wan-ni'aali thumma jalada aboo bakrin arba'eena ‏.‏ falammaa kaana 'umaru wadanaa an-naasu mina ar-reefi wal-quraa qaala maa tarawna fee jaldi al-khamri faqaala 'abdu ar-rahmani ibnu 'awfin araa an taj'alahaa ka'akhaffi al-hudoodi ‏.‏ qaala fajalada 'umaru thamaaneena ‏.‏

haddathanee muhammadu ibnu minhaalin ad-dareeru, haddathanaa yazeedu ibnu zuray'in, haddathanaa sufyaanu ath-thawriyyu, 'an abee haseenin, 'an 'umayri ibni sa'eedin, 'an 'aliyyin, qaala maa kuntu uqeemu 'alaa ahadin haddan fayamoota feehi fa'ajida minhu fee nafsee ila saahiba al-khamri l'annahu in maata wadaytuhu l'anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam lam yasunnahu ‏.‏

haddathanaa ahmadu ibnu 'eesaa, haddathanaa ibnu wahbin, akhbaranee 'amrunw, 'an bukayri ibni al-ashajji, qaala baynaa nahnu 'inda sulaymaana ibni yasaarin idh jaa'ahu 'abdu ar-rahmani ibnu jaabirin fahaddathahu fa'aqbala, 'alaynaa sulaymaanu faqaala haddathanee 'abdu ar-rahmani ibnu jaabirin, 'an abeehi, 'an abee burdata al-ansaariyyi, annahu sami'a rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam yaqoolu ‏ "‏ la yujladu ahadun fawqa 'asharati aswaatin ila fee haddin min hudoodi Allah ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa qutaybatu ibnu sa'eedin, haddathanaa laythun, (h) wahaddathanaa muhammadu ibnu rumhin, akhbaranaa al-laythu, 'an yazeeda ibni abee habeebin, 'an abee al-khayri, 'ani as-sunaabihiyyi, 'an 'ubaadata ibni as-saamiti, annahu qaala innee lamina an-nuqabaa'i alladheena baaya'oo rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam waqaala baaya'naahu 'alaa an la nushrika bil-lahi shay'an wala nazniya wala nasriqa wala naqtula an-nafsa allatee harrama Allah ila bil-haqqi wala nantahiba wala na'siya fal-jannatu in fa'alnaa dhalika fa'in ghasheenaa min dhalika shay'an kaana qadaa'u dhalika ilaa Allah ‏.‏ waqaala ibnu rumhin kaana qadaa'uhu ilaa Allah ‏.‏

haddathanaa yahyaa ibnu yahyaa, wamuhammadu ibnu rumhin, qaala akhbaranaa al-laythu, (h) wahaddathanaa qutaybatu ibnu, sa'eedin haddathanaa laythun, 'ani ibni shihaabin, 'an sa'eedi ibni al-musayyabi, wa'abee, salamata 'an abee hurayrata, 'an rasooli Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam annahu qaala ‏ "‏ al-'ajmaa'u jarhuhaa jubaarun wal-bi'ru jubaarun wal-ma'dinu jubaarun wafee ar-rikaazi al-khumsu ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa 'abdu Allah ibnu maslamata ibni qa'nabin, haddathanaa hammaadu ibnu salamata, 'an thaabitin, 'an anasi, ibni maalikin qaala qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ laghadwatun fee sabeeli Allah aw rawhatun khayrun mina ad-dunyaa wamaa feehaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa yahyaa ibnu yahyaa, akhbaranaa 'abdu al-'azeezi ibnu abee haazimin, 'an abeehi, 'an sahli, ibni sa'din as-saa'idiyyi 'an rasooli Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ wal-ghadwata yaghdoohaa al-'abdu fee sabeeli Allah khayrun mina ad-dunyaa wamaa feehaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏

wahaddathanaa aboo bakri ibnu abee shaybata, wazuhayru ibnu harbin, qaala haddathanaa wakee'un, 'an sufyaana, 'an abee haazimin, 'an sahli ibni sa'din as-saa'idiyyi, 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ ghadwatun aw rawhatun fee sabeeli Allah khayrun mina ad-dunyaa wamaa feehaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa ibnu abee 'umara, haddathanaa marwaanu ibnu mu'aawiyata, 'an yahyaa ibni sa'eedin, 'an dhakwaana, ibni abee saalihin 'an abee hurayrata, qaala qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏"‏ lawla anna rijaalan min ummatee ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wasaaqa al-hadeetha waqaala feehi ‏"‏ walarawhatun fee sabeeli Allah aw ghadwatun khayrun mina ad-dunyaa wamaa feehaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏

wahaddathanaa aboo bakri ibnu abee shaybata, wa'ishaaqu ibnu ibraaheema, wazuhayru ibnu harbin, - wal-lafzu l'abee bakrin wa'ishaaqa - qaala ishaaqu akhbaranaa waqaala al-'aakharaani haddathanaa al-muqri'u 'abdu Allah ibnu yazeeda 'an sa'eedi ibni abee ayyooba haddathanee shurahbeelu ibnu shareekin al-ma'aafiriyyu 'an abee 'abdi ar-rahmani al-hubuliyyi qaala sami'tu abaa ayyooba yaqoolu qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ ghadwatun fee sabeeli Allah aw rawhatun khayrun mimmaa tala'at 'alayhi ash-shamsu wagharabat ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa zakariyyaa'u ibnu yahyaa ibni saalihin al-misriyyu, haddathanaa al-mufaddalu, - ya'nee ibna fadaalata - 'an 'ayyaashin, - wahuwa ibnu 'abbaasin al-qitbaaniyyu - 'an 'abdi Allah ibni yazeeda abee 'abdi ar-rahmani al-hubuliyyi, 'an 'abdi Allah ibni 'amriw ibni al-'aasi, anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ yughfaru lilshshaheedi kullu dhanbin ila ad-dayna ‏"‏ ‏.‏

wahaddathanee zuhayru ibnu harbin, haddathanaa 'abdu Allah ibnu yazeeda al-muqri'u, haddathanaa sa'eedu ibnu abee, ayyooba haddathanee 'ayyaashu ibnu 'abbaasin al-qitbaaniyyu, 'an abee 'abdi ar-rahmani al-hubuliyyi, 'an 'abdi Allah ibni, 'amriw ibni al-'aasi anna an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ al-qatlu fee sabeeli Allah yukaffiru kulla shaa'in ila ad-dayna ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa mansooru ibnu abee muzaahimin, haddathanaa yahyaa ibnu hamzata, 'an muhammadi ibni al-waleedi az-zubaydiyyi, 'ani az-zuhriyyi, 'an 'ataa'i ibni yazeeda al-laythiyyi, 'an abee sa'eedin al-khudriyyi, anna rajulan, ataa an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam faqaala aa an-naasi afdalu faqaala ‏"‏ rajulun yujaahidu fee sabeeli Allah bimaalihi wanafsihi ‏"‏ qaala thumma man qaala ‏"‏ mu'minun fee shi'bin mina ash-shi'aabi ya'budu Allah rabbahu wayada'u an-naasa min sharrihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa 'abdu ibnu humaydin, akhbaranaa 'abdu ar-razzaaqi, akhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani az-zuhriyyi, 'an 'ataa'i, ibni yazeeda al-laythiyyi 'an abee sa'eedin, qaala qaala rajulun aa an-naasi afdalu yaa rasoola Allah qaala ‏"‏ mu'minun yujaahidu binafsihi wamaalihi fee sabeeli Allah ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala thumma man qaala ‏"‏ thumma rajulun mu'tazilun fee shi'bin mina ash-shi'aabi ya'budu rabbahu wayada'u an-naasa min sharrihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa aboo bakri ibnu abee shaybata, haddathanaa ismaa'eelu ibnu 'ulayyata, 'an khaalidin al-hadhdhaa'i, 'an abee qilabata, 'an abee al-ash'athi, 'an shaddaadi ibni awsin, qaala thintaani hafiztuhumaa 'an rasooli Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ inna Allah kataba al-ihsaana 'alaa kulli shaa'in fa'idhaa qataltum fa'ahsinoo al-qitlata wa'idhaa dhabahtum fa'ahsinoo adh-dhabha walyuhidda ahadukum shafratahu falyurih dhabeehatahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa aboo bakri ibnu abee shaybata, wa'aboo kuraybin - wal-lafzu l'abee kuraybin - qaala haddathanaa aboo mu'aawiyata, 'ani al-a'mashi, 'an abee saalihin, 'an jaabiri ibni 'abdi Allah, qaala kunnaa ma'a rasooli Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam faastasqaa faqaala rajulun yaa rasoola Allah ala nasqeeka nabeedhan faqaala ‏"‏ balaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fakharaja ar-rajulu yas'aa fajaa'a biqadahin feehi nabeedhun faqaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏"‏ ala khammartahu walaw ta'rudu 'alayhi 'oodan ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fashariba ‏.‏

wahaddathanaa 'uthmaanu ibnu abee shaybata, haddathanaa jareerun, 'ani al-a'mashi, 'an abee sufyaana, wa'abee, saalihin 'an jaabirin, qaala jaa'a rajulun yuqaalu lahu aboo humaydin biqadahin min labanin mina an-naqee'i faqaala lahu rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ ala khammartahu walaw ta'rudu 'alayhi 'oodan ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa qutaybatu ibnu sa'eedin, haddathanaa laythun, (h) wahaddathanaa muhammadu ibnu rumhin, akhbaranaa al-laythu, 'an abee az-zubayri, 'an jaabirin, 'an rasooli Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam annahu qaala ‏"‏ ghattoo al-inaa'a wa'awkoo as-siqaa'a wa'aghliqoo al-baaba wa'atfi'oo as-siraaja fa'inna ash-shaytaana la yahullu siqaa'an wala yaftahu baaban wala yakshifu inaa'an fa'in lam yajid ahadukum ila an ya'ruda 'alaa inaa'ihi 'oodan wayadhkura isma Allah falyaf'al fa'inna al-fuwaysiqata tudrimu 'alaa ahli al-bayti baytahum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ walam yadhkur qutaybatu fee hadeethihi ‏"‏ wa'aghliqoo al-baaba ‏"‏ ‏.‏

wahaddathanee ishaaqu ibnu mansoorin, akhbaranaa rawhu ibnu 'ubaadata, haddathanaa ibnu jurayjin, akhbaranaa 'ataa'un, annahu sami'a jaabira ibna 'abdi Allah, yaqoolu qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ idhaa kaana junhu al-layli - aw amsaytum - fakuffoo sibyaanakum fa'inna ash-shaytaana yantashiru heena'idhin fa'idhaa dhahaba saa'atun mina al-layli fakhalloohum wa'aghliqoo al-abwaaba waadhkuroo isma Allah fa'inna ash-shaytaana la yaftahu baaban mughlaqan wa'awkoo qirabakum waadhkuroo isma Allah wakhammiroo 'aaniyatakum waadhkuroo isma Allah walaw an ta'rudoo 'alayhaa shay'an wa'atfi'oo masaabeehakum ‏"‏ ‏.‏

wahaddathanaa ahmadu ibnu yoonusa, haddathanaa zuhayrun, haddathanaa aboo az-zubayri, 'an jaabirin, (h) wahaddathanaa yahyaa ibnu yahyaa, akhbaranaa aboo khaythamata, 'an abee az-zubayri, 'an jaabirin, qaala qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ la tursiloo fawaashiyakum wasibyaanakum idhaa ghaabati ash-shamsu hattaa tadhhaba fahmatu al-'ishaa'i fa'inna ash-shayaateena tanba'ithu idhaa ghaabati ash-shamsu hattaa tadhhaba fahmatu al-'ishaa'i ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu al-muthannaa, wamuhammadu ibnu bashshaarin, qaala haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'batu, sami'tu qataadata, 'an saalimin, 'an jaabiri ibni 'abdi Allah, anna rajulan, mina al-ansaari wulida lahu ghulamun fa'araada an yusammiyahu muhammadan fa'ataa an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam fasa'alahu faqaala ‏ "‏ ahsanati al-ansaaru sammoo bismee wala taktanoo bikunyatee ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa 'amrunw an-naaqidu, wamuhammadu ibnu 'abdi Allah ibni numayrin, jamee'an 'an sufyaana, qaala 'amrunw haddathanaa sufyaanu ibnu 'uyaynata, haddathanaa ibnu al-munkadiri, annahu sami'a jaabira ibna 'abdi Allah, yaqoolu wulida lirajulin minnaa ghulamun fasammaahu al-qaasima faqulnaa la nakneeka abaa al-qaasimi wala nun'imuka 'aynan ‏.‏ fa'ataa an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam fadhakara dhalika lahu faqaala ‏ "‏ asmi ibnaka 'abda ar-rahmani ‏"‏ ‏.‏

wahaddathanaa aboo bakri ibnu abee shaybata, wa'amrunw an-naaqidu, wazuhayru ibnu harbin, waabnu, numayrin qaaloo haddathanaa sufyaanu ibnu 'uyaynata, 'an ayyooba, 'an muhammadi ibni seereena, qaala sami'tu abaa hurayrata, yaqoolu qaala aboo al-qaasimi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ tasammaw bismee wala takannaw bikunyatee ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala 'amrunw 'an abee hurayrata walama yaqul sami'tu ‏.‏

haddathanaa aboo bakri ibnu abee shaybata, wamuhammadu ibnu 'abdi Allah ibni numayrin, wa'aboo sa'eedin al-ashajju wamuhammadu ibnu al-muthannaa al-'anaziyyu - wal-lafzu libni numayrin - qaaloo haddathanaa ibnu idreesa, 'an abeehi, 'an simaaki ibni harbin, 'an 'alqamata ibni waa'ilin, 'ani al-mugheerati ibni shu'bata, qaala lammaa qadimtu najraana sa'aloonee faqaaloo innakum taqra'oona yaa ukhta haaroona wamoosaa qabla 'eesaa bikadhaa wakadhaa ‏.‏ falammaa qadimtu 'alaa rasooli Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam sa'altuhu 'an dhalika faqaala ‏ "‏ innahum kaanoo yusammoona bi'anbiyaa'ihim was-saaliheena qablahum ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa yahyaa ibnu yahyaa, wa'aboo bakri ibnu abee shaybata qaala aboo bakrin haddathanaa mu'tamiru ibnu, sulaymaana 'ani ar-rukayni, 'an abeehi, 'an samurata, waqaala, yahyaa akhbaranaa al-mu'tamiru ibnu sulaymaana, qaala sami'tu ar-rukayna, yuhaddithu 'an abeehi, 'an samurata ibni jundabin, qaala nahaanaa rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam an nusammiya raqeeqanaa bi'arba'ati asmaa'in aflaha warabaahin wayasaarin wanaafi'in ‏.‏

wahaddathanaa qutaybatu ibnu sa'eedin, haddathanaa jareerun, 'ani ar-rukayni ibni ar-rabee'i, 'an abeehi, 'an samurata, ibni jundabin qaala qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ la tusammi ghulamaka rabaahan wala yasaaran wala aflaha wala naafi'an ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa ahmadu ibnu 'abdi Allah ibni yoonusa, haddathanaa zuhayrun, haddathanaa mansoorun, 'ani hilali ibni yasaafin, 'an rabee'i ibni 'umaylata, 'an samurata ibni jundabin, qaala qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "ahabbu al-kalami ilaa Allah arba'un subhaana Allah wal-hamdu lillah wala ilaha ila Allah wal-lahu akbaru‏.‏ la yadurruka ba'ayyihinna bada'ata.‏ wala tusammiyanna ghulamaka yasaaran wala rabaahan wala najeehan wala aflaha fa'innaka taqoolu athamma huwa fala yakoonu fayaqoolu la‏."‏‏ innamaa hunna arba'un fala tazeedunna 'alaa ‏.‏

haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu ahmada ibni abee khalafin, haddathanaa rawhun, haddathanaa ibnu jurayjin, akhbaranee aboo az-zubayri annahu sami'a jaabira ibna 'abdi Allah, yaqoolu araada an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam an yanhaa 'an an yusammaa biya'laa wabibarakata wabi'aflaha wabiyasaarin wabinaafi'in wabinahwi dhalika thumma ra'aytuhu sakata ba'du 'anha falam yaqul shay'an thumma qubida rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam walam yanha 'an dhalika thumma araada 'umaru an yanhaa 'an dhalika thumma tarakahu ‏.‏

haddathanaa ahmadu ibnu hanbalin, wazuhayru ibnu harbin, wamuhammadu ibnu al-muthannaa, wa'ubaydu Allah ibnu sa'eedin, wamuhammadu ibnu bashshaarin qaaloo haddathanaa yahyaa ibnu sa'eedin, 'an 'ubaydi Allah, akhbaranee naafi'un, 'ani ibni 'umara, anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ghayyara isma 'aasiyata waqaala ‏ "‏ anti jameelatu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala ahmadu makaana akhbaranee 'an ‏.‏

wahaddathanee ishaaqu ibnu moosaa al-ansaariyyu, haddathanaa ma'nun, haddathanaa maalikun, (h) wahaddathanee aboo at-taahiri akhbaranaa ibnu wahbin, 'an maaliki ibni anasin, 'an ishaaqa ibni 'abdi Allah ibni abee talhata, 'an anasi ibni maalikin, annahu qaala ra'aytu rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam wahaanat salatu al-'asri fat-tamasa an-naasu al-wadoo'a falam yajidoohu fa'utiya rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam biwadoo'in fawada'a rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam fee dhalika al-inaa'i yadahu wa'amara an-naasa an yatawadda'oo minhu - qaala - fara'aytu al-maa'a yanbu'u min tahti asaabi'ihi fatawadda'a an-naasu hattaa tawadda'oo min 'indi 'aakhirihim ‏.‏

haddathanee aboo ghassaana al-misma'iyyu, haddathanaa mu'aadhun, - ya'nee ibna hishaamin - haddathanee abee, 'an qataadata, haddathanaa anasu ibnu maalikin, anna nabiyya Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam wa'ashaabahu biz-zawraa'i - qaala waz-zawraa'u bil-madeenati 'inda as-sooqi wal-masjidi feemaa thammah - da'aa biqadahin feehi maa'un fawada'a kaffahu feehi faja'ala yanbu'u min bayni asaabi'ihi fatawadda'a jamee'u ashaabihi ‏.‏ qaala qultu kam kaanoo yaa abaa hamzata qaala kaanoo zuhaa'a ath-thalathimi'ati ‏.‏

wahaddathanee salamatu ibnu shabeebin, haddathanaa al-hasanu ibnu a'yana, haddathanaa ma'qilun, 'an abee az-zubayri, 'an jaabirin, anna rajulan, ataa an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam yastat'imuhu fa'at'amahu shatra wasqi sha'eerin famaa zaala ar-rajulu ya'akulu minhu waamra'atuhu wadayfuhumaa hattaa kaalahu fa'ataa an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam faqaala ‏ "‏ law lam takilhu l'akaltum minhu walaqaama lakum ‏"‏ ‏.‏

wahaddathanaa qutaybatu ibnu sa'eedin, haddathanaa al-mugheeratu ibnu 'abdi ar-rahmani al-qurashiyyu, 'an abee az-zinaadi, 'ani al-a'raji, 'an abee hurayrata, qaala qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ innamaa mathalee wamathalu ummatee kamathali rajulin istawqada naaran faja'alati ad-dawaabbu wal-faraashu yaqa'na feehi fa'anaa 'aakhidhun bihujazikum wa'antum taqahhamoona feehi ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu ar-razzaaqi, akhbaranaa ma'marun, 'an hammaami ibni munabbihin, qaala hadhaa maa haddathanaa aboo hurayrata, 'an rasooli Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏.‏ fadhakara ahaadeetha minhaa waqaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ mathalee kamathali rajulin istawqada naaran falammaa adaa'at maa hawlahaa ja'ala al-faraashu wahadhihi ad-dawaabbu allatee fee an-naari yaqa'na feehaa waja'ala yahjuzuhunna wayaghlibnahu fayataqahhamna feehaa qaala fadhalikum mathalee wamathalukum anaa 'aakhidhun bihujazikum 'ani an-naari halumma 'ani an-naari halumma 'ani an-naari fataghliboonee taqahhamoona feehaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanee muhammadu ibnu haatimin, haddathanaa ibnu mahdiyyin, haddathanaa saleemun, 'an sa'eedi ibni meenaa'a, 'an jaabirin, qaala qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ mathalee wamathalukum kamathali rajulin awqada naaran faja'ala al-janaadibu wal-faraashu yaqa'na feehaa wahuwa yadhubbuhunna 'anha wa'anaa 'aakhidhun bihujazikum 'ani an-naari wa'antum tafallatoona min yadee ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa 'amroo ibnu muhammadin an-naaqidu, haddathanaa sufyaanu ibnu 'uyaynata, 'an abee az-zinaadi, 'ani al-a'raji, 'an abee hurayrata, 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ mathalee wamathalu al-anbiyaa'i kamathali rajulin banaa bunyaanan fa'ahsanahu wa'ajmalahu faja'ala an-naasu yuteefoona bihi yaqooloona maa ra'aynaa bunyaanan ahsana min hadhaa ila hadhihi al-labinata ‏.‏ fakuntu anaa tilka al-labinata ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu al-muthannaa, haddathanaa aboo daawuda, haddathanaa shu'batu, 'an qataadata, qaala sami'tu anasan, yaqoolu jama'a al-qur'aana 'alaa 'ahdi rasooli Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam arba'atun kulluhum mina al-ansaari mu'aadhu ibnu jabalin wa'ubaa ibnu ka'bin wazaydu ibnu thaabitin wa'aboo zaydin ‏.‏ qaala qataadatu qultu l'anasin man aboo zaydin qaala ahadu 'umoomatee ‏.‏

haddathanee aboo daawuda, sulaymaanu ibnu ma'badin haddathanaa 'amroo ibnu 'aasimin, haddathanaa hammaamun, haddathanaa qataadatu, qaala qultu l'anasi ibni maalikin man jama'a al-qur'aana 'alaa 'ahdi rasooli Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala arba'atun kulluhum mina al-ansaari ubaa ibnu ka'bin wamu'aadhu ibnu jabalin wazaydu ibnu thaabitin warajulun mina al-ansaari yuknaa abaa zaydin ‏.‏

haddathanaa haddaabu ibnu khaalidin, haddathanaa hammaamun, haddathanaa qataadatu, 'an anasi ibni maalikin, anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala l'ubaa ‏"‏ inna Allah 'azza wajalla amaranee an aqra'a 'alayka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala 'aalllahu sammaanee laka qaala ‏"‏ Allah sammaaka lee ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faja'ala ubaa yabkee ‏.‏

haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu al-muthannaa, waabnu, bashshaarin qaala haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'batu, qaala sami'tu qataadata, yuhaddithu 'an anasi ibni maalikin, qaala qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam l'ubaa ibni ka'bin ‏"‏ inna Allah amaranee an aqra'a 'alayka ‏{‏ lam yakuni alladheena kafaroo‏}‏ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala wasammaanee qaala ‏"‏ na'am ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fabakaa ‏.‏

haddathanaa 'abdu ibnu humaydin, akhbaranaa 'abdu ar-razzaaqi, akhbaranaa ibnu jurayjin, akhbaranee aboo az-zubayri, annahu sami'a jaabira ibna 'abdi Allah, yaqoolu qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam wajanaazatu sa'di ibni mu'aadhin bayna aydeehim ‏ "‏ ihtazza lahaa 'arshu ar-rahmani ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa 'amrunw an-naaqidu, haddathanaa 'abdu Allah ibnu idreesa al-awdiyyu, haddathanaa al-a'mashu, 'an abee, sufyaanu 'an jaabirin, qaala qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ ihtazza 'arshu ar-rahmani limawti sa'di ibni mu'aadhin ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu 'abdi Allah ar-ruzziyyu, haddathanaa 'abdu al-wahhaabi ibnu 'ataa'in al-khaffaafu, 'an sa'eedin, 'an qataadata, haddathanaa anasu ibnu maalikin, anna nabiyya Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala wajinaazatuhu mawdoo'atun - ya'nee sa'dan - ‏ "‏ ihtazza lahaa 'arshu ar-rahmani ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu al-muthannaa, waabnu, bashshaarin qaala haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'batu, 'an abee ishaaqa, qaala sami'tu al-baraa'a, yaqoolu uhdiyat lirasooli Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam hullatu hareerin faja'ala ashaabuhu yalmusoonahaa waya'jaboona min leenihaa faqaala ‏ "‏ ata'jaboona min leeni hadhihi lamanaadeelu sa'di ibni mu'aadhin fee al-jannati khayrun minhaa wa'alyanu ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa zuhayru ibnu harbin, haddathanaa yoonusu ibnu muhammadin, haddathanaa shaybaanu, 'an qataadata, haddathanaa anasu ibnu maalikin, annahu uhdiya lirasooli Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam jubbatun min sundusin wakaana yanhaa 'ani al-hareeri fa'ajiba an-naasu minhaa faqaala ‏ "‏ waalladhee nafsu muhammadin biyadihi inna manaadeela sa'di ibni mu'aadhin fee al-jannati ahsanu min hadhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa aboo bakri ibnu abee shaybata, haddathanaa 'affaanu, haddathanaa hammaadu ibnu salamata, haddathanaa thaabitun, 'an anasin, anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam akhadha sayfan yawma uhudin faqaala ‏"‏ man ya'akhudhu minnee hadhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fabasatoo aydiyahum kullu insaanin minhum yaqoolu anaa anaa ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ faman ya'akhudhuhu bihaqqihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fa'ahjama al-qawmu faqaala simaaku ibnu kharashata aboo dujaanata anaa 'aakhudhuhu bihaqqihi ‏.‏ qaala fa'akhadhahu fafalaqa bihi haama al-mushrikeena ‏.‏

haddathanaa aboo kuraybin, muhammadu ibnu al-'ala'i al-hamdaaniyyu haddathanaa ibnu fudaylin, 'an abeehi, 'an 'umaarata, ibni al-qa'qaa'i 'an abee zur'ata, 'an abee hurayrata, qaala qaala rajulun yaa rasoola Allah man ahaqqu bihusni as-suhbati qaala ‏ "‏ ummuka thumma ummuka thumma ummuka thumma abooka thumma adnaaka adnaaka ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanee muhammadu ibnu haatimi ibni maymoonin, haddathanaa ibnu mahdiyyin, 'an mu'aawiyata ibni saalihin, 'an 'abdi ar-rahmani ibni jubayri ibni nufayrin, 'an abeehi, 'ani an-nawwaasi ibni sam'aana al-ansaariyyi, qaala sa'altu rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam 'ani al-birri wal-ithmi faqaala ‏ "‏ al-birru husnu al-khuluqi wal-ithmu maa haaka fee sadrika wakarihta an yattali'a 'alayhi an-naasu ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa 'amrunw an-naaqidu, haddathanaa katheeru ibnu hishaamin, haddathanaa ja'faru ibnu burqaana, 'an yazeeda ibni, al-asammi 'an abee hurayrata, qaala qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ inna Allah la yanzuru ilaa suwarikum wa'amwaalikum walakin yanzuru ilaa quloobikum wa'a'maalikum ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa 'abdu Allah ibnu 'abdi ar-rahmani ibni bahraama ad-daarimiyyu, haddathanaa marwaanu, - ya'nee ibna muhammadin ad-dimashqiyya - haddathanaa sa'eedu ibnu 'abdi al-'azeezi, 'an rabee'ata ibni yazeeda, 'an abee idreesa al-khawlaniyyi, 'an abee dharrin, 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam feemaa rawaa 'ani Allah, tabaaraka wata'aalaa annahu qaala ‏ "‏ yaa 'ibaadee innee harramtu az-zulma 'alaa nafsee waja'altuhu baynakum muharraman fala tazaalamoo yaa 'ibaadee kullukum daallun ila man hadaytuhu faastahdoonee ahdikum yaa 'ibaadee kullukum jaa'i'un ila man at'amtuhu faastat'imoonee ut'imkum yaa 'ibaadee kullukum 'aarin ila man kasawtuhu faastaksoonee aksukum yaa 'ibaadee innakum tukhti'oona bil-layli wan-nahaari wa'anaa aghfiru adh-dhunooba jamee'an faastaghfiroonee aghfir lakum yaa 'ibaadee innakum lan tablughoo darree fatadurroonee walan tablughoo naf'ee fatanfa'oonee yaa 'ibaadee law anna awwalakum wa'aakhirakum wa'insakum wajinnakum kaanoo 'alaa atqaa qalbi rajulin waahidin minkum maa zaada dhalika fee mulkee shay'an yaa 'ibaadee law anna awwalakum wa'aakhirakum wa'insakum wajinnakum kaanoo 'alaa afjari qalbi rajulin waahidin maa naqasa dhalika min mulkee shay'an yaa 'ibaadee law anna awwalakum wa'aakhirakum wa'insakum wajinnakum qaamoo fee sa'eedin waahidin fasa'aloonee fa'a'taytu kulla insaanin mas'alatahu maa naqasa dhalika mimmaa 'indee ila kamaa yanqusu al-mikhyatu idhaa udkhila al-bahra yaa 'ibaadee innamaa hiya a'maalukum uhseehaa lakum thumma uwaffeekum iyyaahaa faman wajada khayran falyahmadi Allah waman wajada ghayra dhalika fala yaloomanna ila nafsahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala sa'eedun kaana aboo idreesa al-khawlaniyyu idhaa haddatha bihadhaa al-hadeethi jathaa 'alaa rukbatayhi ‏.‏

haddathanaa yahyaa ibnu ayyooba, waqutaybatu, waabnu, hujrin qaaloo haddathanaa ismaa'eelu, - wahuwa ibnu ja'farin - 'ani al-'ala'i, 'an abeehi, 'an abee hurayrata, 'an rasooli Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ maa naqasat sadaqatun min maalin wamaa zaada Allah 'abdan bi'afwin ila 'izzan wamaa tawaada'a ahadun lillah ila rafa'ahu Allah ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa harmalatu ibnu yahyaa at-tujeebiyyu, akhbaranaa 'abdu Allah ibnu wahbin, akhbaranee haywatu, haddathanee ibnu al-haadi, 'an abee bakri ibni hazmin, 'an 'amrata, - ya'nee binta 'abdi ar-rahmani - 'an 'aa'ishata, zawji an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ yaa 'aa'ishatu inna Allah rafeequn yuhibbu ar-rifqa wayu'tee 'alaa ar-rifqi maa la yu'tee 'alaa al-'unfi wamaa la yu'tee 'alaa maa siwaahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanee aboo ghassaana al-misma'iyyu, haddathanaa 'uthmaanu ibnu 'umara, haddathanaa aboo 'aamirin, - ya'nee al-khazzaaza - 'an abee 'imraana al-jawniyyi, 'an 'abdi Allah ibni as-saamiti, 'an abee dharrin, qaala qaala liya an-nabiyyu salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ la tahqiranna mina al-ma'roofi shay'an walaw an talqaa akhaaka biwajhin talqin ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa 'uthmaanu ibnu abee shaybata, wa'ishaaqu ibnu ibraaheema, qaala ishaaqu akhbaranaa waqaala, 'uthmaanu haddathanaa jareerun, 'ani al-a'mashi, 'an abee waa'ilin, 'an 'abdi Allah, qaala jaa'a rajulun ilaa rasooli Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam faqaala yaa rasoola Allah kayfa taraa fee rajulin ahabba qawman walammaa yalhaq bihim qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ al-mar'u ma'a man ahabba ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa yahyaa ibnu yahyaa at-tameemiyyu, wa'aboo ar-rabee'i, wa'aboo kaamilin fudaylu ibnu husaynin - wal-lafzu liyahyaa - qaala yahyaa akhbaranaa waqaala al-'aakharaani, haddathanaa hammaadu ibnu zaydin, 'an abee 'imraana al-jawniyyi, 'an 'abdi Allah ibni as-saamiti, 'an abee dharrin, qaala qeela lirasooli Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ara'ayta ar-rajula ya'malu al-'amala mina al-khayri wayahmaduhu an-naasu 'alayhi qaala ‏ "‏ tilka 'aajilu bushraa al-mu'mini ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa muhammadu ibnu 'abdi Allah ibni numayrin, wazuhayru ibnu harbin, - wal-lafzu libni numayrin - qaala haddathanaa sufyaanu ibnu 'uyaynata, 'an 'amriw ibni deenaarin, 'an abee at-tufayli, 'an hudhayfata ibni aseedin, yablughu bihi an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ yadkhulu al-malaku 'alaa an-nutfati ba'da maa tastaqirru fee ar-rahimi bi'arba'eena aw khamsatin wa'arba'eena laylatan fayaqoolu yaa rabbi ashaqiyyun aw sa'eedun fayuktabaani fayaqoolu aa rabbi adhakarun aw unthaa fayuktabaani wayuktabu 'amaluhu wa'atharuhu wa'ajaluhu warizquhu thumma tutwaa as-suhufu fala yuzaadu feehaa wala yunqasu ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanee aboo kaamilin, fudaylu ibnu husaynin al-jahdariyyu haddathanaa hammaadu ibnu zaydin, haddathanaa 'ubaydu, Allah ibnu abee bakrin 'an anasi ibni maalikin, warafa'a al-hadeetha, annahu qaala ‏ "‏ inna Allah 'azza wajalla qad wakkala bir-rahimi malakan fayaqoolu aa rabbi nutfatun aa rabbi 'alaqatun aa rabbi mudghatun ‏.‏ fa'idhaa araada Allah an yaqdiya khalqan - qaala - qaala al-malaku aa rabbi dhakarun aw unthaa shaqiyyun aw sa'eedun famaa ar-rizqu famaa al-ajalu fayuktabu kadhalika fee batni ummihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa aboo bakri ibnu abee shaybata, waabnu, numayrin qaala haddathanaa 'abdu Allah ibnu idreesa, 'an rabee'ata ibni 'uthmaana, 'an muhammadi ibni yahyaa ibni habbaana, 'ani al-a'raji, 'an abee hurayrata, qaala qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ al-mu'minu al-qawiyyu khayrun wa'ahabbu ilaa Allah mina al-mu'mini ad-da'eefi wafee kullin khayrun ihris 'alaa maa yanfa'uka waasta'in bil-lahi wala ta'jiz wa'in asaabaka shaa'un fala taqul law annee fa'altu kaana kadhaa wakadhaa ‏.‏ walakin qul qadaru Allah wamaa shaa'a fa'ala fa'inna law taftahu 'amala ash-shaytaani ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa yahyaa ibnu yahyaa at-tameemiyyu, wa'aboo bakri ibnu abee shaybata wamuhammadu ibnu al-'ala'i al-hamdaaniyyu - wal-lafzu liyahyaa - qaala yahyaa akhbaranaa waqaala al-'aakharaani, haddathanaa aboo mu'aawiyata, 'ani al-a'mashi, 'an abee saalihin, 'an abee hurayrata, qaala qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ man naffasa 'an mu'minin kurbatan min kurabi ad-dunyaa naffasa Allah 'anhu kurbatan min kurabi yawmi al-qiyaamati waman yassara 'alaa mu'sirin yassara Allah 'alayhi fee ad-dunyaa wal-'aakhirati waman satara musliman satarahu Allah fee ad-dunyaa wal-'aakhirati wal-lahu fee 'awni al-'abdi maa kaana al-'abdu fee 'awni akheehi waman salaka tareeqan yaltamisu feehi 'ilman sahhala Allah lahu bihi tareeqan ilaa al-jannati wamaa ijtama'a qawmun fee baytin min buyooti Allah yatloona kitaaba Allah wayatadaarasoonahu baynahum ila nazalat 'alayhimu as-sakeenatu waghashiyathumu ar-rahmatu wahaffathumu al-mala'ikatu wadhakarahumu Allah feeman 'indahu waman batta'a bihi 'amaluhu lam yusri' bihi nasabuhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa aboo bakri ibnu abee shaybata, wa'aboo kuraybin qaala haddathanaa aboo mu'aawiyata, (h) wahaddathanaa ibnu, numayrin - wal-lafzu lahu - haddathanaa abee, haddathanaa al-a'mashu, 'an abee saalihin, 'an abee hurayrata, qaala qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏"‏ yaqoolu Allah 'azza wajalla a'dadtu li'ibaadiya as-saaliheena maa la 'aynun ra'at wala udhunun sami'at wala khatara 'alaa qalbi basharin ‏.‏ dhukhran balha maa atla'akumu Allah 'alayhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma qara'a ‏{‏ fala ta'lamu nafsun maa ukhfiya lahum min qurrati a'yunin‏}‏

haddathanaa haaroonu ibnu ma'roofin, wahaaroonu ibnu sa'eedin al-ayliyyu, qaala haddathanaa ibnu wahbin, haddathanee aboo sakhrin, anna abaa haazimin, haddathahu qaala sami'tu sahla ibna sa'din as-saa'idiyya, yaqoolu shahidtu min rasooli Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam majlisan wasafa feehi al-jannata hattaa intahaa thumma qaala salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam fee 'aakhiri hadeethihi ‏"‏ feehaa maa la 'aynun ra'at wala udhunun sami'at wala khatara 'alaa qalbi basharin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma iqtara'a hadhihi al-'aayata ‏{‏ tatajaafaa junoobuhum 'ani al-madaaji'i yad'oona rabbahum khawfan watama'an wamimmaa razaqnaahum yunfiqoona * fala ta'lamu nafsun maa ukhfiya lahum min qurrati a'yunin jazaa'an bimaa kaanoo ya'maloona‏}‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa qutaybatu ibnu sa'eedin, haddathanaa laythun, 'an sa'eedi ibni abee sa'eedin al-maqburiyyi, 'an abeehi, 'an abee hurayrata, 'an rasooli Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam annahu qaala ‏ "‏ inna fee al-jannati lashajaratan yaseeru ar-raakibu fee zillihaa mi'ata sanatin ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa ishaaqu ibnu ibraaheema al-hanzaliyyu, akhbaranaa al-makhzoomiyyu, haddathanaa wuhaybun, 'an abee, haazimin 'an sahli ibni sa'din, 'an rasooli Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏"‏ inna fee al-jannati lashajaratan yaseeru ar-raakibu fee zillihaa mi'ata 'aamin la yaqta'uhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala aboo haazimin fahaddathtu bihi an-nu'maana ibna abee 'ayyaashin az-zuraqiyya, faqaala haddathanee aboo sa'eedin al-khudriyyu 'ani an-nabiyyi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏"‏ inna fee al-jannati shajaratan yaseeru ar-raakibu al-jawaada al-mudammara as-saree'a mi'ata 'aamin maa yaqta'uhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa qutaybatu ibnu sa'eedin, haddathanaa ya'qoobu, - ya'nee ibna 'abdi ar-rahmani al-qaariyya - 'an abee haazimin, 'an sahli ibni sa'din, anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏"‏ inna ahla al-jannati layataraa'awna al-ghurfata fee al-jannati kamaa taraa'awna al-kawkaba fee as-samaa'i ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fahaddathtu bidhalika an-nu'maana ibna abee 'ayyaashin, faqaala sami'tu abaa sa'eedin al-khudriyya, yaqoolu kamaa taraa'awna al-kawkaba ad-durriyya fee al-ufuqi ash-sharqiyyi awi al-gharbiyyi ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanee 'abdu Allah ibnu ja'fari ibni yahyaa ibni khaalidin, haddathanaa ma'nun, haddathanaa maalikun, (h) wahaddathanee haaroonu ibnu sa'eedin al-ayliyyu, - wal-lafzu lahu - haddathanaa 'abdu Allah ibnu wahbin, akhbaranee maaliku ibnu anasin, 'an safwaana ibni sulaymin, 'an 'ataa'i ibni yasaarin, 'an abee sa'eedin al-khudriyyi, anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏"‏ inna ahla al-jannati layataraa'awna ahla al-ghurafi min fawqihim kamaa tataraa'awna al-kawkaba ad-durriyya al-ghaabira mina al-ufuqi mina al-mashriqi awi al-maghribi litafaaduli maa baynahum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaloo yaa rasoola Allah tilka manaazilu al-anbiyaa'i la yablughuhaa ghayruhum ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ balaa waalladhee nafsee biyadihi rijaalun 'aamanoo bil-lahi wasaddaqoo al-mursaleena ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa qutaybatu ibnu sa'eedin, haddathanaa ya'qoobu, - ya'nee ibna 'abdi ar-rahmani - 'an suhaylin, 'an abeehi, 'an abee hurayrata, anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ min ashaddi ummatee lee hubban naasun yakoonoona ba'dee yawaddu ahaduhum law ra'aanee bi'ahlihi wamaalihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa aboo 'uthmaana, sa'eedu ibnu 'abdi al-jabbaari al-basriyyu haddathanaa hammaadu ibnu salamata, 'an thaabitin, al-bunaaniyyi 'an anasi ibni maalikin, anna rasoola Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam qaala ‏ "‏ inna fee al-jannati lasooqan ya'atoonahaa kulla jumu'atin fatahubbu reehu ash-shamaali fatahthoo fee wujoohihim wathiyaabihim fayazdaadoona husnan wajamaalan fayarji'oona ilaa ahleehim waqadi izdaadoo husnan wajamaalan fayaqoolu lahum ahloohum wal-lahi laqadi izdadtum ba'danaa husnan wajamaalan ‏.‏ fayaqooloona wa'antum wal-lahi laqadi izdadtum ba'danaa husnan wajamaalan ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanee 'amrunw an-naaqidu, waya'qoobu ibnu ibraaheema ad-dawraqiyyu, jamee'an 'ani ibni 'ulayyata, - wal-lafzu liya'qooba - qaala haddathanaa ismaa'eelu ibnu 'ulayyata, akhbaranaa ayyoobu, 'an muhammadin, qaala immaa tafaakharoo wa'immaa tadhaakaroo ar-rijaalu fee al-jannati aktharu ami an-nisaa'u faqaala aboo hurayrata awalam yaqul aboo al-qaasimi salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ inna awwala zumratin tadkhulu al-jannata 'alaa soorati al-qamari laylata al-badri waallatee taleehaa 'alaa adwa'i kawkabin durriyyin fee as-samaa'i likulli imri'in minhum zawjataani ithnataani yuraa mukhkhu sooqihimaa min waraa'i al-lahmi wamaa fee al-jannati a'zabu ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa 'uthmaanu ibnu abee shaybata, wa'ishaaqu ibnu ibraaheema, - wal-lafzu li'uthmaana - qaala 'uthmaanu haddathanaa waqaala, ishaaqu akhbaranaa jareerun, 'ani al-a'mashi, 'an abee sufyaana, 'an jaabirin, qaala sami'tu an-nabiyya salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam yaqoolu ‏"‏ inna ahla al-jannati ya'akuloona feehaa wayashraboona wala yatfuloona wala yabooloona wala yataghawwatoona wala yamtakhitoona ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaloo famaa baalu at-ta'aami qaala ‏"‏ jushaa'un warashhun karashhi al-miski yulhamoona at-tasbeeha wat-tahmeeda kamaa yulhamoona an-nafasa ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa qutaybatu ibnu sa'eedin, haddathanaa 'abdu al-'azeezi, - ya'nee ad-daraawardiyya - 'ani al-'ala'i, 'an abeehi, 'an abee hurayrata, qaala qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ ad-dunyaa sijnu al-mu'mini wajannatu al-kaafiri ‏"‏ ‏.‏

haddathanaa haddaabu ibnu khaalidin al-azdiyyu, washaybaanu ibnu farrookha, jamee'an 'an sulaymaana ibni al-mugheerati, - wal-lafzu lishaybaana - haddathanaa sulaymaanu, haddathanaa thaabitun, 'an 'abdi ar-rahmani ibni abee laylaa, 'an suhaybin, qaala qaala rasoolu Allah salla Allah 'alayhi wa sallam ‏ "‏ 'ajaban l'amri al-mu'mini inna amrahu kullahu khayrun walaysa dhaaka l'ahadin ila lilmu'mini in asaabathu sarraa'u shakara fakaana khayran lahu wa'in asaabathu darraa'u sabara fakaana khayran lahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
